```tsx
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Camera, ScanFace, QrCode, FileText, X, Check, RefreshCw, 
  Sparkles, ShieldCheck, AlertCircle, Upload, Eye, Zap, Copy, Download,
  Maximize2, Volume2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { soundManager } from '../utils/sound';

interface CameraToolsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  initialTab?: 'face' | 'qr' | 'ocr' | 'analysis';
  onFaceVerified?: (userName: string) => void;
}

export default function CameraToolsModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  initialTab = 'face',
  onFaceVerified
}: CameraToolsModalProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'face' | 'qr' | 'ocr' | 'analysis'>(initialTab);
  
  // Camera Stream States
  const [hasCameraPermission, setHasCameraPermission] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [isCameraActive, setIsCameraActive] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Tab Specific States
  const [faceScanStatus, setFaceScanStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'scanning' | 'verified' | 'failed'>('idle');
  const [faceProgress, setFaceProgress] = useState(0);
  const [livenessScore, setLivenessScore] = useState(99.4);

  const [qrResult, setQrResult] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isScanningQr, setIsScanningQr] = useState(false);

  const [ocrText, setOcrText] = useState<string>('');
  const [isOcrProcessing, setIsOcrProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [scannedDocImage, setScannedDocImage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [uploadedImage, setUploadedImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [aiAnalysisResult, setAiAnalysisResult] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState(false);

  const [copiedText, setCopiedText] = useState(false);

  // Media Stream Refs
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);

  // Start Camera Stream
  const startCamera = async () => {
    setCameraError(null);
    try {
      if (streamRef.current) {
        streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      }

      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { width: { ideal: 1280 }, height: { ideal: 720 }, facingMode: 'user' },
        audio: false
      });

      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        await videoRef.current.play();
      }
      setHasCameraPermission(true);
      setIsCameraActive(true);
      soundManager.playSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('Camera access denied or unavailable:', err);
      setHasCameraPermission(false);
      setIsCameraActive(false);
      setCameraError(err.message || 'Camera hardware access denied. Please check device permissions.');
      soundManager.playToggle();
    }
  };

  // Stop Camera Stream
  const stopCamera = () => {
    if (streamRef.current) {
      streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    }
    setIsCameraActive(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      startCamera();
    } else {
      stopCamera();
    }
    return () => {
      stopCamera();
    };
  }, [isOpen, activeTab]);

  // Face Verification Handler
  const handleStartFaceScan = () => {
    if (faceScanStatus === 'scanning') return;
    soundManager.playClick();
    setFaceScanStatus('scanning');
    setFaceProgress(0);

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setFaceProgress((prev) => {
        if (prev >= 100) {
          clearInterval(interval);
          setFaceScanStatus('verified');
          soundManager.playSuccess();
          if (onFaceVerified) onFaceVerified('Shashvat (Face ID Verified)');
          return 100;
        }
        return prev + 10;
      });
    }, 150);
  };

  // QR Code Scanner Handler
  const handleScanQrNow = () => {
    setIsScanningQr(true);
    soundManager.playClick();

    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsScanningQr(false);
      const mockQrData = `https://kronex.ai/auth/session_token_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(7)}`;
      setQrResult(mockQrData);
      soundManager.playSuccess();
    }, 1200);
  };

  // Document OCR Handler
  const handleCaptureDocOcr = () => {
    setIsOcrProcessing(true);
    soundManager.playClick();

    // Snap image from video stream to canvas
    if (videoRef.current && canvasRef.current) {
      const video = videoRef.current;
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      canvas.width = video.videoWidth || 640;
      canvas.height = video.videoHeight || 480;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (ctx) {
        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        const imgData = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg');
        setScannedDocImage(imgData);
      }
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsOcrProcessing(false);
      const extracted = `KRONEX AI ENTERPRISE DEPLOYMENT SPECIFICATION v6.0\n\nClient ID: SEC-88942-KRX\nSystem Authorization: Level 5 Sovereign\nModel Selected: Gemini 3.6 Flash / Claude 3.7 Sonnet\nStatus: FULLY ENCRYPTED & VERIFIED\n\nKey Parameters:\n- Hardware Acceleration: WebGPU + WASM Enabled\n- Latency SLA: < 24ms Realtime Audio & Vision\n- Security Protocol: AES-256 GCM Hardware Sealed`;
      setOcrText(extracted);
      soundManager.playSuccess();
    }, 1500);
  };

  // AI Image Analysis Handler
  const handleImageAnalysis = (imgSrc: string) => {
    setUploadedImage(imgSrc);
    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    soundManager.playClick();

    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsAnalyzing(false);
      setAiAnalysisResult(
        `**Gemini Multimodal Vision Analysis:**\n\n1. **Object Detection**: Detected high-definition technical interface elements, glowing status indicators, and biometric scan target overlays.\n2. **Confidence**: 99.8%\n3. **Recommendation**: Operational parameters optimal. Suitable for immediate deployment in Enterprise AI Agent workflows.`
      );
      soundManager.playSuccess();
    }, 1600);
  };

  const handleCopyText = (text: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedText(true);
    soundManager.playClick();
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedText(false), 2000);
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-3xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-white/[0.1] rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-5 relative overflow-hidden text-white font-sans">
        {/* Top Accent Line */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-[2px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] via-[#00D4FF] to-[#00FFA3]" />

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.08] pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-[#00D4FF]/20 border border-[#00D4FF]/40 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Camera className="w-5 h-5 text-[#00D4FF]" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Camera & Vision AI Studio</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">Face Biometrics, QR Code Reader, Document OCR & AI Vision Analysis</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              stopCamera();
              onClose();
            }}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Navigation */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 bg-[#131A2E]/70 p-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] overflow-x-auto">
          <button
            onClick={() => { setActiveTab('face'); soundManager.playClick(); }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'face'
                ? 'bg-[#00D4FF]/20 border border-[#00D4FF]/50 text-[#00D4FF] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,212,255,0.2)]'
                : 'text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <ScanFace className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Face Auth</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => { setActiveTab('qr'); soundManager.playClick(); }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'qr'
                ? 'bg-[#7C5CFF]/20 border border-[#7C5CFF]/50 text-[#7C5CFF] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(124,92,255,0.2)]'
                : 'text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <QrCode className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>QR Scanner</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => { setActiveTab('ocr'); soundManager.playClick(); }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'ocr'
                ? 'bg-[#00FFA3]/20 border border-[#00FFA3]/50 text-[#00FFA3] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,255,163,0.2)]'
                : 'text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Document OCR</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => { setActiveTab('analysis'); soundManager.playClick(); }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'analysis'
                ? 'bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/50 text-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.2)]'
                : 'text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>AI Vision</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Camera Viewport Container */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {/* Left: Video Feed */}
          <div className="relative bg-[#050816] rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.1] overflow-hidden aspect-video sm:aspect-square flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
            <video
              ref={videoRef}
              playsInline
              muted
              className={`w-full h-full object-cover ${isCameraActive ? 'block' : 'hidden'}`}
            />
            <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="hidden" />

            {!isCameraActive && (
              <div className="p-6 text-center space-y-3">
                <Camera className="w-10 h-10 text-[#94A3B8] mx-auto animate-pulse" />
                <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">
                  {cameraError || 'Camera feed starting or permissions requested...'}
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={startCamera}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-xs font-bold text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Enable Camera Permission
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Overlays according to active tab */}
            {isCameraActive && activeTab === 'face' && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
                <div className="w-48 h-64 rounded-[50%] border-2 border-dashed border-[#00D4FF] shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,212,255,0.4)] flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative">
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-[50%] border border-[#00D4FF]/30 animate-ping" />
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-[#00D4FF] bg-black/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-[#00D4FF]/40">
                    ALIGN FACE
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {isCameraActive && activeTab === 'qr' && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
                <div className="w-48 h-48 rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#7C5CFF] relative shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(124,92,255,0.4)]">
                  <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-[2px] bg-[#00D4FF] animate-pulse" />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {isCameraActive && activeTab === 'ocr' && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
                <div className="w-56 h-40 border-2 border-[#00FFA3] rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center relative shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,255,163,0.3)]">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#00FFA3] bg-black/70 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-[#00FFA3]/40">
                    HOLD DOCUMENT STILL
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Right: Tab Controls & Results */}
          <div className="bg-[#131A2E]/80 border border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4">
            {/* TAB 1: Face Auth */}
            {activeTab === 'face' && (
              <div className="space-y-4 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-[#00D4FF] font-bold text-sm">
                    <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Biometric Face Verification</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8] mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                    Verify user identity using 3D facial feature embedding vectors and real-time liveness analysis.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 bg-[#0B1020] p-3 rounded-xl border border-white/5 font-mono text-xs">
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[#94A3B8]">
                    <span>Liveness Confidence:</span>
                    <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">{livenessScore}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[#94A3B8]">
                    <span>Biometric Encryption:</span>
                    <span className="text-[#00D4FF]">AES-256 Sealed</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {faceScanStatus === 'verified' ? (
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-bold flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <Check className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0" />
                    <span>Face Identity Verified! Welcome Shashvat.</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    onClick={handleStartFaceScan}
                    disabled={faceScanStatus === 'scanning' || !isCameraActive}
                    className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,212,255,0.4)] transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"
                  >
                    {faceScanStatus === 'scanning' ? (
                      <>
                        <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-white" />
                        <span>Analyzing Biometrics ({faceProgress}%)...</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <ScanFace className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>Scan Face & Verify Identity</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 2: QR Scanner */}
            {activeTab === 'qr' && (
              <div className="space-y-4 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-[#7C5CFF] font-bold text-sm">
                    <QrCode className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Real-Time QR Code Reader</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8] mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                    Point camera at any QR code to authenticate, load workflows, or connect API keys instantly.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {qrResult ? (
                  <div className="p-3.5 rounded-xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-[#7C5CFF]/40 space-y-2">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#7C5CFF] font-bold uppercase">Decoded QR Output:</span>
                    <p className="text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] font-mono break-all">{qrResult}</p>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleCopyText(qrResult)}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-xs font-bold text-white transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-1.5"
                    >
                      {copiedText ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                      <span>{copiedText ? 'Copied' : 'Copy Output'}</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-white/5 text-center text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">
                    No QR code detected in active camera frame yet.
                  </div>
                )}

                <button
                  onClick={handleScanQrNow}
                  disabled={isScanningQr || !isCameraActive}
                  className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"
                >
                  {isScanningQr ? (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-white" />
                      <span>Reading QR Code Matrix...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <QrCode className="w-4 h-4" />
                      <span>Capture & Read QR Code</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 3: Document OCR */}
            {activeTab === 'ocr' && (
              <div className="space-y-4 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-[#00FFA3] font-bold text-sm">
                    <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Document Scanner & Optical Recognition</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8] mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                    Capture document text with high contrast edge-detection and Gemini OCR extraction.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {ocrText ? (
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-emerald-500/30 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar font-mono text-[11px] text-[#F8FAFC] whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
                    {ocrText}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-white/5 text-center text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">
                    Click below to capture frame & run Gemini OCR text extraction.
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex space-x-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={handleCaptureDocOcr}
                    disabled={isOcrProcessing || !isCameraActive}
                    className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00FFA3] to-[#00D4FF] text-[#0B1020] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"
                  >
                    {isOcrProcessing ? (
                      <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Camera className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>Snap & Extract Text</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>

                  {ocrText && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleCopyText(ocrText)}
                      className="px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-bold text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {copiedText ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 4: AI Vision Analysis */}
            {activeTab === 'analysis' && (
              <div className="space-y-4 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-amber-400 font-bold text-sm">
                    <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Gemini Multimodal AI Vision</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8] mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                    Upload image or capture frame for detailed object, code, diagram, or scene analysis.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {aiAnalysisResult ? (
                  <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-amber-500/30 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
                    {aiAnalysisResult}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <label className="p-4 border-2 border-dashed border-white/10 rounded-xl text-center space-y-2 block cursor-pointer hover:border-amber-400/50 transition-colors">
                    <Upload className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-400 mx-auto" />
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Upload Photo or Drag File Here</p>
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/*"
                      className="hidden"
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
                          const reader = new FileReader();
                          reader.onload = (ev) => handleImageAnalysis(ev.target?.result as string);
                          reader.readAsDataURL(e.target.files[0]);
                        }
                      }}
                    />
                  </label>
                )}

                <button
                  onClick={() => handleImageAnalysis('captured-frame')}
                  disabled={isAnalyzing || !isCameraActive}
                  className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-[#7C5CFF] text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"
                >
                  {isAnalyzing ? (
                    <>
                      <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                      <span>Gemini Analyzing Vision Data...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                      <span>Analyze Live Camera Frame</span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// Pre-defined template certificates the user can select

    date: "May 2026",
    grade: "Perfect (100%)",
    skills: ["Real-time Code Streaming", "Interactive UI Injection", "AST Code Hot-Swaps", "Holographic Grids"],
    hash: "sha256:d8c114f0ea511c9118e9c20a11",
    color: "from-fuchsia-600 via-purple-600 to-pink-500",
    bgAccent: "rgba(217, 70, 239, 0.08)",
    badgeColor: "text-fuchsia-600 bg-fuchsia-50 border-fuchsia-200"
  }
];

export default function CertificateShowcase() {
  const [selectedIdx, setSelectedIdx] = useState(0);
  const activeCert = CERTIFICATES_DATA[selectedIdx];
  
  // Toast notifications
  const [activeNotification, setActiveNotification] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const notify = (msg: string) => {
    setActiveNotification(msg);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setActiveNotification(null);
    }, 3000);
  };

  // Interactive Verification states
  const [isVerifyModalOpen, setIsVerifyModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [verificationId, setVerificationId] = useState('');
  const [verificationResult, setVerificationResult] = useState<'idle' | 'scanning' | 'success' | 'failed'>('idle');
  const [scannedCert, setScannedCert] = useState<typeof CERTIFICATES_DATA[0] | null>(null);

  // 3D Tilt parameters for Mouse movement
  const [tilt, setTilt] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [shinePos, setShinePos] = useState({ x: 50, y: 50 });
  const certRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Canvas backdrop for particles
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // 3D Particles effect
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    let width = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth);
    let height = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!canvas) return;
      width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
      height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    // Particles and slow motion variables
    interface Particle {
      x: number;
      y: number;
      radius: number;
      color: string;
      speed: number;
      angle: number;
      vibrancy: number;
    }

    const particles: Particle[] = Array.from({ length: 30 }, () => ({
      x: Math.random() * width,
      y: Math.random() * height,
      radius: Math.random() * 3.5 + 1.5,
      color: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.15)' : 'rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.12)',
      speed: Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1,
      angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      vibrancy: Math.random() * 0.02
    }));

    let animationId: number;
    const draw = () => {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

      // Render subtle light beams/glowing layers in background
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(width * 0.3, height * 0.4, 10, width * 0.3, height * 0.4, width * 0.5);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.03)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.01)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

      // Drawing particles
      particles.forEach(p => {
        p.angle += p.vibrancy;
        p.x += Math.cos(p.angle) * p.speed;
        p.y += Math.sin(p.angle) * p.speed;

        // Wrap boundaries
        if (p.x < 0) p.x = width;
        if (p.x > width) p.x = 0;
        if (p.y < 0) p.y = height;
        if (p.y > height) p.y = 0;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3)';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset
      });

      animationId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    };

    draw();

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
    };
  }, []);

  // Handle Mouse Move for 3D tilt of Certificate Card
  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const el = certRef.current;
    if (!el) return;

    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left; // x coordinate within element
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;  // y coordinate within element

    const xc = rect.width / 2;
    const yc = rect.height / 2;

    const tiltX = -(y - yc) / 14; // max angle in degrees
    const tiltY = (x - xc) / 14;

    setTilt({ x: tiltX, y: tiltY });

    // Calculate percent position for shine sweep
    const shineX = (x / rect.width) * 100;
    const shineY = (y / rect.height) * 100;
    setShinePos({ x: shineX, y: shineY });
  };

  const handleMouseLeave = () => {
    setTilt({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  };

  // Simulate verification scan
  const startVerification = (id: string) => {
    const cleaned = id.trim().toUpperCase();
    setVerificationResult('scanning');
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      const found = CERTIFICATES_DATA.find(c => c.id === cleaned) || null;
      if (found) {
        setScannedCert(found);
        setVerificationResult('success');
      } else {
        setVerificationResult('failed');
      }
    }, 2200);
  };

  return (
    <section id="certificates" className="relative py-24 px-6 md:px-12 bg-[#050816] overflow-hidden border-t border-white/5">
      {/* Toast Notifications */}
      <AnimatePresence>

          <motion.div

            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20, scale: 0.95 }}
            className="fixed top-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 bg-[#12121A]/90 border border-white/10 p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl flex items-center space-x-3 backdrop-blur-md"
          >
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Sparkles className="w-4.5 h-4.5 text-brand-secondary animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs">
              <span className="block font-black text-white">KRONEX Registry Alert</span>
              <span className="block text-[#A1A1AA] font-medium">{activeNotification}</span>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Dynamic 3D Floating Particle Canvas Backdrop */}
      <canvas 
        ref={canvasRef}
        className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-0"
      />

      {/* Decorative Aurora Gradients */}
      <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-0 w-[450px] h-[450px] bg-brand-primary/5 rounded-full blur-[140px] pointer-events-none z-0" />
      <div className="absolute bottom-1/4 right-0 w-[550px] h-[550px] bg-brand-secondary/5 rounded-full blur-[160px] pointer-events-none z-0" />

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto relative z-10">
        
        {/* Header Block with luxurious aesthetic typography */}
        <div className="text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-16">

            <Award className="w-4 h-4 text-[#22D3EE]" />
            <span>Verifiable Blockchain Credentials</span>
          </div>

            Earn an Industry-Recognized Certificate
          </h2>

            Complete any KRONEX AI course and unlock a premium, verifiable digital certificate that proves your AI skills worldwide. Backed by immutable cryptographic hashes.

                  const link = document.createElement('a');

                    e.preventDefault();

                  link.click();
                }}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-xs font-bold text-white/80 hover:text-white transition-all flex items-center space-x-1.5 shadow-2xl cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white/50" />
                <span>Save PDF</span>
              </button>

              <button

                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-xs font-bold text-white/80 hover:text-white transition-all flex items-center space-x-1.5 shadow-2xl cursor-pointer"

              </h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-[#A1A1AA] font-sans leading-relaxed">
                Unlock career pathways in tech-forward industries. Our automated digital records system interfaces with leading global registries to ensure your hard work stays verifiable 24/7/365.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Feature Cards Grid (2x3 Grid) */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              {[
                {
                  title: "Industry Recognized",
                  desc: "Partnered with leading global AI, Cloud, and engineering groups.",
                  icon: Cpu,
                  color: "border-purple-500/20 bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400"
                },

                  }
                }}
                className="flex-1 py-4 px-6 rounded-xl font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-widest bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C3AED] to-[#22D3EE] text-white hover:opacity-90 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 group cursor-pointer shadow-sm active:scale-95"
              >
                <span>Get Certified Now</span>
                <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 transition-transform group-hover:translate-x-1 text-white" />
              </button>

              <button 
                onClick={() => {
                  setVerificationId(activeCert.id);
                  setIsVerifyModalOpen(true);
                  startVerification(activeCert.id);
                }}
                className="flex-1 py-4 px-6 rounded-xl font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-widest border border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-sm"
              >
                <Eye className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                <span>View Sample</span>
              </button>

              <button 
                onClick={() => {
                  setVerificationId('');
                  setVerificationResult('idle');
                  setIsVerifyModalOpen(true);
                }}
                className="flex-1 py-4 px-6 rounded-xl font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-widest border border-brand-secondary/20 bg-brand-secondary/10 text-brand-secondary hover:bg-brand-secondary/20 transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-lg"
              >
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-secondary animate-pulse" />
                <span>Verify ID</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Holographic Verification Simulator Modal Overlay */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isVerifyModalOpen && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <motion.div 
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 15 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 15 }}
              className="bg-[#12121A]/95 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-lg p-6 md:p-8 shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-xl"
            >
              {/* Absolute Watermark Background */}
              <div className="absolute -left-12 -top-12 w-48 h-48 bg-white/3 rounded-full border border-white/5 pointer-events-none opacity-40 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Lock className="w-20 h-20 text-white/5" />
              </div>

              {/* Close Button */}
              <button 
                onClick={() => setIsVerifyModalOpen(false)}
                className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-white/10 text-white/50 hover:text-white transition-colors"
              >
                <ChevronRight className="w-5 h-5 rotate-90" />
              </button>

              <div className="text-center space-y-2 mb-6">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-brand-secondary/10 border border-brand-secondary/20 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6 text-brand-secondary animate-pulse" />
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-xl font-display font-black text-white tracking-tight">
                  KRONEX AI Registry Portal
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#A1A1AA] font-sans max-w-sm mx-auto">
                  Type a verifiable Certificate ID below to trigger cryptographic validation sequences across node clusters.
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Verification input field */}
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex space-x-2">
                  <input 
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="Enter ID (e.g. KRNX-AI-883F)"
                    value={verificationId}
                    onChange={(e) => setVerificationId(e.target.value)}
                    className="flex-1 bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-primary placeholder-white/30"
                  />
                  <button 
                    onClick={() => startVerification(verificationId)}
                    className="px-5 py-3 rounded-xl bg-brand-primary hover:bg-brand-primary/85 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-white transition-all flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Search className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Query Registry</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-center">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-white/40 uppercase font-bold self-center">Try:</span>
                  {CERTIFICATES_DATA.map((c) => (
                    <button
                      key={c.id}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setVerificationId(c.id);
                        startVerification(c.id);
                      }}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-mono bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-brand-secondary border border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 text-white/80 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {c.id}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Holographic Output logs */}
              <div className="mt-6 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl bg-black/90 p-4 min-h-[140px] flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden">
                {/* Scanner Overlay Line */}
                {verificationResult === 'scanning' && (
                  <div className="absolute inset-x-0 h-0.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-cyan-400 to-transparent animate-[bounce_1.5s_infinite] top-0 pointer-events-none" />
                )}

                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-white/40 block uppercase tracking-widest border-b border-white/5 pb-1.5">
                    PARSER TERMINAL INTERFACE:
                  </span>
                  
                  {verificationResult === 'idle' && (
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-white/40 italic">
                      Waiting for active registry token payload...
                    </p>
                  )}

                  {verificationResult === 'scanning' && (
                    <div className="space-y-1 font-mono text-[10.5px] text-cyan-400 leading-relaxed">
                      <p className="animate-pulse">▶ Resolving DNS for registry.kronex.ai...</p>
                      <p className="delay-100">▶ Cryptographic cluster handshake successful.</p>
                      <p className="delay-200">▶ Parsing immutable signature payload for "{verificationId}"</p>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {verificationResult === 'success' && scannedCert && (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-emerald-400 font-mono text-xs font-bold">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                        <span>AUTHENTICATION VERIFIED SUCCESS (SLA SECURED)</span>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-1 text-[10px] font-mono text-[#A1A1AA]">
                        <div>
                          <span className="block text-white/30">RECIPIENT:</span>
                          <span className="text-white font-bold">{scannedCert.recipient}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="block text-white/30">CREDENTIAL TITLE:</span>
                          <span className="text-white font-bold">{scannedCert.title}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="block text-white/30">DATE RECORDED:</span>
                          <span className="text-white font-bold">{scannedCert.date}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="block text-white/30">BLOCK HASH:</span>
                          <span className="text-white font-bold truncate block">{scannedCert.hash}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {verificationResult === 'failed' && (
                    <div className="space-y-1.5 text-red-400 font-mono text-[11px]">
                      <p className="font-bold flex items-center space-x-1">
                        <span>⚠ REGISTRY LOOKUP ERROR</span>
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-white/40 text-[10px]">
                        The key index was not matched in KRONEX-BLOC-LEDGER. Check syntax or type a valid identifier.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Footer status indicator */}
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[8.5px] font-mono text-white/30 pt-3 border-t border-white/5 mt-3">
                  <span>SSL STATUS: RSA-4096 VALID</span>
                  <span>LATENCY: 14MS</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Close CTAs */}
              <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end space-x-3">
                <button 
                  onClick={() => setIsVerifyModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 text-xs font-bold text-white/80 hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Close Portal
                </button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

    </section>
  );
}
```

FILE: src/components/CommunityForum.tsx

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { FORUM_POSTS } from '../data';
import { ForumPost, ForumComment, UserProgress } from '../types';
import { 
  MessageSquare, Heart, Pin, Plus, Search, ArrowLeft, Send, 
  User, ShieldCheck, HelpCircle, Flame, Award, Terminal 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';

interface CommunityForumProps {
  progress: UserProgress;
  onUpdateProgress: (newProgress: Partial<UserProgress>) => void;
}

export default function CommunityForum({ progress, onUpdateProgress }: CommunityForumProps) {
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState<ForumPost[]>(FORUM_POSTS);
  const [selectedPostId, setSelectedPostId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<string>('All');
  
  // Create Post Form States
  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false);
  const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = useState('');
  const [newContent, setNewContent] = useState('');
  const [newCategory, setNewCategory] = useState<'General' | 'Python' | 'Prompt Engineering' | 'UI/UX Design' | 'Job Hunt' | 'Showcase'>('General');

  // Comment reply state
  const [commentContent, setCommentContent] = useState('');

  const categories = ['All', 'General', 'Python', 'Prompt Engineering', 'UI/UX Design', 'Job Hunt', 'Showcase'];

  const filteredPosts = posts.filter(post => {
    const matchesSearch = post.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || 
                          post.content.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'All' || post.category === activeCategory;
    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
  });

  const selectedPost = posts.find(p => p.id === selectedPostId);

  const handleLikePost = (postId: string, e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    
    setPosts(prev => prev.map(p => {
      if (p.id === postId) {
        const hasLiked = !p.hasLiked;
        return {
          ...p,
          hasLiked,
          likes: hasLiked ? p.likes + 1 : p.likes - 1
        };
      }
      return p;
    }));
  };

  const handleCreatePost = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newTitle.trim() || !newContent.trim()) return;

    const newPost: ForumPost = {
      id: `custom-post-${Date.now()}`,
      author: 'Kronex Explorer (You)',
      avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=100&q=80',
      title: newTitle,
      content: newContent,
      category: newCategory,
      likes: 1,
      hasLiked: true,
      createdAt: 'Just now',
      replies: []
    };

    setPosts([newPost, ...posts]);
    setIsCreating(false);
    setNewTitle('');
    setNewContent('');

    // Award XP for posting on forum
    onUpdateProgress({
      xp: progress.xp + 25,
      level: Math.floor((progress.xp + 25) / 300) + 1
    });
  };

  const handleAddComment = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!commentContent.trim() || !selectedPostId) return;

    const newComment: ForumComment = {
      id: `comment-${Date.now()}`,
      author: 'Kronex Explorer (You)',
      avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=100&q=80',
      content: commentContent,
      createdAt: 'Just now',
      likes: 0
    };

    setPosts(prev => prev.map(p => {
      if (p.id === selectedPostId) {
        return {
          ...p,
          replies: [...p.replies, newComment]
        };
      }
      return p;
    }));

    setCommentContent('');

    // Award XP for contributing to discussion
    onUpdateProgress({
      xp: progress.xp + 15,
      level: Math.floor((progress.xp + 15) / 300) + 1
    });
  };

  return (
    <div id="community-discussion-panel" className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 py-10 text-white">
      
      {/* HEADER ROW */}
      <div className="mb-8 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-extrabold text-3xl text-white flex items-center space-x-2">
            <Flame className="text-brand-secondary w-8 h-8 animate-pulse" />
            <span className="bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-slate-200 to-slate-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent">Community Discussion Forums</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-white/60 font-sans mt-1">
            Connect with other modern explorers, ask questions, exchange code hacks, and collaborate.
          </p>
        </div>

        {!selectedPostId && !isCreating && (
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsCreating(true)}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-display font-bold text-xs shining-btn text-white transition-all shadow-xl shadow-brand-primary/20 flex items-center space-x-1.5 self-start cursor-pointer border border-white/10"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Create Topic (+25 XP)</span>
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        
        {/* VIEWING SINGLE POST THREAD */}
        {selectedPostId && selectedPost ? (
          <motion.div
            key="thread"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 10 }}
            className="space-y-6"
          >
            {/* Back Button */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setSelectedPostId(null)}
              className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-secondary hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Back to all discussions</span>
            </button>

            {/* Root Post Card */}
            <div className="bg-white/[0.03] rounded-3xl border border-white/10 p-6 shadow-2xl">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 mb-4">
                <img src={selectedPost.avatar} alt={selectedPost.author} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full border border-white/10" />
                <div>
                  <span className="block text-sm font-bold text-white">{selectedPost.author}</span>
                  <span className="block text-[10px] font-mono text-white/45">{selectedPost.createdAt} • Category: {selectedPost.category}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <h2 className="font-display font-black text-xl text-white mb-4">
                {selectedPost.title}
              </h2>

              <p className="text-sm text-white/70 font-sans leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
                {selectedPost.content}
              </p>

              <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center space-x-6 text-xs font-semibold text-white/55">
                <button 
                  onClick={() => handleLikePost(selectedPost.id)}
                  className={`flex items-center space-x-1.5 hover:text-brand-secondary transition-colors cursor-pointer ${selectedPost.hasLiked ? 'text-brand-secondary' : ''}`}
                >
                  <Heart className={`w-4 h-4 ${selectedPost.hasLiked ? 'fill-current text-brand-secondary' : ''}`} />
                  <span>{selectedPost.likes} Likes</span>
                </button>
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                  <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>{selectedPost.replies.length} replies</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Comments/Replies list */}
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-white/80 px-2">Discussion Replies</h3>
              
              {selectedPost.replies.map((reply) => (
                <div key={reply.id} className="bg-white/[0.02] backdrop-blur rounded-2xl border border-white/5 p-5 shadow-2xl flex items-start space-x-4">
                  <img src={reply.avatar} alt={reply.author} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full mt-0.5 border border-white/5" />
                  <div className="flex-grow space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white">{reply.author}</span>
                      {reply.isMentor && (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center space-x-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-brand-primary/20 border border-brand-primary/30 text-brand-secondary text-[9px] font-bold font-mono">
                          <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>Kronex Coach</span>
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-white/40">{reply.createdAt}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-sans text-white/75 leading-relaxed">
                      {reply.content}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Post comment reply form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleAddComment} className="bg-white/[0.03] rounded-2xl border border-white/10 p-4 flex gap-4 shadow-2xl">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={commentContent}
                onChange={(e) => setCommentContent(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Write a constructive comment or answer..."
                className="flex-grow bg-white/5 border border-white/10 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs text-white placeholder-white/30 outline-none focus:border-brand-primary"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="p-3 bg-brand-primary hover:bg-brand-secondary text-white rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-lg hover:scale-[1.02]"
                title="Send reply"
              >
                <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </form>

          </motion.div>
        ) : isCreating ? (
          
          /* CREATING NEW POST TOPIC */
          <motion.div
            key="create-form"
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}
            className="space-y-6"
          >
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsCreating(false)}
              className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand-secondary hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Cancel new topic</span>
            </button>

            <form onSubmit={handleCreatePost} className="bg-white/[0.03] rounded-3xl border border-white/10 p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4">
              <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-lg text-white">Launch New Discussion Topic</h2>
              
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-white/45 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Discussion Title</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={newTitle}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewTitle(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g., Demystifying neural network cost functions with real metrics"
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-xs text-white placeholder-white/30 outline-none focus:border-brand-primary"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-white/45 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Channel Category</label>
                  <select
                    value={newCategory}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewCategory(e.target.value as any)}
                    className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-[#0b1120] text-xs text-white outline-none focus:border-brand-primary cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <option value="General">General Questions</option>
                    <option value="Python">Python AI Path</option>
                    <option value="Prompt Engineering">Prompt Engineering</option>
                    <option value="UI/UX Design">UI/UX Design</option>
                    <option value="Job Hunt">Job Hunt & Career</option>
                    <option value="Showcase">Project Showcase</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-white/45 uppercase tracking-wider font-mono">Topic Content / Details</label>
                <textarea
                  required
                  rows={6}
                  value={newContent}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewContent(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Elaborate on your idea, paste sample prompts, or request reviews from our expert mentors..."
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-xs text-white placeholder-white/30 outline-none focus:border-brand-primary resize-none font-sans"
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full py-3 rounded-2xl font-display font-bold text-xs text-white shining-btn hover:scale-[1.01] active:scale-[0.99] transition-all cursor-pointer border border-white/10"
              >
                Publish New Topic (+25 XP)
              </button>
            </form>
          </motion.div>
        ) : (
          
          /* GENERAL DISCUSSIONS FEED LIST */
          <motion.div
            key="feed"
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            className="space-y-6"
          >
            {/* Filters Row */}
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4 py-2 border-y border-white/10">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {categories.map((cat) => (
                  <button
                    key={cat}
                    onClick={() => setActiveCategory(cat)}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold tracking-wider font-display transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      activeCategory === cat
                        ? 'bg-brand-primary/20 border border-brand-primary/30 text-brand-secondary'
                        : 'bg-transparent text-white/50 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {cat}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              <div className="relative w-full md:w-64">
                <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-white/40" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={searchTerm}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search discussions..."
                  className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-[11px] text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-primary placeholder-white/30 transition-colors font-sans"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Posts Stream */}
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {filteredPosts.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-center py-12 bg-white/[0.03] rounded-3xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl">
                  <HelpCircle className="w-10 h-10 text-white/30 mx-auto opacity-50" />
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white mt-2">No discussions found</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-white/50 font-sans">Be the first to create a topic in this channel!</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                filteredPosts.map((post) => (
                  <div
                    key={post.id}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedPostId(post.id)}
                    className="bg-white/[0.03] rounded-3xl border border-white/10 p-6 shadow-2xl hover:border-brand-primary/40 hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(123,47,247,0.15)] hover:scale-[1.005] transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between"
                  >
                    <div>
                      {/* Post top metadata */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                          <img src={post.avatar} alt={post.author} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full border border-white/5" />
                          <div>
                            <span className="block text-xs font-bold text-white">{post.author}</span>

                              <Pin className="w-3 h-3 fill-current" />
                              <span>PINNED</span>

                          )}
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-brand-primary/20 border border-brand-primary/30 text-brand-secondary text-[9px] font-bold font-mono">
                            {post.category}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <h3 className="font-display font-black text-base text-white leading-tight hover:text-brand-secondary transition-colors mb-2">
                        {post.title}
                      </h3>

                      <p className="text-xs text-white/60 font-sans line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                        {post.content}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    {/* Likes & replies bar */}
                    <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center space-x-4 text-[11px] font-bold text-white/45">
                      <button
                        onClick={(e) => handleLikePost(post.id, e)}
                        className={`flex items-center space-x-1 hover:text-brand-secondary transition-colors cursor-pointer ${post.hasLiked ? 'text-brand-secondary font-bold' : ''}`}
                      >
                        <Heart className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${post.hasLiked ? 'fill-current text-brand-secondary' : ''}`} />
                        <span>{post.likes} Likes</span>

                      </div>
                    </div>

                  </div>
                ))
              )}

        )}

  );
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export default function CursorGlow() {
  const [pos, setPos] = useState({ x: -200, y: -200 });
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Only run on non-touch devices and respect reduced motion
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    if (mediaQuery.matches) return;

    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      setPos({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
      if (!isVisible) setIsVisible(true);
    };

    const handleMouseLeave = () => setIsVisible(false);

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
    };
  }, [isVisible]);

  if (!isVisible) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed pointer-events-none z-50 rounded-full transition-opacity duration-300 hidden md:block"
      style={{
        left: `${pos.x}px`,
        top: `${pos.y}px`,
        width: '320px',
        height: '320px',
        transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
        background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.08) 0%, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.04) 45%, transparent 70%)',
        mixBlendMode: 'screen',
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import { Sparkles, BrainCircuit, Cpu } from 'lucide-react';

interface FloatingAIOrbProps {
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  isThinking?: boolean;
  label?: string;
}

export default function FloatingAIOrb({ size = 'md', isThinking = false, label }: FloatingAIOrbProps) {
  const sizeMap = {
    sm: 'w-16 h-16',
    md: 'w-24 h-24',
    lg: 'w-36 h-36'
  };

  const iconSizeMap = {
    sm: 'w-6 h-6',
    md: 'w-10 h-10',
    lg: 'w-14 h-14'
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
      <div className={`relative flex items-center justify-center ${sizeMap[size]}`}>
        {/* Ambient Volumetric Glow */}
        <div 
          className={`absolute inset-0 rounded-full blur-2xl transition-all duration-500 ${
            isThinking 
              ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500/40 via-cyan-500/40 to-purple-500/40 animate-pulse scale-125' 
              : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C3AED]/30 to-[#22D3EE]/30 animate-pulse-slow'
          }`} 
        />

        {/* Orbit Ring 1 */}
        <motion.div 
          animate={{ rotate: 360 }}
          transition={{ duration: isThinking ? 4 : 16, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }}
          className="absolute -inset-2 rounded-full border border-dashed border-cyan-400/30"
        />

        {/* Orbit Ring 2 */}
        <motion.div 
          animate={{ rotate: -360 }}
          transition={{ duration: isThinking ? 6 : 22, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }}
          className="absolute -inset-4 rounded-full border border-purple-500/20"
        />

        {/* Inner Glowing Core */}
        <motion.div
          animate={{
            y: [0, -6, 0],
            scale: isThinking ? [1, 1.08, 1] : [1, 1.03, 1]
          }}
          transition={{
            y: { duration: 4, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' },
            scale: { duration: isThinking ? 0.8 : 3, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }
          }}
          className="w-full h-full rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#7C3AED] via-[#A855F7] to-[#22D3EE] p-0.5 shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(124,58,237,0.4)] relative z-10 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden"
        >
          <div className="w-full h-full bg-[#0B1020]/90 backdrop-blur-md rounded-[14px] flex items-center justify-center relative">
            {/* Scan line effect */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-cyan-400/10 to-transparent animate-scan-line pointer-events-none" />

            {isThinking ? (
              <BrainCircuit className={`${iconSizeMap[size]} text-amber-400 animate-spin`} />
            ) : (
              <Sparkles className={`${iconSizeMap[size]} text-[#22D3EE] animate-pulse`} />
            )}
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Orbiting particles */}
        <span className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_#22D3EE] animate-ping" />
        <span className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-purple-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_#7C3AED] animate-pulse" />
      </div>

      {label && (
        <span className="mt-3 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold tracking-wider text-slate-300 uppercase flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Cpu className="w-3 h-3 text-[#22D3EE]" />
          {label}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
