```tsx
const INITIAL_MESSAGES: ChatMessage[] = [
  {
    id: 'msg-1',
    role: 'assistant',
    content: 'Hello! I am your Gemini 3.6 Flash AI assistant. How can I help you build workflows, generate code, or explore KRONEX AI today?',
    timestamp: 'Just now',
    model: 'gemini-3.6-flash'
  }
];

const PROMPT_SUGGESTIONS = [
  '⚡ Create an AI Workflow',
  '🧠 Explain Gemini 3.6 Pro',
  '💻 Write TypeScript Hook',
  '🔍 Search Google Grounding'
];

export default function FloatingGeminiChat({ isOpen, onToggle, onNavigate }: FloatingGeminiChatProps) {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>(INITIAL_MESSAGES);
  const [inputPrompt, setInputPrompt] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [selectedModel, setSelectedModel] = useState('gemini-3.6-flash');
  const [searchGrounding, setSearchGrounding] = useState(false);
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isExpanded, setIsExpanded] = useState(false);

  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      scrollToBottom();
    }
  }, [messages, isOpen]);

  const handleCopy = (id: string, text: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedId(id);
    soundManager.playClick();
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleClearHistory = () => {
    setMessages([
      {
        id: `msg-${Date.now()}`,
        role: 'assistant',
        content: 'Chat session cleared. How can Gemini assist you next?',
        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
        model: selectedModel
      }
    ]);
    soundManager.playMenuClose();
  };

  const handleSendMessage = async (textToSend?: string) => {
    const promptText = (textToSend || inputPrompt).trim();
    if (!promptText || isLoading) return;

    soundManager.playMessageSent();

    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: `user-${Date.now()}`,
      role: 'user',
      content: promptText,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
    };

    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMsg]);
    if (!textToSend) setInputPrompt('');
    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      // Simulate/call Gemini response with high fidelity
      let aiResponseText = '';
      const lower = promptText.toLowerCase();

      if (lower.includes('workflow') || lower.includes('node') || lower.includes('pipeline')) {
        aiResponseText = `**Gemini AI Workflow Recommendation:**\n\nYou can use our new **Visual Node-based Workflow Builder** to connect Gemini 2.5 Flash with custom agents and Pinecone vector stores.\n\nKey advantages:\n- Real-time execution console\n- Multi-agent orchestrations\n- Automatic token tracking`;
        if (onNavigate) {
          setTimeout(() => onNavigate('dashboard', 'workflow-builder'), 1500);
        }
      } else if (lower.includes('code') || lower.includes('typescript') || lower.includes('react')) {
        aiResponseText = `Here is an optimized React hook for state management with sound effects:\n\`\`\`typescript\nimport { useState, useCallback } from 'react';\nimport { soundManager } from './utils/sound';\n\nexport function useSoundState<T>(initialValue: T) {\n  const [state, setState] = useState<T>(initialValue);\n  const setSoundState = useCallback((val: T) => {\n    soundManager.playClick();\n    setState(val);\n  }, []);\n  return [state, setSoundState] as const;\n}\n\`\`\``;
      } else if (lower.includes('search') || lower.includes('grounding') || searchGrounding) {
        aiResponseText = `**Google Search Grounded Result:**\n\nAccording to real-time search data, **Gemini 3.6 Flash** and **Gemini 3.1 Pro** provide state-of-the-art multimodal reasoning, zero-latency streaming, and built-in search grounding tools.`;
      } else if (lower.includes('hi') || lower.includes('hello') || lower.includes('hey')) {
        aiResponseText = `Hello! I'm your dedicated Gemini AI Assistant. Ask me anything about building AI agents, writing code, or running multi-model sandboxes!`;
      } else {
        aiResponseText = `**Gemini 3.6 Response:**\n\nRegarding "${promptText}": KRONEX AI platform enables high-density cognitive processing, autonomous agent loops, and seamless tool execution with sub-50ms response times.`;
      }

      setTimeout(() => {
        soundManager.playMessageReceived();
        const assistantMsg: ChatMessage = {
          id: `ai-${Date.now()}`,
          role: 'assistant',
          content: aiResponseText,
          timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
          model: selectedModel,
          isGrounding: searchGrounding
        };
        setMessages((prev) => [...prev, assistantMsg]);
        setIsLoading(false);
      }, 900);

    } catch (error) {
      setIsLoading(false);
      const errorMsg: ChatMessage = {
        id: `err-${Date.now()}`,
        role: 'assistant',
        content: 'I encountered a temporary connection glitch. Please retry your request.',
        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
        model: selectedModel
      };
      setMessages((prev) => [...prev, errorMsg]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      {/* Expanded Floating Gemini Chat Widget */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isOpen && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.85, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.85, y: 20 }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 300 }}
            className={`fixed bottom-24 right-6 z-50 ${
              isExpanded ? 'w-[90vw] sm:w-[600px] h-[650px]' : 'w-88 sm:w-[420px] h-[520px]'
            } bg-[#0B0F19]/95 border border-[#7C5CFF]/40 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-[0_20px_60px_rgba(124,92,255,0.25)] backdrop-blur-2xl flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300`}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-white/10 shrink-0">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] p-[1px] flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,212,255,0.4)]">
                  <div className="w-full h-full bg-[#0B0F19] rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center">
                    <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00D4FF] animate-pulse" />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Gemini AI Chatbot</h3>
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#7C5CFF]/20 border border-[#7C5CFF]/40 text-[#00D4FF] text-[9px] font-mono font-bold">
                      PRO
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8] font-mono">Multi-turn Cognitive Assistant</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                <button
                  onClick={handleClearHistory}
                  title="Clear Chat"
                  className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={() => setIsExpanded(!isExpanded)}
                  title={isExpanded ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'}
                  className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {isExpanded ? <Minimize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Maximize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={onToggle}
                  title="Close Gemini Chat"
                  className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Model & Search Bar Settings */}
            <div className="py-2 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono shrink-0 border-b border-white/[0.05]">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                <Cpu className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00D4FF]" />
                <select
                  value={selectedModel}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedModel(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-[#131A2E] text-[#F8FAFC] border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#00D4FF] text-[10px]"
                >
                  <option value="gemini-3.6-flash">Gemini 3.6 Flash</option>
                  <option value="gemini-3.1-pro-preview">Gemini 3.1 Pro</option>
                  <option value="gemini-3.1-flash-lite">Gemini 3.1 Lite</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={() => setSearchGrounding(!searchGrounding)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border font-bold flex items-center space-x-1 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  searchGrounding
                    ? 'bg-[#00D4FF]/20 border-[#00D4FF] text-[#00D4FF]'
                    : 'bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <Globe className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Search: {searchGrounding ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Chat Messages Body */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar my-2 space-y-3 pr-1 text-xs">
              {messages.map((msg) => (
                <div
                  key={msg.id}
                  className={`flex items-start space-x-2.5 ${
                    msg.role === 'user' ? 'flex-row-reverse space-x-reverse' : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  <div
                    className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border ${
                      msg.role === 'user'
                        ? 'bg-[#7C5CFF]/20 border-[#7C5CFF]/40 text-[#7C5CFF]'
                        : 'bg-[#00D4FF]/20 border-[#00D4FF]/40 text-[#00D4FF]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {msg.role === 'user' ? <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Bot className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                  </div>

                  <div
                    className={`max-w-[82%] p-3 rounded-2xl relative group ${
                      msg.role === 'user'
                        ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#6366F1] text-white font-medium rounded-tr-xs'
                        : 'bg-[#131A2E]/90 border border-white/[0.08] text-[#F8FAFC] rounded-tl-xs'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
                      {msg.content}
                    </div>

                    <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[9px] text-white/50 font-mono">
                      <span>{msg.timestamp}</span>
                      {msg.role === 'assistant' && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleCopy(msg.id, msg.content)}
                          className="p-1 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                          title="Copy response"
                        >
                          {copiedId === msg.id ? (
                            <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                          ) : (
                            <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />
                          )}
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}

              {isLoading && (
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-[#00D4FF] text-xs font-mono p-2">
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Gemini is thinking...</span>
                </div>
              )}
              <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
            </div>

            {/* Quick Prompt Chips */}
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 overflow-x-auto custom-scrollbar pb-2 shrink-0">
              {PROMPT_SUGGESTIONS.map((chip) => (
                <button
                  key={chip}
                  onClick={() => handleSendMessage(chip.replace(/^[^\w\s]+/, '').trim())}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 text-[10px] font-mono text-[#CBD5E1] whitespace-nowrap transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                >
                  {chip}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Input Bar */}
            <form
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                handleSendMessage();
              }}
              className="relative shrink-0 flex items-center bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-1.5 focus-within:border-[#00D4FF] transition-all"
            >
              <input
                type="text"
                value={inputPrompt}
                onChange={(e) => setInputPrompt(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ask Gemini AI anything..."
                className="flex-1 bg-transparent px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#94A3B8] focus:outline-none"
              />

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={!inputPrompt.trim() || isLoading}
                className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white disabled:opacity-40 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md"
              >
                <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </form>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Floating Glowing Gemini Chat Button (Side by side with Mic Icon) */}
      <motion.button
        whileHover={{ scale: 1.08 }}
        whileTap={{ scale: 0.94 }}
        onClick={() => {
          onToggle();
          soundManager.playClick();
        }}
        className={`relative w-[56px] h-[56px] rounded-2xl border shadow-xl flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer group backdrop-blur-xl ${
          isOpen
            ? 'bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] border-white/40 text-white shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,212,255,0.6)]'
            : 'bg-[#131A2E]/80 border-white/15 hover:border-[#7C5CFF]/60 text-[#F8FAFC] shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]'
        }`}
        title="Gemini AI Chatbot"
      >
        {/* Glow */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#7C5CFF]/20 to-[#00D4FF]/20 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200 pointer-events-none" />

        <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-[#00D4FF] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-200" />
        </div>

        {/* Badge indicator */}
        <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-3 w-3">
          <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-[#00D4FF] opacity-75"></span>
          <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-3 w-3 bg-[#00D4FF]"></span>
        </span>
      </motion.button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  Mic, MicOff, Volume2, VolumeX, Sparkles, Brain, Radio, Zap, 
  X, MessageSquare, Settings, Play, Square, RefreshCw, ChevronUp, ChevronDown, Heart, Activity
} from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { soundManager } from '../utils/sound';

interface FloatingVoiceAssistantProps {
  onCommandTrigger?: (command: string, tab?: string) => void;
  isDocked?: boolean;
}

export default function FloatingVoiceAssistant({ onCommandTrigger, isDocked }: FloatingVoiceAssistantProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isListening, setIsListening] = useState(false);
  const [isSpeaking, setIsSpeaking] = useState(false);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [heartListening, setHeartListening] = useState(false);
  const [heartRateBpm, setHeartRateBpm] = useState(72);
  const [statusText, setStatusText] = useState('Voice Assistant Ready • Speak Command');
  const [transcript, setTranscript] = useState('');
  const [responseMessage, setResponseMessage] = useState('Hi! I am KRONEX AI. How can I assist you today?');
  const [continuousMode, setContinuousMode] = useState(false);
  const [wakeWordEnabled, setWakeWordEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [voiceGender, setVoiceGender] = useState<'female' | 'male'>('female');
  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);
  const [waveformHeights, setWaveformHeights] = useState<number[]>([30, 60, 45, 80, 50, 90, 40, 70, 35, 85, 60, 40]);

  const recognitionRef = useRef<any>(null);

  // Cardiac heartbeat simulator for Heart Listening Mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!heartListening) return;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setHeartRateBpm(70 + Math.floor(Math.sin(Date.now() / 800) * 8 + Math.random() * 4));
      soundManager.playHeartPulse();
    }, 850);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [heartListening]);

  // Animated sound waves
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isListening && !isSpeaking) {
      setWaveformHeights([20, 25, 20, 30, 20, 25, 20, 30, 20, 25, 20, 25]);
      return;
    }

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setWaveformHeights(prev => prev.map(() => Math.floor(Math.random() * 70) + 20));
    }, 90);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isListening, isSpeaking]);

  // Speech synthesis engine with voice selection & interruption
  const speakText = (text: string) => {
    if (isMuted) return;

    if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
      utterance.rate = 1.05;
      utterance.pitch = voiceGender === 'female' ? 1.1 : 0.85;

      const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
      if (voices.length > 0) {
        let selectedVoice = null;
        if (voiceGender === 'female') {
          selectedVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.includes('en') && (v.name.includes('Samantha') || v.name.includes('Google') || v.name.includes('Female') || v.name.includes('Natural') || v.name.includes('Victoria')));
        } else {
          selectedVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.includes('en') && (v.name.includes('Daniel') || v.name.includes('Male') || v.name.includes('David') || v.name.includes('Alex')));
        }
        if (!selectedVoice) {
          selectedVoice = voices.find(v => v.lang.includes('en'));
        }
        if (selectedVoice) utterance.voice = selectedVoice;
      }

      utterance.onstart = () => {
        setIsSpeaking(true);
        setStatusText('KRONEX AI Replying...');
      };

      utterance.onend = () => {
        setIsSpeaking(false);
        setStatusText('Voice Assistant Ready');
        if (continuousMode) {
          setTimeout(() => {
            startListening();
          }, 800);
        }
      };

      utterance.onerror = () => {
        setIsSpeaking(false);
        setStatusText('Voice Assistant Ready');
      };

      window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
    } else {
      soundManager.playMessageReceived();
      setIsSpeaking(true);
      setTimeout(() => setIsSpeaking(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  const stopSpeaking = () => {
    if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    }
    setIsSpeaking(false);
  };

  // Process command
  const handleVoiceCommand = (cmdText: string) => {
    setTranscript(cmdText);
    setIsListening(false);
    setIsProcessing(true);
    setStatusText('Processing Neural Query...');
    soundManager.playThinking();

    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsProcessing(false);
      let reply = '';
      const lower = cmdText.toLowerCase();

      if (lower.includes('hi') || lower.includes('hy') || lower.includes('hello') || lower.includes('kronex') || lower.includes('who are you')) {
        reply = 'Hi! I am KRONEX AI. I can build intelligent agents, launch multi-model sandboxes, and automate workflows.';
      } else if (lower.includes('deploy') || lower.includes('agent')) {
        reply = 'Deploying Sovereign AI Agent on KRONEX Network.';
        if (onCommandTrigger) onCommandTrigger('dashboard', 'tutorials');
      } else if (lower.includes('agent') || lower.includes('bot') || lower.includes('orchestrat')) {
        reply = 'Opening KRONEX Sovereign AI Agent Platform.';
        if (onCommandTrigger) onCommandTrigger('dashboard', 'ai-agents');
      } else if (lower.includes('playground') || lower.includes('model')) {
        reply = 'Opening AI Playground workspace with 100+ AI models.';
        if (onCommandTrigger) onCommandTrigger('dashboard', 'playground');
      } else if (lower.includes('course') || lower.includes('learn')) {
        reply = 'Opening Masterclass Learning Path & Interactive Courses.';
        if (onCommandTrigger) onCommandTrigger('dashboard', 'courses');
      } else if (lower.includes('sandbox') || lower.includes('code')) {
        reply = 'Opening Interactive AI Prompting Sandbox.';
        if (onCommandTrigger) onCommandTrigger('dashboard', 'tutorials');
      } else if (lower.includes('pricing') || lower.includes('plan')) {
        reply = 'KRONEX AI offers Developer Free tier, Pro at $29/mo, and Enterprise custom tiers.';
        const pricingEl = document.getElementById('pricing');
        if (pricingEl) pricingEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      } else {
        reply = `Executed: "${cmdText}". KRONEX Neural Matrix updated.`;
      }

      setResponseMessage(reply);
      speakText(reply);
    }, 1000);
  };

  // Start listening function
  const startListening = () => {
    stopSpeaking();
    soundManager.playVoiceActivation();
    setIsListening(true);
    setStatusText('Listening... Speak now');
    setTranscript('');

    const SpeechRecognition = (window as any).SpeechRecognition || (window as any).webkitSpeechRecognition;

    if (SpeechRecognition) {
      try {
        const recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
        recognitionRef.current = recognition;
        recognition.continuous = false;
        recognition.interimResults = true;
        recognition.lang = 'en-US';

        recognition.onresult = (event: any) => {
          const currentTranscript = Array.from(event.results)
            .map((result: any) => result[0].transcript)
            .join('');
          setTranscript(currentTranscript);
        };

        recognition.onend = () => {
          setIsListening(false);
          if (transcript.trim()) {
            handleVoiceCommand(transcript);
          } else {
            setStatusText('Voice Assistant Ready');
          }
        };

        recognition.onerror = () => {
          setIsListening(false);
          setStatusText('Voice Assistant Ready');
        };

        recognition.start();
      } catch (err) {
        simulateListening();
      }
    } else {
      simulateListening();
    }
  };

  const simulateListening = () => {
    const sampleCommands = [
      'Hi, I am KRONEX AI',
      'Deploy Sovereign AI Agent',
      'Open AI Playground',
      'Show Available Courses'
    ];
    const randomCmd = sampleCommands[Math.floor(Math.random() * sampleCommands.length)];

    let charIdx = 0;
    const typeInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (charIdx <= randomCmd.length) {
        setTranscript(randomCmd.slice(0, charIdx));
        charIdx++;
      } else {
        clearInterval(typeInterval);
        setTimeout(() => {
          handleVoiceCommand(randomCmd);
        }, 400);
      }
    }, 50);
  };

  const toggleListening = () => {
    if (isListening) {
      if (recognitionRef.current) recognitionRef.current.stop();
      setIsListening(false);
      setStatusText('Voice Assistant Ready');
      soundManager.playMenuClose();
    } else if (isSpeaking) {
      stopSpeaking();
      startListening();
    } else {
      startListening();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={isDocked ? "relative flex flex-col items-end" : "fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 flex flex-col items-end"}>
      
      {/* Expanded Voice Widget Popup */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {isOpen && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.85, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.85, y: 20 }}
            className="mb-4 w-80 sm:w-96 bg-[#0B0F19]/95 border border-[#00D9FF]/40 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-[0_20px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] backdrop-blur-2xl relative overflow-hidden"
          >
            {/* Ambient Background Glow */}
            <div className={`absolute inset-0 filter blur-[60px] pointer-events-none transition-all duration-500 ${
              isListening ? 'bg-amber-500/20' : isSpeaking ? 'bg-cyan-500/20' : 'bg-purple-500/15'
            }`} />
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

export default function FuturisticBackground() {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    let animId: number;
    let particles: Array<{
      x: number;
      y: number;
      r: number;
      vx: number;
      vy: number;
      color: string;
      alpha: number;
    }> = [];

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!canvas) return;
      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    handleResize();

    // Generate high density premium neural network nodes
    const particleCount = Math.min(65, Math.floor((window.innerWidth * window.innerHeight) / 25000));
    const colors = ['rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.25)', 'rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.25)', 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15)'];

    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
        y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
        r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 1.0,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35,
        color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
        alpha: Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.2
      });
    }

    const animate = () => {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // 2. Draw Floating Particles and Connected Neural Network Lines
      particles.forEach((p, index) => {
        // Move particle
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;

        // Bounce boundaries
        if (p.x < 0 || p.x > canvas.width) p.vx *= -1;
        if (p.y < 0 || p.y > canvas.height) p.vy *= -1;

        // Draw particle node
        ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Check nearest neighbors for connecting lines
        for (let j = index + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
          const q = particles[j];
          const dist = Math.hypot(p.x - q.x, p.y - q.y);
          const maxDistance = 150;

          if (dist < maxDistance) {
            const lineAlpha = (1 - dist / maxDistance) * 0.07;
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(124, 92, 255, ${lineAlpha})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
            ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y);
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      });

      animId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    };

    animate();

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <canvas 
      ref={canvasRef} 
      className="absolute inset-0 z-0 pointer-events-none select-none overflow-hidden"
      style={{ opacity: 0.85 }}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
interface HeroProps {
  onExploreCourses: () => void;
  onLaunchPlatform: () => void;
  onLaunchVibeStudio?: () => void;
}

export default function Hero({ onExploreCourses, onLaunchPlatform }: HeroProps) {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ models: 0, devs: 0, uptime: 99.90, requests: 0 });
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  // Counter count-up effect
  useEffect(() => {
    const duration = 2000;
    const steps = 40;
    const intervalTime = duration / steps;
    let step = 0;

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      step++;
      const progress = step / steps;
      setStats({
        models: Math.min(Math.floor(100 * progress), 100),
        devs: Math.min(Math.floor(50 * progress), 50),
        uptime: parseFloat((99.90 + (0.09 * progress)).toFixed(2)),
        requests: Math.min(Math.floor(1 * progress), 1)
      });

      if (step >= steps) {
        clearInterval(timer);
      }
    }, intervalTime);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  // Neural network background particle animation
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    let animationId: number;
    let width = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || window.innerWidth);
    let height = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 800);

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!canvas) return;
      width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || window.innerWidth;
      height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 800;
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    class Particle {
      x: number;
      y: number;
      vx: number;
      vy: number;
      radius: number;

      constructor() {
        this.x = Math.random() * width;
        this.y = Math.random() * height;
        this.vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35;
        this.vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35;
        this.radius = Math.random() * 2 + 0.8;
      }

      update() {
        this.x += this.vx;
        this.y += this.vy;
        if (this.x < 0 || this.x > width) this.vx *= -1;
        if (this.y < 0 || this.y > height) this.vy *= -1;
      }

      draw() {
        if (!ctx) return;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3)';
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    const particles: Particle[] = Array.from({ length: 45 }, () => new Particle());

    const render = () => {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

      for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        particles[i].update();
        particles[i].draw();

        for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
          const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
          const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
          const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

          if (dist < 120) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
            ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(124, 58, 237, ${0.15 * (1 - dist / 120)})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        }
      }

      animationId = requestAnimationFrame(render);
    };

    render();

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
    };
  }, []);

  const featureChecklist = [
    '100+ AI Models',
    'Enterprise Security',
    'AI Agents',
    'Workflow Automation',
    'Sub-millisecond Latency',
    'Global Cloud Infrastructure'
  ];

  return (
    <section 
      id="hero" 
      className="relative min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col justify-between pt-28 md:pt-36 pb-16 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-12 overflow-hidden bg-[#050510] text-white"
    >
      {/* Background Neural Canvas */}
      <canvas 
        ref={canvasRef}
        className="absolute inset-0 z-0 pointer-events-none opacity-60"
      />

      {/* Grid Overlay */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 z-0 bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,rgba(0,212,255,0.04)_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,rgba(124,58,237,0.04)_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:3rem_3rem] pointer-events-none" />

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full relative z-10 flex-grow flex flex-col justify-center">
        
        {/* DESKTOP 2-COLUMN HERO LAYOUT */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 lg:gap-8 items-center pt-4">
          
          {/* LEFT SIDE: BADGE, HEADLINE, DESCRIPTION, CTAS & SIGNATURE */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 text-left space-y-6">
            
            {/* BADGE: "Next-Gen AI Platform" */}
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -15 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.6 }}
              className="inline-flex items-center"
            >
              <div 
                onClick={onLaunchPlatform}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-white/[0.04] border border-cyan-400/30 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,212,255,0.15)] flex items-center gap-2.5 cursor-pointer hover:border-cyan-400/60 transition-all duration-300 group"
              >
                <span className="flex h-2 w-2 relative">
                  <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-[#00D4FF] opacity-75"></span>
                  <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-[#00D4FF]"></span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-[#00D4FF] tracking-wider uppercase">
                  Next-Gen AI Platform
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs text-zinc-300 font-medium hidden sm:inline">
                  • KRONEX 2.5
                </span>
                <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00D4FF] group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
              </div>
            </motion.div>

            {/* HUGE HEADLINE */}
            <motion.h1
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.7, delay: 0.1 }}
              className="font-display font-black text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tight leading-[1.08] text-white"
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Key, ShieldCheck, Check, X, RefreshCw, Zap, Activity, 
  Trash2, Lock, Eye, EyeOff, Globe, HardDrive, Terminal
} from 'lucide-react';
import { soundManager } from '../utils/sound';

interface IntegrationConfigModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  integration: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    category: string;
    desc: string;
    icon: React.ComponentType<any>;
    color: string;
    latency: string;
  } | null;
  onSaveKey?: (id: string, apiKey: string) => void;
  onDisconnect?: (id: string) => void;
}

export default function IntegrationConfigModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  integration,
  onSaveKey,
  onDisconnect
}: IntegrationConfigModalProps) {
  const [apiKey, setApiKey] = useState('krx_sk_live_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 18));
  const [showKey, setShowKey] = useState(false);
  const [isTestingPing, setIsTestingPing] = useState(false);
  const [pingResult, setPingResult] = useState<{ status: 'idle' | 'success' | 'failed'; ms?: number }>({ status: 'idle' });
  const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen || !integration) return null;

  const Icon = integration.icon;

  const handleTestConnection = () => {
    setIsTestingPing(true);
    soundManager.playClick();
    setPingResult({ status: 'idle' });

    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsTestingPing(false);
      const pingTime = Math.floor(Math.random() * 40) + 18; // 18ms to 58ms
      setPingResult({ status: 'success', ms: pingTime });
      soundManager.playSuccess();
    }, 1000);
  };

  const handleSaveCredential = () => {
    soundManager.playClick();
    setIsSaved(true);
    if (onSaveKey) onSaveKey(integration.id, apiKey);
    soundManager.playSuccess();
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsSaved(false);
      onClose();
    }, 800);
  };

  const handleRemoveIntegration = () => {
    soundManager.playClick();
    if (onDisconnect) onDisconnect(integration.id);
    soundManager.playToggle();
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-white/[0.1] rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-5 relative overflow-hidden text-white font-sans">
        {/* Top Accent Line */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-[2px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] via-[#00D4FF] to-[#00FFA3]" />

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.08] pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center ${integration.color}`}>
              <Icon className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">{integration.name} Vault Configuration</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">{integration.category} • Encrypted Connection</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Info Box */}
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/5 text-xs text-[#94A3B8] leading-relaxed">
          {integration.desc}
        </div>

        {/* API Key Input */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[#94A3B8] flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>API Secret / OAuth Token</span>
            <span className="text-emerald-400 text-[10px]">AES-256 GCM Hardware Sealed</span>
          </label>

          <div className="relative flex items-center">
            <input
              type={showKey ? 'text' : 'password'}
              value={apiKey}
              onChange={(e) => setApiKey(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] font-mono focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none pr-10"
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowKey(!showKey)}
              className="absolute right-3 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              {showKey ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Connection Test Section */}
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="space-y-0.5">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Live Health & Ping Test</span>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8] font-mono">
              {pingResult.status === 'success'
                ? `Connection Healthy • Latency ${pingResult.ms}ms`
                : 'Click test to verify server handshake'}
            </p>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={handleTestConnection}
            disabled={isTestingPing}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-xs font-bold text-white transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-1.5"
          >
            {isTestingPing ? (
              <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#00D4FF]" />
            )}
            <span>{isTestingPing ? 'Pinging...' : 'Test Ping'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 pt-2">
          <button
            onClick={handleRemoveIntegration}
            className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 hover:bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Disconnect Integration"
          >
            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={handleSaveCredential}
            disabled={isSaved}
            className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,212,255,0.4)] transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"
          >
            {isSaved ? (
              <>
                <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                <span>Credential Saved!</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Save & Lock Credential</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
    notion: 'available',

  const [configIntegration, setConfigIntegration] = useState<Integration | null>(null);

      setToast(prev => ({ ...prev, show: false }));

      setConnections(prev => ({ ...prev, [id]: 'connecting' }));
      setActiveSyncingId(id);

        setConnections(prev => ({ ...prev, [id]: 'connected' }));
        setActiveSyncingId(null);

            className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-display font-black tracking-tight text-white mb-4"
          >
            Sovereign Ecosystem <span className="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 via-[#22D3EE] to-blue-500 drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(34,211,238,0.2)]">AI Integrations</span>
          </motion.h2>

          <motion.p
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            whileInView={{ opacity: 1 }}
            viewport={{ once: true }}

          >
            Hot-swap your active LLM, datastore, secure cloud containers, or ledger tunnels.

        </div>

        {/* ====================================================
           FEATURED PRIMARY INTEGRATION: n8n (At the top)
           ==================================================== */}
        <div className="mb-12">
          <span className="block text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-zinc-500 tracking-widest uppercase mb-4">
            FEATURED INTEGRATION
          </span>

          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }}
            whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            viewport={{ once: true }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.7 }}
            whileHover={{ 
              y: -4,
              borderColor: 'rgba(124, 92, 255, 0.4)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 60px -15px rgba(124, 92, 255, 0.2)'
            }}
            onMouseEnter={() => soundManager.playHover()}
            className="relative p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-[20px] bg-[#08080C]/85 border border-[#7C3AED]/20 backdrop-blur-2xl transition-all duration-500 group overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-8"
          >
            {/* Ambient Background Glow matching brand */}
            <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-[300px] h-[300px] bg-[#7C3AED]/10 rounded-full blur-[80px] pointer-events-none opacity-50 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500" />
            <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-[200px] h-[200px] bg-cyan-400/5 rounded-full blur-[60px] pointer-events-none opacity-35" />

            {/* Left side info */}

              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center lg:justify-start gap-4">
                {/* n8n glowing logo container */}
                <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#7C3AED]/20 to-[#22D3EE]/20 border border-[#7C3AED]/45 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg relative group-hover:scale-105 transition-all duration-300">
                  <Workflow className="w-7 h-7 text-[#22D3EE] group-hover:rotate-12 transition-transform duration-500" />
                </div>
                
                <div className="text-center sm:text-left">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center sm:justify-start gap-2.5">
                    <h3 className="font-display font-black text-2xl text-white tracking-wide">
                      n8n
                    </h3>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-[#7C3AED]/15 border border-[#7C3AED]/35 text-[#22D3EE]">
                      v1.0 Ready
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block mt-1">
                    Workflow Automation & Orchestrator
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <p className="text-zinc-300 text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed max-w-2xl font-sans font-medium">
                Automate workflows visually with n8n and connect KRONEX AI to hundreds of apps.
              </p>

              {/* Status and telemetry bar */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center lg:justify-start gap-4 pt-2">
                {connections.n8n === 'connected' ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(52,211,153,0.8)] animate-pulse" />
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Connected ✓
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ) : connections.n8n === 'connecting' ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl">
                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400 animate-spin" />
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Establishing link...
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ) : (

                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-zinc-500" />
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Available (Disconnected)
                    </span>

                  <span>PIPELINE CAPACITY: 200/sec</span>
                </div>

                  <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />
                  <span>SYNCED EVENTS: {syncCount}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Right side Actions (Connect/Configure button) */}
            <div className="relative z-10 shrink-0 w-full lg:w-auto flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-4">
              {connections.n8n === 'connected' ? (
                <>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleConnectToggle('n8n', 'n8n')}
                    className="w-full sm:w-auto px-6 py-3.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 hover:border-red-500/30 hover:bg-red-500/10 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-zinc-400 hover:text-red-400 transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Disconnect
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      soundManager.playClick();
                      setSyncCount(prev => prev + 12);
                      triggerToast('Sovereign pipeline configurations synced successfully!', 'success');
                    }}
                    className="w-full sm:w-auto px-6 py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C3AED] to-[#22D3EE] text-white font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.25)] hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 cursor-pointer shadow-lg"
                  >
                    <Settings className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin-slow" />
                    <span>Sync Pipeline</span>
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleConnectToggle('n8n', 'n8n')}
                  disabled={connections.n8n === 'connecting'}
                  className="w-full sm:w-auto px-8 py-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C3AED] to-[#22D3EE] text-white font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(34,211,238,0.35)] hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all duration-300 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 cursor-pointer shadow-lg disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {connections.n8n === 'connecting' ? (
                    <>
                      <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-white" />
                      <span>Linking n8n...</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <span>Connect n8n</span>
                      <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </div>

        {/* ====================================================
           ECOSYSTEM GRID (Other 12 integrations below n8n)
           ==================================================== */}
        <div className="mb-4">
          <span className="block text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-zinc-500 tracking-widest uppercase mb-6">
            ECOSYSTEM SERVICE PIPELINES ({integrations.length} AVAILABLE)
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Integrations Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          {integrations.map((item, index) => {
            const Icon = item.icon;
            const status = connections[item.id];
            
            return (
              <motion.div
                key={item.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
                whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                viewport={{ once: true }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.5, delay: index * 0.04 }}
                whileHover={{ 
                  y: -6, 
                  scale: 1.02,
                  borderColor: 'rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.45)',
                  boxShadow: `0 15px 40px -10px ${item.glowColor}`
                }}
                onMouseEnter={() => soundManager.playHover()}
                className="p-5 rounded-[20px] bg-[#08080C]/85 border border-white/[0.08] backdrop-blur-2xl transition-all duration-300 group flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden min-h-[220px]"
              >
                {/* Internal card particle spark effect */}
                <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-20 h-20 bg-gradient-to-br from-white/5 to-transparent rounded-full blur-xl pointer-events-none opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />

                <div className="space-y-3 relative z-10">
                  {/* Top line with Icon and status indicator */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className={`p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-center group-hover:border-cyan-400/30 transition-colors`}>
                      <Icon className={`w-5.5 h-5.5 ${item.color} transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-110`} />
                    </div>

                    {status === 'connected' ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg">
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(52,211,153,0.8)] animate-pulse" />
                        <span className="text-[8px] font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Connected
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    ) : status === 'connecting' ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg">
                        <Loader2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-amber-400 animate-spin" />
                        <span className="text-[8px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Linking
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 bg-zinc-500/5 border border-white/5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg">
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-600" />
                        <span className="text-[8px] font-mono font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          Available
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Name & Category */}
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm text-white tracking-wide group-hover:text-[#22D3EE] transition-colors">
                      {item.name}
                    </h3>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-zinc-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block">
                        {item.category}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[8px] font-mono font-bold text-[#22D3EE] bg-white/5 px-1.5 py-0.1 rounded">
                        {item.latency}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Description */}
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-sans leading-relaxed line-clamp-2">
                    {item.desc}
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Bottom line: Connect & Configure Buttons */}
                <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-white/[0.05] relative z-10 flex items-center space-x-2">
                  {status === 'connected' ? (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleConnectToggle(item.id, item.name)}
                      className="flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 hover:border-red-500/30 hover:bg-red-500/10 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-zinc-400 hover:text-red-400 transition-all cursor-pointer text-center"
                    >
                      Disconnect
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleConnectToggle(item.id, item.name)}
                      disabled={status === 'connecting'}
                      className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C3AED] to-[#22D3EE] text-white hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(34,211,238,0.25)] font-display font-black text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer text-center flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-sm disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                      {status === 'connecting' ? (
                        <>
                          <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin text-white" />
                          <span>Connecting...</span>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <span>One-Click Connect</span>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  )}

                  <button
                    onClick={() => { soundManager.playClick(); setConfigIntegration(item); }}
                    className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    title="Configure API Vault & Ping"
                  >
                    <Settings className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Integration Vault Configuration Modal */}
      <IntegrationConfigModal
        isOpen={!!configIntegration}
        onClose={() => setConfigIntegration(null)}
        integration={configIntegration}
        onSaveKey={(id) => {
          setConnections((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: 'connected' }));
          triggerToast(`Saved encrypted API token for ${configIntegration?.name}`, 'success');
        }}
        onDisconnect={(id) => {
          setConnections((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: 'available' }));
          triggerToast(`Disconnected ${configIntegration?.name}`, 'info');
        }}
      />

      {/* Floating interactive toast notifications */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {toast.show && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 50, scale: 0.95 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, scale: 0.95 }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 350, damping: 25 }}
            className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-55 flex items-center space-x-3 p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#09090D]/95 border border-[#7C3AED]/30 shadow-[0_20px_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] backdrop-blur-md"
          >
            <div className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg ${toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20' : 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20'}`}>
              <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div className="font-sans">
              <span className="block text-xs font-bold text-white leading-none">
                {toast.message}
              </span>
              <span className="block text-[9px] font-mono text-zinc-500 mt-1 uppercase tracking-wider">
                SYSTEM STATUS: ACTIVE
              </span>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { COURSES } from '../data';
import { Course, UserProgress } from '../types';
import { Search, Star, BookOpen, Clock, Users, ArrowRight, Check, Sparkles, Code2, GraduationCap } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';

interface InteractiveCoursesProps {
  progress: UserProgress;
  onUpdateProgress: (newProgress: Partial<UserProgress>) => void;
}

export default function InteractiveCourses({ progress, onUpdateProgress }: InteractiveCoursesProps) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<string>('All');
  const [expandedCourseId, setExpandedCourseId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hoveredCourseId, setHoveredCourseId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const categories = ['All', 'Prompting', 'Python', 'JavaScript', 'Design', 'Business'];

  const filteredCourses = COURSES.filter(course => {
    const matchesSearch = course.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || 
                          course.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'All' || course.category === activeCategory;
    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
  });

  const handleEnroll = (courseId: string) => {
    if (progress.registeredCourses.includes(courseId)) return;
    
    const updatedCourses = [...progress.registeredCourses, courseId];
    // Award 50 XP for starting a new path
    onUpdateProgress({
      registeredCourses: updatedCourses,
      xp: progress.xp + 50,
      level: Math.floor((progress.xp + 50) / 300) + 1
    });
  };

  return (
    <div id="interactive-courses-panel" className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12">
      
      {/* Search and Category Filter Section with High-End Glass Backing */}
      <div className="mb-12 p-8 rounded-3xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-6 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-64 h-64 bg-brand-primary/15 rounded-full blur-[80px] pointer-events-none" />
        
        <div className="relative z-10">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-brand-secondary uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">
            <GraduationCap className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-accent animate-pulse" />
            <span>EXPERT-CURATED WORKSPACES</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-black text-3xl sm:text-4xl text-white tracking-tight">Interactive Training Blueprints</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-white/60 font-sans mt-1.5 max-w-xl leading-relaxed">
            Choose a path, unlock secure sandboxes, and compile functional code blocks live. Earn gold certifications recognized worldwide.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Search */}
        <div className="relative w-full md:w-80 shrink-0 z-10">
          <Search className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4.5 h-4.5 text-white/40" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search AI models, python, UI/UX..."
            className="w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-brand-primary/10 transition-all font-sans placeholder-white/30"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Category Pills */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2.5 mb-12">
        {categories.map((category) => (
          <button
            key={category}
            onClick={() => setActiveCategory(category)}
            className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold tracking-wider font-display transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeCategory === category
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-brand-primary to-brand-accent text-white shadow-lg shadow-brand-primary/20 scale-[1.02]'
                : 'bg-white/5 text-white/65 border border-white/10 hover:border-brand-primary/30 hover:bg-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            {category}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Courses Grid with Spring-Loaded Hover Elevations */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        {filteredCourses.map((course) => {
          const isEnrolled = progress.registeredCourses.includes(course.id);
          const isExpanded = expandedCourseId === course.id;
          const isHovered = hoveredCourseId === course.id;

          return (
            <div
              key={course.id}
              onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredCourseId(course.id)}
              onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredCourseId(null)}
              className="bg-white/[0.03] rounded-3xl border border-white/10 transition-all duration-300 overflow-hidden flex flex-col relative group"
              style={{
                transform: isHovered ? 'translateY(-6px) scale(1.01)' : 'translateY(0px) scale(1)',
                boxShadow: isHovered ? '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(123, 47, 247, 0.15)' : 'none',
                borderColor: isHovered ? 'rgba(123, 47, 247, 0.3)' : 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
              }}
            >
              {/* Card Header Image with Glowing Accent Overlays */}
              <div className="h-48 overflow-hidden relative">
                <img
                  src={course.image}
                  alt={course.title}
                  loading="lazy"
                  referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-700"
                />
                
                {/* Decorative radial lens flare */}
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-slate-950 via-slate-950/20 to-transparent opacity-90" />
                
                <span className="absolute top-4 right-4 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md text-[9px] font-bold font-mono text-brand-secondary border border-brand-secondary/20 uppercase tracking-widest">
                  {course.category}
                </span>

                {/* Floating Level Indicator Badge */}
                <span className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-brand-primary text-white text-[9px] font-mono font-bold tracking-wider">
                  {course.difficulty}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Card Body */}
              <div className="p-6 flex-grow flex flex-col space-y-4">
                
                {/* Meta Row */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-white/50">
                  <span className="flex items-center space-x-1">
                    <Star className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current text-amber-400" />
                    <span className="text-white font-display">{course.rating}</span>
                    <span>(2.4k reviews)</span>
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-brand-accent-secondary">CERTIFICATION LEVEL</span>
                </div>

                <h3 className="font-display font-black text-xl text-white leading-tight group-hover:text-brand-secondary transition-colors">
                  {course.title}
                </h3>

                <p className="text-xs text-white/60 font-sans leading-relaxed">
                  {course.description}
                </p>

                {/* Info Pills */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 py-3 border-y border-white/10 text-[10px] font-mono text-white/60 font-bold bg-white/5 rounded-xl px-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 justify-center">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-secondary shrink-0" />
                    <span>{course.duration}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 justify-center border-x border-white/10">
                    <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-secondary shrink-0" />
                    <span>{course.students}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 justify-center">
                    <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-secondary shrink-0" />
                    <span>{course.curriculum.length} units</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Curriculum Dropdown Trigger with Lucide Icon Rotation */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => setExpandedCourseId(isExpanded ? null : course.id)}
                  className="w-full py-1 text-center text-xs font-bold text-brand-secondary hover:text-brand-accent transition-colors flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5"
                >
                  <Code2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-secondary" />
                  <span>{isExpanded ? 'Hide Course Curriculum' : 'View Core Curriculum Units'}</span>
                </button>

                {/* Expanded Curriculum List */}
                <AnimatePresence>
                  {isExpanded && (
                    <motion.div
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                      exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                      className="pt-2 border-t border-white/10 space-y-2 text-xs font-sans text-white/60 overflow-hidden"
                    >
                      <p className="font-mono font-bold text-[9px] tracking-widest text-white/40 uppercase">Interactive Chapters Required:</p>
                      {course.curriculum.map((item, idx) => (
                        <div key={idx} className="flex items-start space-x-2 bg-white/5 p-2 rounded-lg border border-white/5">
                          <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
                          <span className="font-medium text-white/80 text-[11px]">{item}</span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </motion.div>
                  )}
                </AnimatePresence>

              </div>

              {/* Card Footer Button with interactive status changes */}
              <div className="px-6 pb-6 pt-0">
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleEnroll(course.id)}
                  className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl font-display font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    isEnrolled
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 font-bold shadow-sm cursor-default'
                      : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-brand-primary via-brand-secondary to-brand-accent text-white hover:opacity-95 shadow-lg shadow-brand-primary/20 hover:scale-[1.01]'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isEnrolled ? (
                    <>
                      <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                      <span>Workspace Loaded & Ready</span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-accent animate-pulse" />
                      <span>Unlock Interactive Path (+50 XP)</span>
                      <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 transform group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
                    </>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>

            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
interface KeyboardShortcutsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;

export default function KeyboardShortcutsModal({ isOpen, onClose }: KeyboardShortcutsModalProps) {
```
