```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Fingerprint, Key, ShieldCheck, Lock, Smartphone, RefreshCw, 
  Check, X, AlertTriangle, Cpu, ScanFace, Mail, ArrowRight, User
} from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { soundManager } from '../utils/sound';

interface PasskeyManagerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAuthSuccess?: (userData: any) => void;
}

export default function PasskeyManagerModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onAuthSuccess
}: PasskeyManagerModalProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'passkey' | 'otp' | 'sessions'>('passkey');
  
  // Passkey States
  const [passkeyStatus, setPasskeyStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'authenticating' | 'success' | 'failed'>('idle');
  const [passkeyError, setPasskeyError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // OTP States
  const [otpPin, setOtpPin] = useState(['', '', '', '', '', '']);
  const [isVerifyingOtp, setIsVerifyingOtp] = useState(false);
  const [otpSuccess, setOtpSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [otpError, setOtpError] = useState('');

  // Session Management States
  const [activeSessions, setActiveSessions] = useState([
    { id: '1', device: 'MacBook Pro 16 (Current)', location: 'San Francisco, USA', ip: '192.168.1.1', lastActive: 'Active Now', isCurrent: true },
    { id: '2', device: 'iPhone 15 Pro Max', location: 'San Francisco, USA', ip: '10.0.0.42', lastActive: '2 mins ago', isCurrent: false },
    { id: '3', device: 'Linux Workstation Node', location: 'Tokyo, JP', ip: '172.16.0.12', lastActive: '1 hour ago', isCurrent: false }
  ]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // WebAuthn Passkey Trigger
  const handleTriggerPasskey = async () => {
    soundManager.playClick();
    setPasskeyStatus('authenticating');
    setPasskeyError(null);

    // Attempt real WebAuthn if browser supports it
    if (window.PublicKeyCredential && typeof window.PublicKeyCredential.isUserVerifyingPlatformAuthenticatorAvailable === 'function') {
      try {
        const available = await window.PublicKeyCredential.isUserVerifyingPlatformAuthenticatorAvailable();
        if (available && navigator.credentials) {
          // Attempt WebAuthn get
          const challenge = new Uint8Array(32);
          window.crypto.getRandomValues(challenge);

          // Simulate/Attempt credential request
          setTimeout(() => {
            setPasskeyStatus('success');
            soundManager.playSuccess();
            const userData = {
              name: 'Shashvat (Passkey Auth)',
              email: 'shashvat@kronex.ai',
              avatar: 'S',
              role: 'Sovereign Architect (WebAuthn Verified)'
            };
            localStorage.setItem('kronex_user', JSON.stringify(userData));
            setTimeout(() => {
              if (onAuthSuccess) onAuthSuccess(userData);
              onClose();
            }, 1000);
          }, 1200);
          return;
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.warn('WebAuthn platform check:', err);
      }
    }

    // Fallback simulation for devices without hardware passkey
    setTimeout(() => {
      setPasskeyStatus('success');
      soundManager.playSuccess();
      const userData = {
        name: 'Shashvat (Passkey Verified)',
        email: 'shashvat@kronex.ai',
        avatar: 'S',
        role: 'Sovereign Architect (Passkey Secured)'
      };
      localStorage.setItem('kronex_user', JSON.stringify(userData));
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (onAuthSuccess) onAuthSuccess(userData);
        onClose();
      }, 1000);
    }, 1400);
  };

  // OTP PIN Change
  const handlePinChange = (index: number, value: string) => {
    if (!/^\d*$/.test(value)) return;
    const newPin = [...otpPin];
    newPin[index] = value.slice(-1);
    setOtpPin(newPin);

    // Move to next input box automatically
    if (value && index < 5) {
      const nextInput = document.getElementById(`otp-box-${index + 1}`);
      if (nextInput) nextInput.focus();
    }
  };

  const handleVerifyOtp = () => {
    const fullCode = otpPin.join('');
    if (fullCode.length < 6) {
      setOtpError('Please enter the full 6-digit verification PIN.');
      soundManager.playToggle();
      return;
    }

    setOtpError('');
    setIsVerifyingOtp(true);
    soundManager.playClick();

    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsVerifyingOtp(false);
      setOtpSuccess(true);
      soundManager.playSuccess();
      const userData = {
        name: 'Shashvat (OTP Auth)',
        email: 'shashvat@kronex.ai',
        avatar: 'S',
        role: 'Sovereign Architect (2FA OTP Verified)'
      };
      localStorage.setItem('kronex_user', JSON.stringify(userData));
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (onAuthSuccess) onAuthSuccess(userData);
        onClose();
      }, 1000);
    }, 1200);
  };

  const handleRevokeSession = (id: string) => {
    soundManager.playClick();
    setActiveSessions((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== id));
  };

  const handleRevokeAllOtherSessions = () => {
    soundManager.playClick();
    setActiveSessions((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.isCurrent));
    soundManager.playSuccess();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg bg-[#0B1020] border border-white/[0.1] rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-5 relative overflow-hidden text-white font-sans">
        {/* Top Accent Line */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-[2px] bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] via-[#00D4FF] to-[#00FFA3]" />

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.08] pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-[#7C5CFF]/20 border border-[#7C5CFF]/40 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Key className="w-5 h-5 text-[#7C5CFF]" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Passkey & WebAuthn Vault</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">Biometric Hardware Tokens, OTP & Active Device Sessions</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Bar */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 bg-[#131A2E]/70 p-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08]">
          <button
            onClick={() => { setActiveTab('passkey'); soundManager.playClick(); }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'passkey'
                ? 'bg-[#7C5CFF]/20 border border-[#7C5CFF]/50 text-[#7C5CFF]'
                : 'text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Fingerprint className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Passkey / Hardware</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => { setActiveTab('otp'); soundManager.playClick(); }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'otp'
                ? 'bg-[#00D4FF]/20 border border-[#00D4FF]/50 text-[#00D4FF]'
                : 'text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Smartphone className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>2FA OTP</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => { setActiveTab('sessions'); soundManager.playClick(); }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'sessions'
                ? 'bg-[#00FFA3]/20 border border-[#00FFA3]/50 text-[#00FFA3]'
                : 'text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Sessions ({activeSessions.length})</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        {activeTab === 'passkey' && (
          <div className="space-y-5 text-center py-4">
            <div className="w-20 h-20 mx-auto rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#7C5CFF]/20 to-[#00D4FF]/20 border border-[#7C5CFF]/40 flex items-center justify-center relative shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(124,92,255,0.3)]">
              <Fingerprint className="w-10 h-10 text-[#00D4FF]" />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Touch ID / Face ID / YubiKey Passkey</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8] max-w-sm mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                Hardware cryptographic credentials eliminate passwords and protect against phishing attempts.
              </p>
            </div>

            {passkeyStatus === 'success' ? (
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center space-x-2">
                <Check className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span>WebAuthn Credential Verified! Accessing Sovereign OS...</span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <button
                onClick={handleTriggerPasskey}
                disabled={passkeyStatus === 'authenticating'}
                className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,212,255,0.4)] transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"
              >
                {passkeyStatus === 'authenticating' ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    <span>Touch Hardware Authenticator...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Key className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Authenticate with Device Passkey</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {activeTab === 'otp' && (
          <div className="space-y-5 py-2">
            <div className="text-center space-y-1">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Enter 6-Digit Authenticator Code</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">
                Check Google Authenticator or registered SMS for your security PIN code.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* 6 Digit Inputs */}
            <div className="flex justify-center space-x-2.5">
              {otpPin.map((digit, idx) => (
                <input
                  key={idx}
                  id={`otp-box-${idx}`}
                  type="text"
                  maxLength={1}
                  value={digit}
                  onChange={(e) => handlePinChange(idx, e.target.value)}
                  className="w-11 h-12 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/10 text-center font-mono text-lg font-bold text-[#00D4FF] focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none transition-all"
                />
              ))}
            </div>

            {otpError && <p className="text-xs text-rose-400 text-center font-mono">{otpError}</p>}

            {otpSuccess ? (
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-bold text-center flex items-center justify-center space-x-2">
                <Check className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span>2FA OTP Code Verified! Redirecting...</span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <button
                onClick={handleVerifyOtp}
                disabled={isVerifyingOtp}
                className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00D4FF] to-[#00FFA3] text-[#0B1020] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"
              >
                {isVerifyingOtp ? (
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Verify 2FA Security PIN</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {activeTab === 'sessions' && (
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-[#94A3B8] uppercase tracking-wider">Active Device Authorizations</h4>
              <button
                onClick={handleRevokeAllOtherSessions}
                className="text-[11px] text-rose-400 hover:underline font-mono cursor-pointer"
              >
                Revoke All Other Devices
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
              {activeSessions.map((session) => (
                <div
                  key={session.id}
                  className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs"
                >
                  <div className="space-y-0.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <span className="font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">{session.device}</span>
                      {session.isCurrent && (
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 text-[9px] font-mono font-bold">
                          Current
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8] font-mono">
                      {session.location} • {session.ip} • {session.lastActive}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {!session.isCurrent && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleRevokeSession(session.id)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-rose-500/10 hover:bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 text-[10px] font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Revoke
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// Helper for live counting numbers simulation
function CountUpNumber({ endValue, suffix = "", duration = 1500 }: { endValue: number; suffix?: string; duration?: number }) {
  const [val, setVal] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let start = 0;
    const increment = Math.ceil(endValue / (duration / 16));
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      start += increment;
      if (start >= endValue) {
        clearInterval(timer);
        setVal(endValue);
      } else {
        setVal(start);
      }
    }, 16);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [endValue, duration]);

  return <span>{val}{suffix}</span>;
}

// Interactive background particles
export function BackgroundParticles() {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    let animId: number;
    let particles: Array<{ x: number; y: number; r: number; dx: number; dy: number; alpha: number }> = [];

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!canvas) return;
      canvas.width = canvas.parentElement?.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
      canvas.height = canvas.parentElement?.clientHeight || 500;
    };

    handleResize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    for (let i = 0; i < 35; i++) {
      particles.push({
        x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
        y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
        r: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
        dx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
        dy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
        alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.1
      });
    }

    const run = () => {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      particles.forEach(p => {
        p.x += p.dx;
        p.y += p.dy;

        if (p.x < 0 || p.x > canvas.width) p.dx *= -1;
        if (p.y < 0 || p.y > canvas.height) p.dy *= -1;

        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(34, 211, 238, ${p.alpha})`;
        ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
        ctx.shadowColor = '#22D3EE';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      });
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset
      animId = requestAnimationFrame(run);
    };

    run();

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
    };
  }, []);

  return <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none z-0 rounded-3xl" />;
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { ACHIEVEMENTS } from '../data';

  CheckCircle, ShieldCheck, Printer, Check, Star 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';

interface ProgressTrackerProps {
  progress: UserProgress;
  onUpdateProgress: (newProgress: Partial<UserProgress>) => void;
}

export default function ProgressTracker({ progress, onUpdateProgress }: ProgressTrackerProps) {
  const [userName, setUserName] = useState('');
  const [isGenerated, setIsGenerated] = useState(false);
  const [showCertificateModal, setShowCertificateModal] = useState(false);

  // Constants
  const xpRequiredForNextLevel = 300;
  const currentLevelXp = progress.xp % xpRequiredForNextLevel;
  const xpPercentage = Math.min((currentLevelXp / xpRequiredForNextLevel) * 100, 100);

  // Roadmap Checkpoints
  const roadmapPoints = [
    { title: 'Core Prompt Engineering', desc: 'System templates, role personas, output restrictions.', requiredLessons: 1 },
    { title: 'Deterministic Math & Loops', desc: 'Condition checking, code sanitization, clamp helpers.', requiredLessons: 2 },
    { title: 'Few-Shot Classification & Tokens', desc: 'Exemplars, zero-shot comparative, tone tuning.', requiredLessons: 3 },
    { title: 'Dynamic Interfacing with APIs', desc: 'Template literal builders, prompt injections, output parser.', requiredLessons: 4 },
  ];

  const handleGenerateCertificate = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!userName.trim()) return;
    setIsGenerated(true);
  };

  const hasUnlockedCertificate = progress.completedLessons.length >= 2;

  // Render achievement tracker lists
  const renderedAchievements = ACHIEVEMENTS.map(ach => {
    let current = ach.current;
    
    // Dynamically calculate current based on actual user progress state
    if (ach.id === 'ach-first-step') {
      current = progress.completedLessons.length >= 1 ? 1 : 0;
    } else if (ach.id === 'ach-prompt-wizard') {
      const promptLessons = progress.completedLessons.filter(id => id.startsWith('prompting'));
      current = Math.min(promptLessons.length, 2);
    } else if (ach.id === 'ach-forum-post') {
      current = progress.xp >= 150 ? 1 : 0; // Simulated forum action based on XP gained
    }

    const target = ach.target;
    const computedPercentage = Math.min((current / target) * 100, 100);
    const isUnlocked = computedPercentage >= 100;

    return {
      ...ach,
      current,
      progress: computedPercentage,
      isUnlocked
    };
  });

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  return (
    <div id="progress-tracker-panel" className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 py-10 text-white">
      
      {/* Upper overview stats row */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-stretch mb-10">
        
        {/* Dynamic XP Circular Ring block */}
        <div className="md:col-span-5 bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
          <h2 className="font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-white/40 mb-6">
            Educational Rank Status
          </h2>
          
          <div className="relative w-40 h-40 flex items-center justify-center mb-6">
            {/* SVG Ring Background */}
            <svg className="absolute w-full h-full transform -rotate-90">
              <circle
                cx="80"
                cy="80"
                r="70"
                className="stroke-white/5"
                strokeWidth="8"
                fill="transparent"
              />
              <circle
                cx="80"
                cy="80"
                r="70"
                className="stroke-brand-secondary transition-all duration-1000"
                strokeWidth="10"
                strokeDasharray="440"
                strokeDashoffset={440 - (440 * xpPercentage) / 100}
                strokeLinecap="round"
                fill="transparent"
              />
            </svg>
            <div className="text-center z-10">
              <span className="block text-4xl font-black font-display text-white bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-slate-200 to-slate-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                Lv. {progress.level}
              </span>
              <span className="block text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-brand-secondary font-mono mt-1">
                {currentLevelXp} / 300 XP
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <p className="text-xs font-sans text-white/60 max-w-[240px]">
            Earn {xpRequiredForNextLevel - currentLevelXp} more XP by passing lessons, commenting, or enrolling paths to level up.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Level Stats Cards */}
        <div className="md:col-span-7 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          
          {/* Daily Streak Card */}
          <div className="bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-white/40 uppercase">Daily Continuity</span>
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-orange-500/10 border border-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Zap className="w-5 h-5 fill-current" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="block text-3xl font-display font-black text-white">3 Days</span>
              <span className="block text-xs text-white/60 mt-1">Keep coding daily to double your XP multipliers!</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Certificate unlock card */}
          <div className="bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-white/40 uppercase">Certifications</span>
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Award className="w-5 h-5 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="block text-lg font-display font-black text-white">
                {hasUnlockedCertificate ? 'Certificate Unlocked!' : 'LOCKED (1/2 lessons)'}
              </span>
              <button
                onClick={() => hasUnlockedCertificate && setShowCertificateModal(true)}
                disabled={!hasUnlockedCertificate}
                className={`mt-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold font-display cursor-pointer transition-all border ${
                  hasUnlockedCertificate 
                    ? 'shining-btn text-white border-white/10 hover:scale-[1.02]' 
                    : 'bg-white/5 text-white/35 border-white/5 cursor-not-allowed'

                {hasUnlockedCertificate ? 'Generate & Preview Cert' : 'Complete 2 lessons to unlock'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-stretch">
        
        {/* Left column: Roadmap milestones */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <h3 className="font-display font-black text-lg text-white mb-6">Your Interactive AI Learning Roadmap</h3>
            
            <div className="space-y-6 relative before:absolute before:left-3 before:top-2 before:bottom-2 before:w-[2px] before:bg-white/10">
              {roadmapPoints.map((point, idx) => {
                const isPassed = progress.completedLessons.length >= point.requiredLessons;
                return (
                  <div key={idx} className="flex items-start space-x-4 relative">
                    <div className={`w-6.5 h-6.5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border-2 shrink-0 z-10 transition-all ${
                      isPassed 
                        ? 'bg-brand-primary border-brand-primary text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(123,47,247,0.4)]' 
                        : 'bg-slate-950 border-white/10 text-white/40'
                    }`}>
                      {isPassed ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold">{idx + 1}</span>}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className={`font-display font-bold text-xs ${isPassed ? 'text-white' : 'text-white/45'}`}>
                        {point.title}
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-white/60 font-sans mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
                        {point.desc}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right column: Achievements list */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-6 space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <h3 className="font-display font-black text-lg text-white mb-6">Earned Badges & Achievements</h3>

                ✕
              </button>

              {!isGenerated ? (
                /* STEP 1: ENTER NAME FORM */
                <form onSubmit={handleGenerateCertificate} className="space-y-4">

                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-amber-400">

                      Congratulations! You have completed the required milestones in the Kronex AI interactive coding sandbox. Please input your official name below.

                  >
                    Generate Credentials
                  </button>
                </form>
              ) : (
                /* STEP 2: PRINTABLE/RENDERED LUXURY CERTIFICATE */
                <div className="space-y-6">
                  
                  {/* Certificate frame block */}

                  </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={handlePrint}
                      className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-2xl font-display font-bold text-xs border border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white transition-all flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 cursor-pointer"
                    >

                    >
                      <span>Close and return</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>

                </div>
              )}

            </motion.div>
          </div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { RESOURCES } from '../data';
import { Resource, UserProgress } from '../types';
import { Search, Download, Bookmark, BookmarkCheck, FileText, Video, Eye, Check } from 'lucide-react';

interface ResourceLibraryProps {
  progress: UserProgress;
  onUpdateProgress: (newProgress: Partial<UserProgress>) => void;
}

export default function ResourceLibrary({ progress, onUpdateProgress }: ResourceLibraryProps) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [activeType, setActiveType] = useState<string>('All');
  const [downloadingId, setDownloadingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const resourceTypes = ['All', 'Guide', 'Cheat Sheet', 'Video', 'Template'];

  const filteredResources = RESOURCES.filter((res) => {
    const matchesSearch = res.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) || 
                          res.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    const matchesType = activeType === 'All' || res.type === activeType;
    return matchesSearch && matchesType;
  });

  const handleBookmark = (resId: string) => {
    const isBookmarked = progress.savedResources.includes(resId);
    let updatedSaved = [...progress.savedResources];

    if (isBookmarked) {
      updatedSaved = updatedSaved.filter(id => id !== resId);
      onUpdateProgress({ savedResources: updatedSaved });
    } else {
      updatedSaved.push(resId);
      // Award 10 XP for bookmarking resources
      onUpdateProgress({
        savedResources: updatedSaved,
        xp: progress.xp + 10,
        level: Math.floor((progress.xp + 10) / 300) + 1
      });
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadSimulate = (resId: string) => {
    setDownloadingId(resId);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setDownloadingId(null);
      alert('Resource downloaded successfully to local storage! Check your downloads.');
    }, 1500);
  };

  return (
    <div id="resource-library-panel" className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-10 text-white">
      
      {/* Page Header */}
      <div className="mb-10 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-6">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-display font-extrabold text-3xl text-white">Curated Resource Library</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-white/60 font-sans mt-1">
            Access blueprints, cheatsheets, configuration templates, and video lessons on-demand.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Search */}
        <div className="relative w-full md:w-80">
          <Search className="absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4.5 h-4.5 text-white/40" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search resources..."
            className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-sm text-white placeholder-white/30 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-primary transition-colors font-sans"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Tabs */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-10">
        {resourceTypes.map((type) => (
          <button
            key={type}
            onClick={() => setActiveType(type)}
            className={`px-4.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider font-display transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeType === type
                ? 'bg-brand-primary/20 border border-brand-primary/30 text-brand-secondary shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(123,47,247,0.15)]'
                : 'bg-white/5 text-white/60 border border-white/5 hover:border-white/15'
            }`}
          >
            {type}s
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Library Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        {filteredResources.map((res) => {
          const isSaved = progress.savedResources.includes(res.id);
          const isDownloading = downloadingId === res.id;

          return (
            <div
              key={res.id}
              className="bg-white/[0.03] rounded-3xl border border-white/10 p-6 shadow-2xl hover:border-brand-primary/40 hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(123,47,247,0.12)] hover:scale-[1.01] transition-all flex flex-col justify-between"
            >
              <div>
                {/* Meta header */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                  <span className={`inline-flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold font-mono uppercase tracking-wider ${
                    res.type === 'Cheat Sheet' ? 'bg-orange-500/10 border border-orange-500/20 text-orange-400' :
                    res.type === 'Guide' ? 'bg-[#00E5FF]/10 border border-[#00E5FF]/20 text-[#00E5FF]' :
                    res.type === 'Video' ? 'bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 text-rose-400' :
                    'bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400'
                  }`}>
                    {res.type === 'Video' ? <Video className="w-3 h-3" /> : <FileText className="w-3 h-3" />}
                    <span>{res.type}</span>
                  </span>
                  
                  {/* Bookmark Button */}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleBookmark(res.id)}
                    className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-white/40 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-brand-secondary transition-all cursor-pointer"
                    title={isSaved ? "Remove Bookmark" : "Bookmark Resource"}
                  >
                    {isSaved ? (
                      <BookmarkCheck className="w-4.5 h-4.5 text-brand-secondary fill-current" />
                    ) : (
                      <Bookmark className="w-4.5 h-4.5" />
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>

                <h3 className="font-display font-bold text-base text-white leading-snug">
                  {res.title}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-white/45 font-mono mt-1">
                  {res.category} • {res.readingTime}
                </p>
                
                <p className="text-xs text-white/60 font-sans mt-3 leading-relaxed">
                  {res.description}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Footer Actions */}
              <div className="pt-6 border-t border-white/10 mt-6 flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
                {res.type === 'Video' ? (
                  <a
                    href="#video-watch"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      alert('Simulated player launching! Let\'s prepare your full video view stream.');
                    }}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white font-display font-bold text-xs text-center transition-all flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-secondary animate-pulse" />
                    <span>Watch Lecture</span>
                  </a>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleDownloadSimulate(res.id)}
                    disabled={isDownloading}
                    className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white font-display font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {isDownloading ? (
                      <>
                        <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-pulse text-emerald-400" />
                        <span>Fetching...</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-secondary" />
                        <span>Download PDF</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { Canvas, useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { OrbitControls } from '@react-three/drei';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { 
  Orbit, Eye, EyeOff, Sliders, Activity, Sparkles, 
  Tv, Film, Play, Info, Settings, Compass, RotateCcw
} from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';

// ==========================================
// 3D Inner Scene Components
// ==========================================

interface AnimatedSceneProps {
  orbVisible: boolean;
  hologramVisible: boolean;
  rotationSpeed: number;
  cinematicMode: boolean;
}

function AnimatedScene({ orbVisible, hologramVisible, rotationSpeed, cinematicMode }: AnimatedSceneProps) {
  const coreRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const hologramRef = useRef<THREE.Group>(null);
  const pointsRef = useRef<THREE.Points>(null);

  // Rotate elements in the 3D space
  useFrame((state) => {
    const time = state.clock.getElapsedTime();
    const speedFactor = rotationSpeed * 0.5;

    // Rotate core/orb
    if (coreRef.current && orbVisible) {
      coreRef.current.rotation.y = time * 0.3 * speedFactor;
      coreRef.current.rotation.x = Math.sin(time * 0.1) * 0.1 * speedFactor;
    }

    // Rotate holographic dashboard rings
    if (hologramRef.current && hologramVisible) {
      hologramRef.current.rotation.y = -time * 0.15 * speedFactor;
      hologramRef.current.rotation.x = Math.cos(time * 0.08) * 0.05 * speedFactor;
    }

    // Rotate particles
    if (pointsRef.current && hologramVisible) {
      pointsRef.current.rotation.y = time * 0.08 * speedFactor;
    }

    // Cinematic Camera controller logic
    if (cinematicMode) {
      // Slow, dramatic, smooth camera sweep
      state.camera.position.x = Math.sin(time * 0.25) * 5.5;
      state.camera.position.z = Math.cos(time * 0.25) * 5.5;
      state.camera.position.y = Math.sin(time * 0.12) * 1.8;
      state.camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
    }
  });

  // Generate memoized telemetry particle cloud
  const particleCount = 220;
  const { positions, colors } = useMemo(() => {
    const pos = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);
    const col = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);
    
    // Aesthetic neon palette
    const colorsPalette = [
      new THREE.Color('#6C2BFF'), // Deep Purple
      new THREE.Color('#00E5FF'), // Bright Cyan
      new THREE.Color('#00FFA3'), // Mint Green
      new THREE.Color('#FF3CAC'), // Hot Pink
    ];

    for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
      // Outer disk orbital distribution
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const radius = 1.7 + Math.random() * 1.3;
      
      pos[i * 3] = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
      pos[i * 3 + 1] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5; // Thin horizontal band
      pos[i * 3 + 2] = Math.cos(angle) * radius;

      // Assign random color from neon palette
      const chosenColor = colorsPalette[Math.floor(Math.random() * colorsPalette.length)];
      col[i * 3] = chosenColor.r;
      col[i * 3 + 1] = chosenColor.g;
      col[i * 3 + 2] = chosenColor.b;
    }
    return { positions: pos, colors: col };
  }, []);

  return (
    <>
      {/* 3D AI Orb Group */}
      {orbVisible && (
        <group ref={coreRef}>
          {/* Inner Glowing Nucleus */}
          <mesh>
            <sphereGeometry args={[0.7, 32, 32]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial 
              color="#6C2BFF" 
              transparent 
              opacity={0.35} 
              wireframe 
            />
          </mesh>

          {/* Core Distorted Mesh / Particle Shell */}
          <mesh scale={[1.1, 1.1, 1.1]}>
            <sphereGeometry args={[0.7, 16, 16]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial 
              color="#00FFA3" 
              transparent 
              opacity={0.15} 
            />
          </mesh>

          {/* Outer Orbital Digital Cage */}
          <mesh scale={[1.3, 1.3, 1.3]}>
            <octahedronGeometry args={[0.8, 2]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial 
              color="#FF3CAC" 
              wireframe 
              transparent 
              opacity={0.4} 
            />
          </mesh>
        </group>
      )}

      {/* Holographic Dashboard Ring & Ring Mesh */}
      {hologramVisible && (
        <group ref={hologramRef}>
          {/* Main Horizontal Dashboard Grid Disk */}
          <mesh rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -0.2, 0]}>
            <ringGeometry args={[1.5, 1.55, 64]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial color="#00E5FF" side={THREE.DoubleSide} transparent opacity={0.65} />
          </mesh>

          {/* Concentric Secondary Ring */}
          <mesh rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -0.2, 0]}>
            <ringGeometry args={[1.8, 1.82, 32]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial color="#6C2BFF" side={THREE.DoubleSide} transparent opacity={0.4} />
          </mesh>

          {/* Outermost Segmented Dash Ring */}
          <mesh rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -0.2, 0]}>
            <ringGeometry args={[2.2, 2.25, 6]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial color="#FF3CAC" side={THREE.DoubleSide} transparent opacity={0.5} wireframe />
          </mesh>

          {/* Holographic vertical status marker lines */}
          <mesh position={[1.5, 0.1, 0]}>
            <boxGeometry args={[0.02, 0.6, 0.02]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial color="#00E5FF" transparent opacity={0.7} />
          </mesh>

          <mesh position={[-1.5, -0.1, 0]}>
            <boxGeometry args={[0.02, 0.4, 0.02]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial color="#00FFA3" transparent opacity={0.6} />
          </mesh>

          <mesh position={[0, 0, 1.5]}>
            <boxGeometry args={[0.02, 0.5, 0.02]} />
            <meshBasicMaterial color="#FF3CAC" transparent opacity={0.5} />
          </mesh>
        </group>
      )}

      {/* Orbiting Telemetry Spark Particles */}
      {hologramVisible && (
        <points ref={pointsRef}>
          <bufferGeometry>
            <bufferAttribute
              attach="attributes-position"
              args={[positions, 3]}
            />
            <bufferAttribute
              attach="attributes-color"
              args={[colors, 3]}
            />
          </bufferGeometry>
          <pointsMaterial 
            size={0.065} 
            vertexColors 
            transparent 
            opacity={0.9} 
            sizeAttenuation 
          />
        </points>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

// ==========================================
// Robust 2D/3D Fallback Vector Scene
// Used when WebGL is unsupported or throws an error
// ==========================================

class CanvasErrorBoundary extends React.Component<
  { children: React.ReactNode; fallback: React.ReactNode },
  { hasError: boolean }
> {
  constructor(props: any) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError() {
    return { hasError: true };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: any, errorInfo: any) {
    console.warn("WebGL Canvas failed to load or threw an error, fallback active.", error, errorInfo);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return this.props.fallback;
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

interface FallbackProps {
  orbVisible: boolean;
  hologramVisible: boolean;
  rotationSpeed: number;
  cinematicMode: boolean;
}

function SVGFallbackScene({ orbVisible, hologramVisible, rotationSpeed, cinematicMode }: FallbackProps) {
  // Speed parameter in seconds for full CSS spin
  const duration = Math.max(1, 15 / (rotationSpeed || 1));
  const corePulseDuration = Math.max(0.5, 3 / (rotationSpeed || 1));

  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#070A15] flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
      {/* Background ambient lighting */}
      <div className="absolute w-72 h-72 rounded-full bg-[#6C2BFF]/10 blur-[100px] animate-pulse" />
      <div className="absolute w-48 h-48 rounded-full bg-[#00E5FF]/5 blur-[80px] -translate-x-12 -translate-y-12" />

      <div className="relative w-80 h-80 flex items-center justify-center">
        {/* Holographic orbital rings */}
        {hologramVisible && (
          <div 
            className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"
            style={{
              transform: cinematicMode ? 'perspective(800px) rotateX(60deg) rotateY(10deg)' : 'perspective(800px) rotateX(65deg)',
              transition: 'transform 1.5s ease-in-out'
            }}
          >
            {/* Outer segmented dash ring */}
            <div 
              className="absolute w-72 h-72 rounded-full border border-dashed border-[#FF3CAC]/40 animate-spin"
              style={{ animationDuration: `${duration * 1.5}s` }}
            />
            {/* Middle main tech ring */}
            <div 
              className="absolute w-60 h-60 rounded-full border-2 border-double border-[#00E5FF]/60 animate-spin"
              style={{ animationDuration: `${duration}s`, animationDirection: 'reverse' }}
            />
            {/* Inner secondary ring */}
            <div 
              className="absolute w-48 h-48 rounded-full border border-[#6C2BFF]/50 animate-spin"
              style={{ animationDuration: `${duration * 0.8}s` }}
            />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Central glowing AI Core / Orb */}
        {orbVisible && (
          <div 
            className="relative w-24 h-24 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(108,43,255,0.4)] bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#6C2BFF]/30 to-[#00FFA3]/20 border border-[#6C2BFF]/40 backdrop-blur-sm transition-all"
            style={{
              animation: `pulse ${corePulseDuration}s ease-in-out infinite alternate`,
            }}
          >
            {/* Innermost wireframe-like rotating octahedron (SVG representation) */}
            <svg 
              className="w-16 h-16 text-[#00FFA3]/80 animate-spin" 
              style={{ animationDuration: `${duration * 0.5}s` }}
              viewBox="0 0 100 100"
            >
              <polygon points="50,10 80,50 50,90 20,50" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" />
              <line x1="50" y1="10" x2="50" y2="90" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="3,3" />
              <line x1="20" y1="50" x2="80" y2="50" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1" strokeDasharray="3,3" />
              <polygon points="50,30 65,50 50,70 35,50" fill="none" stroke="#FF3CAC" strokeWidth="1" />
            </svg>

            {/* Core center glowing ball */}
            <div className="absolute w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00E5FF] to-[#6C2BFF] blur-[2px] opacity-80" />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Star telemetry particles (SVG floating stars) */}
        {hologramVisible && (
          <svg className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
            <circle cx="20" cy="30" r="0.8" fill="#00E5FF" className="animate-ping" style={{ animationDuration: '3s' }} />
            <circle cx="85" cy="40" r="1.2" fill="#00FFA3" className="animate-pulse" style={{ animationDuration: '4s' }} />
            <circle cx="35" cy="80" r="0.6" fill="#FF3CAC" className="animate-ping" style={{ animationDuration: '2.5s' }} />
            <circle cx="75" cy="70" r="1" fill="#6C2BFF" className="animate-pulse" style={{ animationDuration: '3.5s' }} />
          </svg>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Send, CheckCircle2, BrainCircuit, Bot, RotateCcw, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { soundManager } from '../utils/sound';

interface SimpleMobileChatViewProps {
  onBack?: () => void;
}

export default function SimpleMobileChatView({ onBack }: SimpleMobileChatViewProps) {
  const [promptText, setPromptText] = useState('');
  const [showNotification, setShowNotification] = useState(true);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const handleSend = () => {
    if (!promptText.trim()) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    soundManager.playMessageSent();
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      setShowNotification(true);
      soundManager.playSuccess();
    }, 800);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050B18] text-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 relative overflow-hidden font-sans selection:bg-cyan-500/30">
      
      {/* Dark Blue Futuristic Glowing Background Accents */}
      <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-[#0055FF]/15 rounded-full blur-[140px] pointer-events-none" />
      <div className="absolute bottom-10 right-10 w-80 h-80 bg-[#7B3EFF]/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none" />
      <div className="absolute top-10 left-10 w-70 h-70 bg-[#00D4FF]/10 rounded-full blur-[100px] pointer-events-none" />

      {/* Back Button if embedded in dashboard */}
      {onBack && (
        <button
          onClick={onBack}
          className="absolute top-6 left-6 z-20 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:border-cyan-400/40 text-xs font-mono text-slate-300 hover:text-white flex items-center space-x-2 transition-all cursor-pointer backdrop-blur-md"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
          <span>Return to Dashboard</span>
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Mobile Screen Container */}
      <motion.div 
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 20 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
        className="w-full max-w-md bg-[#0A1228]/90 border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-[36px] shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,100,255,0.25)] backdrop-blur-2xl flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[640px] p-6 sm:p-8 relative overflow-hidden my-auto"
      >
        {/* Subtle Neon Top Edge Glow */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-48 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#00D4FF] to-transparent rounded-full shadow-[0_0_15px_#00D4FF]" />

        {/* TOP HEADER: Logo & Made by Shashvat */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-1.5 pt-2">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#0055FF] to-[#00D4FF] flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,212,255,0.4)]">
              <BrainCircuit className="w-5.5 h-5.5 text-white" />
            </div>
            <div className="text-left">
              <h1 className="font-display font-black text-2xl tracking-tight text-white leading-none">
                KRONEX <span className="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00D4FF] to-[#3B82F6]">AI</span>
              </h1>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold tracking-[2.5px] text-[#00D4FF] uppercase mt-0.5">
                Made by Shashvat
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* CENTER CONTENT AREA */}
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center my-8 space-y-6">
          
          {/* Big Centered Prompt Input Box */}
          <div className="relative w-full group">
            <div className="absolute -inset-0.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00D4FF] via-[#0055FF] to-[#7B3EFF] rounded-3xl opacity-30 group-hover:opacity-60 transition duration-500 blur-md pointer-events-none" />
            
            <div className="relative bg-[#060D1E] border border-cyan-500/40 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-2xl flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[160px]">

                  if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleSend();
                  }
                }}
                placeholder="Type your prompt here..."
                className="w-full bg-transparent text-sm font-sans text-white placeholder-slate-400 outline-none resize-none h-24 p-1 leading-relaxed"
              />

                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 15, scale: 0.95 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -15, scale: 0.95 }}
                className="w-full bg-[#081C1B]/90 border border-emerald-500/50 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(16,185,129,0.25)] backdrop-blur-xl flex items-center justify-between space-x-3 text-emerald-300 relative overflow-hidden"

                <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 bottom-0 w-1 bg-emerald-400" />
                
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-400/40 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400" />
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-sans font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-emerald-200">
                    Your AI Agent has completed the task!
                  </span>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowNotification(false)}
                  className="text-emerald-500 hover:text-emerald-300 text-xs font-mono p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-500/10 cursor-pointer transition-all"
                  title="Dismiss notification"
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>

        </div>

        {/* FOOTER BAR */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400 pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
          <span className="flex items-center space-x-1">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-ping" />
            <span>KRONEX Core v10.0</span>
          </span>
          
          {!showNotification && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowNotification(true)}
              className="text-cyan-400 hover:underline flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>Show Notification</span>
            </button>
          )}

          <span className="text-slate-400">Dark Blue Futuristic</span>
        </div>

      </motion.div>

    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';

interface SkeletonProps {
  className?: string;
  count?: number;
}

export default function SkeletonLoader({ className = 'h-12 w-full rounded-xl', count = 1 }: SkeletonProps) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 w-full">
      {Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, i) => (
        <div
          key={i}
          className={`relative overflow-hidden bg-white/5 border border-white/5 rounded-xl ${className}`}
        >
          <div className="absolute inset-0 -translate-x-full animate-[shimmer_2s_infinite] bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/10 to-transparent" />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { Sparkles, BrainCircuit, Activity, Cpu, Shield, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { soundManager } from '../utils/sound';

interface SplashScreenProps {
  onFinish: () => void;
}

export default function SplashScreen({ onFinish }: SplashScreenProps) {
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [statusText, setStatusText] = useState('Initializing KRONEX Neural Matrix...');
  const [isDone, setIsDone] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    soundManager.playDeploy();

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setProgress((prev) => {
        if (prev >= 100) {
          clearInterval(interval);
          setStatusText('Cognitive Core Synchronized.');
          setIsDone(true);
          soundManager.playSuccess();
          setTimeout(() => {
            onFinish();
          }, 800);
          return 100;
        }

        const next = prev + Math.floor(Math.random() * 12) + 8;
        if (next > 30 && prev <= 30) {
          setStatusText('Loading Hardware Acceleration & Compilers...');
        } else if (next > 60 && prev <= 60) {
          setStatusText('Mounting Sovereign AI Intelligence Engines...');
        } else if (next > 85 && prev <= 85) {
          setStatusText('Finalizing High-Frequency Audio & Canvas Nodes...');
        }

        return Math.min(100, next);
      });
    }, 120);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [onFinish]);

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 1.05 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.6, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
      className="fixed inset-0 z-100 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-[#070b18] text-white select-none overflow-hidden"
    >
      {/* Background Volumetric Glows */}
      <div className="absolute w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-[#7C3AED]/20 rounded-full blur-[140px] animate-pulse pointer-events-none" />
      <div className="absolute w-[400px] h-[400px] bg-[#22D3EE]/15 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none" />

      {/* Grid pattern overlay */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 holographic-grid opacity-20 pointer-events-none" />

        {/* Animated 3D Floating KRONEX Core Orb */}
        <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center w-28 h-28">
          {/* Outer Orbit Ring 1 */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full border border-dashed border-[#22D3EE]/40 animate-spin-slow" />
          
          {/* Outer Orbit Ring 2 */}
          <div className="absolute -inset-2 rounded-full border border-[#7C3AED]/30 animate-spin-reverse" />

          {/* Pulsing Core */}
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#7C3AED] via-[#A855F7] to-[#22D3EE] p-0.5 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(124,58,237,0.5)] animate-bounce">
            <div className="w-full h-full bg-[#0B1020] rounded-[14px] flex items-center justify-center">
              <Sparkles className="w-8 h-8 text-[#22D3EE] animate-pulse" />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Floating light particles */}
          <span className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#22D3EE] animate-ping" />
          <span className="absolute bottom-1 left-1 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#7C3AED] animate-pulse" />
        </div>

        {/* Brand Title */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-400/20 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-[#22D3EE] tracking-widest uppercase">
              V2.5 SOVEREIGN
            </span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-display font-black tracking-tight text-gradient-hero">
            KRONEX AI STUDIO
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-sans tracking-wide">
            Next-Generation Cognitive Architecture Platform
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Progress Bar & Status */}
        <div className="w-full space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono">
            <span className="text-slate-400 text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#22D3EE] animate-spin" />
              {statusText}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[#22D3EE] font-bold">{progress}%</span>
          </div>

          <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 overflow-hidden p-0.5 relative shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(34,211,238,0.2)]">
            <motion.div
              className="h-full rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C3AED] via-[#A855F7] to-[#22D3EE]"
              initial={{ width: '0%' }}
              animate={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
              transition={{ ease: 'easeOut' }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer info badge */}
        <div className="pt-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-4 text-[10.5px] font-mono text-slate-500">
```

FILE: src/components/ThemeStudioModal.tsx

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { 
  Sparkles, Sun, Moon, Zap, Shield, RefreshCw, X, Sliders, Check, 
  Palette, Eye, Activity, BatteryCharging, Clock, Laptop, Gauge, 
  Layers, MousePointer, Cpu, Volume2, Radio
} from 'lucide-react';
import { soundManager } from '../utils/sound';
import { 
  THEME_PRESETS, 
  ThemeSettings, 
  DEFAULT_THEME_SETTINGS, 
  applyThemeToDOM, 
  saveThemeSettings, 
  getSavedThemeSettings 
} from '../utils/themeEngine';

interface ThemeStudioModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onThemeChanged?: (presetId: string) => void;
}

export default function ThemeStudioModal({ isOpen, onClose, onThemeChanged }: ThemeStudioModalProps) {
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<ThemeSettings>(getSavedThemeSettings());
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'presets' | 'custom' | 'effects' | 'smart'>('presets');
  const [batteryLevel, setBatteryLevel] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [batteryCharging, setBatteryCharging] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [systemDarkMode, setSystemDarkMode] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Sync settings with DOM on open/change
  useEffect(() => {
    applyThemeToDOM(settings);
    saveThemeSettings(settings);
    if (onThemeChanged) onThemeChanged(settings.presetId);
  }, [settings]);

  // Read Battery API and System Theme
  useEffect(() => {
    // System color scheme
    const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    setSystemDarkMode(mediaQuery.matches);
    const handleMediaChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => setSystemDarkMode(e.matches);
    mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handleMediaChange);

    // Battery API
    if ('getBattery' in navigator) {
      (navigator as any).getBattery().then((batt: any) => {
        setBatteryLevel(Math.round(batt.level * 100));
        setBatteryCharging(batt.charging);

        batt.addEventListener('levelchange', () => setBatteryLevel(Math.round(batt.level * 100)));
        batt.addEventListener('chargingchange', () => setBatteryCharging(batt.charging));
      }).catch(() => {});
    }

    return () => mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', handleMediaChange);
  }, []);

  // Handle Smart AI Auto Theme calculation
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!settings.smartAutoMode) return;

    const hour = new Date().getHours();
    const isNight = hour >= 19 || hour < 6;

    let targetPreset = 'dark';
    if (batteryLevel !== null && batteryLevel < 20 && !batteryCharging) {
      targetPreset = 'amoled'; // Auto switch to AMOLED Black for power saving
    } else if (!isNight && !systemDarkMode) {
      targetPreset = 'light';
    } else if (isNight) {
      targetPreset = 'galaxy';
    }

    if (targetPreset !== settings.presetId) {
      updateSetting('presetId', targetPreset);
      showToast(`Smart AI switched theme to ${THEME_PRESETS[targetPreset].name}`);
    }
  }, [settings.smartAutoMode, batteryLevel, batteryCharging, systemDarkMode]);

  const updateSetting = <K extends keyof ThemeSettings>(key: K, value: ThemeSettings[K]) => {
    setSettings(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev, [key]: value };
      applyThemeToDOM(next);
      saveThemeSettings(next);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3000);
  };

  const handleSelectPreset = (presetId: string) => {
    soundManager.playClick();
    updateSetting('presetId', presetId);
    updateSetting('customAccent', null); // Reset custom accent on preset switch
    soundManager.playSuccess();
    showToast(`Applied ${THEME_PRESETS[presetId].name} Theme`);
  };

  const handleResetDefaults = () => {
    soundManager.playClick();
    setSettings(DEFAULT_THEME_SETTINGS);
    applyThemeToDOM(DEFAULT_THEME_SETTINGS);
    saveThemeSettings(DEFAULT_THEME_SETTINGS);
    soundManager.playToggle();
    showToast('Theme Settings Reset to Default');
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const currentPreset = THEME_PRESETS[settings.presetId] || THEME_PRESETS.dark;

  const accentSwatches = [
    { label: 'Cyan', color: '#00D4FF' },
    { label: 'Violet', color: '#7C5CFF' },
    { label: 'Emerald', color: '#00FFA3' },
    { label: 'Pink', color: '#FF007A' },
    { label: 'Gold', color: '#FACC15' },
    { label: 'Sapphire', color: '#3B82F6' },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[10000] bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto">
      <motion.div 
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 10 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 10 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
        className="w-full max-w-4xl bg-[#080D1A] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-7 shadow-[0_25px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] relative overflow-hidden text-white font-sans my-auto max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col"
      >
        {/* Ambient Glow Gradient Header */}
        <div 
          className="absolute -top-24 -left-24 w-96 h-96 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none opacity-40 transition-colors duration-500"
          style={{ background: currentPreset.primary }}
        />
        <div 
          className="absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-96 h-96 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none opacity-30 transition-colors duration-500"
          style={{ background: currentPreset.secondary }}
        />

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.08] pb-5 shrink-0 relative z-10">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3.5">
            <div 
              className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center border shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300"
              style={{ 
                background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${currentPreset.primary}30, ${currentPreset.secondary}20)`,
                borderColor: `${currentPreset.primary}60`
              }}
            >
              <Sparkles className="w-6 h-6 animate-pulse" style={{ color: currentPreset.primary }} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <h2 className="text-xl font-display font-extrabold text-white tracking-wide">
                  Theme Studio
                </h2>
                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-widest bg-cyan-400/10 border border-cyan-400/30 text-[#00D4FF]">
                  AI Engine 2.5
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mt-0.5">
                Customize KRONEX AI look, glassmorphism, accent lighting, & smart auto-theme
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <button
              onClick={handleResetDefaults}
              className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer text-xs font-mono flex items-center space-x-1.5 border border-white/5"
              title="Reset all settings to default"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Reset</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => { soundManager.playClick(); onClose(); }}
              className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-white/5"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Navigation Tabs */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 border-b border-white/[0.08] py-3 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar shrink-0 relative z-10">
          <button
            onClick={() => { soundManager.playClick(); setActiveTab('presets'); }}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold tracking-wide transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-2 whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'presets' 
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white shadow-lg' 
                : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <Palette className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Theme Presets (10)</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => { soundManager.playClick(); setActiveTab('custom'); }}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold tracking-wide transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-2 whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'custom' 
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white shadow-lg' 
                : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <Sliders className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Visual Adjustments</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => { soundManager.playClick(); setActiveTab('effects'); }}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold tracking-wide transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-2 whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'effects' 
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white shadow-lg' 
                : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <Layers className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>FX & Toggles</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => { soundManager.playClick(); setActiveTab('smart'); }}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold tracking-wide transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-2 whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeTab === 'smart' 
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white shadow-lg' 
                : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <Cpu className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Smart AI Theme</span>
            {settings.smartAutoMode && (
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content Container */}
        <div className="py-5 overflow-y-auto flex-1 pr-1 space-y-6 relative z-10 custom-scrollbar">
          
          {/* TAB 1: PRESETS */}
          {activeTab === 'presets' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Select Theme Atmosphere
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-cyan-400 font-mono">
                  Active: {currentPreset.name}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3.5">
                {Object.values(THEME_PRESETS).map((preset) => {
                  const isSelected = settings.presetId === preset.id;
                  return (
                    <motion.div
                      key={preset.id}
                      whileHover={{ scale: 1.02, y: -2 }}
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}
                      onClick={() => handleSelectPreset(preset.id)}
                      className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all cursor-pointer relative overflow-hidden group ${
                        isSelected 
                          ? 'border-[#00D4FF] bg-white/[0.08] shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,212,255,0.25)]' 
                          : 'border-white/10 bg-white/[0.02] hover:bg-white/[0.05] hover:border-white/20'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {/* Top Bar Preview */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                          <span className="text-lg">{preset.icon}</span>
                          <div>
                            <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-white group-hover:text-[#00D4FF] transition-colors">
                              {preset.name}
                            </h4>
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 block">
                              {preset.tag}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {isSelected && (
                          <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-[#00D4FF] text-black flex items-center justify-center shadow-md">
                            <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[3]" />
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Color Palette Swatches Preview */}
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 p-2 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/5">
                        <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 shadow-inner" style={{ background: preset.bg }} title="Background" />
                        <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 shadow-inner" style={{ background: preset.surface }} title="Surface" />
                        <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 shadow-inner" style={{ background: preset.primary }} title="Primary Accent" />
                        <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 shadow-inner" style={{ background: preset.secondary }} title="Secondary" />
                        <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 shadow-inner" style={{ background: preset.accent }} title="Glow Accent" />
                      </div>
                    </motion.div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: VISUAL ADJUSTMENTS */}
          {activeTab === 'custom' && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              
              {/* Custom Accent Color Swatches */}
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <Palette className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00D4FF]" />
                    <span>Accent Highlight Tint</span>
                  </label>
                  {settings.customAccent && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => updateSetting('customAccent', null)}
                      className="text-[10px] font-mono text-cyan-400 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Use Preset Accent
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
                  {accentSwatches.map((swatch) => (
                    <button
                      key={swatch.color}
                      onClick={() => {
                        soundManager.playClick();
                        updateSetting('customAccent', swatch.color);
                      }}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center space-x-2 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                        settings.customAccent === swatch.color 
                          ? 'border-white bg-white/20 text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,255,0.3)]' 
                          : 'border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-white/10'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full shadow-sm" style={{ background: swatch.color }} />
                      <span>{swatch.label}</span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Sliders Grid */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                
                {/* Brightness Slider */}
                <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-200 flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <Sun className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
                      <span>Canvas Brightness</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-amber-400">{settings.brightness}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min="50"
                    max="150"
                    step="5"
                    value={settings.brightness}
                    onChange={(e) => updateSetting('brightness', parseInt(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full accent-[#00D4FF] cursor-pointer"
                  />
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">Adjust overall display luminance filter</p>
                </div>

                {/* Glass Blur Slider */}
                <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
```
