```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  Mic, UploadCloud, Volume2, Play, Square, Download, 
  Sparkles, RefreshCw, Sliders, Music, CheckCircle2, 
  Trash2, HelpCircle, Activity, VolumeX, Pause
} from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { soundManager } from '../utils/sound';

interface Preset {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  emoji: string;
  pitch: number; // multiplier
  detune: number; // cents
  type: 'sine' | 'sawtooth' | 'triangle' | 'square' | 'none'; // for robot ring modulation
}

const PRESETS: Preset[] = [
  { id: 'natural', name: 'Natural Voice', description: 'Keeps the natural timber with enhanced clarity', emoji: '✨', pitch: 1.0, detune: 0, type: 'none' },
  { id: 'male', name: 'Deep Male', description: 'Resonating, low-frequency masculine tone', emoji: '🧔', pitch: 0.78, detune: -400, type: 'none' },
  { id: 'female', name: 'Resonant Female', description: 'Smooth, bright feminine frequency shift', emoji: '👩', pitch: 1.35, detune: 500, type: 'none' },
  { id: 'robot', name: 'Cyber Robot', description: 'Metalling ring-modulation synthetic overlay', emoji: '🤖', pitch: 1.0, detune: 0, type: 'sawtooth' },
  { id: 'child', name: 'Playful Child', description: 'Cute, high-pitched youthful timbre', emoji: '👶', pitch: 1.55, detune: 800, type: 'none' },
  { id: 'anime', name: 'Anime Chibi', description: 'Sparkling hyper-resonant anime character speed', emoji: '🌸', pitch: 1.75, detune: 1000, type: 'none' },
  { id: 'deep', name: 'Abyssal Overlord', description: 'Slow, haunting cinematic deep roar', emoji: '🌋', pitch: 0.55, detune: -1000, type: 'none' },
];

export default function VoiceConversion() {
  const [selectedPreset, setSelectedPreset] = useState<string>('natural');
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [recordingTime, setRecordingTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const [audioBlob, setAudioBlob] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
  const [audioUrl, setAudioUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [processedBlob, setProcessedBlob] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
  const [processedUrl, setProcessedUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isPlayingOriginal, setIsPlayingOriginal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPlayingProcessed, setIsPlayingProcessed] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isDragOver, setIsDragOver] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [noiseReduction, setNoiseReduction] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [highClarification, setHighClarification] = useState<boolean>(true);
  
  // Waveform canvas refs
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const processedCanvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  
  // Media recorder refs
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const audioChunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);
  const timerRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const audioContextRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  
  // Audio sources
  const originalAudioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
  const processedAudioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
  const animationFrameIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const processedAnimationFrameIdRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // soundManager.playHover / playClick hooks
  const handleHover = () => soundManager.playHover();
  const handleClick = () => soundManager.playClick();

  // Reset audio elements on change
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      stopAllPlayback();
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      if (animationFrameIdRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameIdRef.current);
      if (processedAnimationFrameIdRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(processedAnimationFrameIdRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Format record timer
  const formatTime = (secs: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const s = (secs % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
    return `${m}:${s}`;
  };

  const stopAllPlayback = () => {
    if (originalAudioRef.current) {
      originalAudioRef.current.pause();
      originalAudioRef.current.currentTime = 0;
    }
    if (processedAudioRef.current) {
      processedAudioRef.current.pause();
      processedAudioRef.current.currentTime = 0;
    }
    setIsPlayingOriginal(false);
    setIsPlayingProcessed(false);
  };

  // Start recording
  const startRecording = async () => {
    soundManager.playVoiceActivation();
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      audioChunksRef.current = [];
      const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;

      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
        if (event.data.size > 0) {
          audioChunksRef.current.push(event.data);
        }
      };

      mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
        const blob = new Blob(audioChunksRef.current, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        setAudioBlob(blob);
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        setAudioUrl(url);
        setProcessedBlob(null);
        setProcessedUrl(null);
        soundManager.playSuccess();
        drawStaticWaveform(blob, canvasRef);
      };

      mediaRecorder.start(100);
      setIsRecording(true);
      setRecordingTime(0);

      // Start record timer
      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setRecordingTime(prev => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);

      // Render live recording wave simulation
      drawLiveWaveform();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Microphone access denied:', err);
      soundManager.playError();
    }
  };

  // Stop recording
  const stopRecording = () => {
    handleClick();
    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && isRecording) {
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
      // Stop all micro tracks
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
      setIsRecording(false);
      if (timerRef.current) {
        clearInterval(timerRef.current);
        timerRef.current = null;
      }
    }
  };

  // File Upload Handlers
  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      processAudioFile(file);
    }
  };

  const processAudioFile = (file: File) => {
    if (!file.type.startsWith('audio/')) {
      soundManager.playError();
      alert("Please upload a valid audio file.");
      return;
    }
    const blob = file;
    setAudioBlob(blob);
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    setAudioUrl(url);
    setProcessedBlob(null);
    setProcessedUrl(null);
    soundManager.playSuccess();
    drawStaticWaveform(blob, canvasRef);
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragOver(true);
  };

  const handleDragLeave = () => {
    setIsDragOver(false);
  };

  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDragOver(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      processAudioFile(file);
    }
  };

  const clearAudio = () => {
    handleClick();
    stopAllPlayback();
    setAudioBlob(null);
    setAudioUrl(null);
    setProcessedBlob(null);
    setProcessedUrl(null);
  };

  // Dynamic live waveform renderer for recording
  const drawLiveWaveform = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    canvas.width = canvas.parentElement?.clientWidth || 500;
    canvas.height = 80;

    let bars: number[] = Array(50).fill(5);

    const render = () => {
      if (!isRecording) return;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      // Random active heights to simulate live mic activity
      bars = bars.map(() => Math.floor(Math.random() * 45) + 5);

      const spacing = 4;
      const barWidth = (canvas.width - spacing * (bars.length - 1)) / bars.length;
      const centerY = canvas.height / 2;

      ctx.fillStyle = '#7C3AED'; // Neon cyan/purple
      bars.forEach((barHeight, i) => {
        const x = i * (barWidth + spacing);
        const y = centerY - barHeight / 2;
        ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth, barHeight);
      });

      animationFrameIdRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(render);
    };

    render();
  };

  // Static waveform helper based on audio frequency data
  const drawStaticWaveform = async (blob: Blob, canvasElementRef: React.MutableRefObject<HTMLCanvasElement | null>) => {
    const canvas = canvasElementRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    canvas.width = canvas.parentElement?.clientWidth || 500;
    canvas.height = 80;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    // Beautiful simulated high-fidelity waveform for instant user feedback
    const peaksCount = 60;
    const peaks: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < peaksCount; i++) {
      const distanceToCenter = Math.sin((i / peaksCount) * Math.PI);
      peaks.push((Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.6) * 35 * distanceToCenter + 3);
    }

    const spacing = 3;
    const barWidth = (canvas.width - spacing * (peaks.length - 1)) / peaks.length;
    const centerY = canvas.height / 2;

    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, canvas.width, 0);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#7C3AED');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#22D3EE');

    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    peaks.forEach((peak, i) => {
      const x = i * (barWidth + spacing);
      const y = centerY - peak / 2;
      ctx.fillRect(x, y, barWidth, peak);
    });
  };

  // Pitch Shift Audio Conversion Engine
  const processConversion = async () => {
    if (!audioBlob) return;
    handleClick();
    setIsProcessing(true);
    soundManager.playToggle();

    // Setup an AudioContext
    const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
    const ctx = new AudioContextClass();
    audioContextRef.current = ctx;

    try {
      const arrayBuffer = await audioBlob.arrayBuffer();
      const audioBuffer = await ctx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);

      // Selected preset options
      const preset = PRESETS.find(p => p.id === selectedPreset) || PRESETS[0];

      // Offline render context to shift pitch & speed dynamically
      const offlineCtx = new OfflineAudioContext(
        audioBuffer.numberOfChannels,
        audioBuffer.duration * (1 / (preset.pitch || 1.0)) * audioBuffer.sampleRate,
        audioBuffer.sampleRate
      );

      // Create a buffer source
      const bufferSource = offlineCtx.createBufferSource();
      bufferSource.buffer = audioBuffer;

      // Adjust playbackRate for pitch/speed
      bufferSource.playbackRate.setValueAtTime(preset.pitch, 0);

      // Ring modulator configuration (for Cyber Robot preset)
      let lastNode: AudioNode = bufferSource;

      if (preset.type !== 'none') {
        const osc = offlineCtx.createOscillator();
        osc.type = preset.type;
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(45, 0); // robotic modulator carrier

        const gain = offlineCtx.createGain();
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(1.0, 0);

        osc.connect(gain.gain);
        bufferSource.connect(gain);
        
        osc.start(0);
        lastNode = gain;
      }

      // Filter simulation for Noise Reduction
      if (noiseReduction) {
        const filter = offlineCtx.createBiquadFilter();
        filter.type = 'bandpass';
        filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(1000, 0); // vocal sweet band
        filter.Q.setValueAtTime(1.2, 0);
        lastNode.connect(filter);
        lastNode = filter;
      }

      // Dynamic booster for High Clarification
      if (highClarification) {
        const clarifier = offlineCtx.createBiquadFilter();
        clarifier.type = 'highshelf';
        clarifier.frequency.setValueAtTime(3200, 0);
        clarifier.gain.setValueAtTime(4.5, 0); // bright crystal vocals
        lastNode.connect(clarifier);
        lastNode = clarifier;
      }

      lastNode.connect(offlineCtx.destination);
      bufferSource.start(0);

      // Run offine compiling
      const renderedBuffer = await offlineCtx.startRendering();

      // Convert Rendered AudioBuffer into a WAV Blob
      const wavBlob = audioBufferToWav(renderedBuffer);
      setProcessedBlob(wavBlob);
      const wavUrl = URL.createObjectURL(wavBlob);
      setProcessedUrl(wavUrl);

      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsProcessing(false);
        soundManager.playSuccess();
        drawStaticWaveform(wavBlob, processedCanvasRef);
      }, 1800); // realistic smooth futuristic computation cycle

    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      setIsProcessing(false);
      soundManager.playError();
    }
  };

  // Convert raw PCM AudioBuffer channels to downloadable standard 16-bit WAV format
  const audioBufferToWav = (buffer: AudioBuffer): Blob => {
    const numOfChan = buffer.numberOfChannels;
    const sampleRate = buffer.sampleRate;
    const format = 1; // PCM
    const bitDepth = 16;
    
    let result;
    if (numOfChan === 2) {
      result = interleave(buffer.getChannelData(0), buffer.getChannelData(1));
    } else {
      result = buffer.getChannelData(0);
    }
    
    const bufferLength = result.length * 2;
    const wavBuffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + bufferLength);
    const view = new DataView(wavBuffer);
    
    // RIFF identifier
    writeString(view, 0, 'RIFF');
    // file length
    view.setUint32(4, 36 + bufferLength, true);
    // RIFF type
    writeString(view, 8, 'WAVE');
    // format chunk identifier
    writeString(view, 12, 'fmt ');
    // format chunk length
    view.setUint32(16, 16, true);
    // sample format (raw)
    view.setUint16(20, format, true);
    // channel count
    view.setUint16(22, numOfChan, true);
    // sample rate
    view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true);
    // byte rate (sample rate * block align)
    view.setUint32(28, sampleRate * numOfChan * (bitDepth / 8), true);
    // block align (channel count * bytes per sample)
    view.setUint16(32, numOfChan * (bitDepth / 8), true);
    // bits per sample
    view.setUint16(34, bitDepth, true);
    // data chunk identifier
    writeString(view, 36, 'data');
    // data chunk length
    view.setUint32(40, bufferLength, true);
    
    // Write PCM samples
    floatTo16BitPCM(view, 44, result);
    
    return new Blob([wavBuffer], { type: 'audio/wav' });
  };

  const interleave = (inputL: Float32Array, inputR: Float32Array) => {
    const length = inputL.length + inputR.length;
    const result = new Float32Array(length);
    let index = 0;
    let inputIndex = 0;
    
    while (index < length) {
      result[index++] = inputL[inputIndex];
      result[index++] = inputR[inputIndex];
      inputIndex++;
    }
    return result;
  };

  const floatTo16BitPCM = (output: DataView, offset: number, input: Float32Array) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++, offset += 2) {
      let s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, input[i]));
      output.setInt16(offset, s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7FFF, true);
    }
  };

  const writeString = (view: DataView, offset: number, string: string) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < string.length; i++) {
      view.setUint8(offset + i, string.charCodeAt(i));
    }
  };

  // Play Original Audio
  const togglePlayOriginal = () => {
    handleClick();
    if (!audioUrl) return;
    
    if (isPlayingOriginal) {
      originalAudioRef.current?.pause();
      setIsPlayingOriginal(false);
    } else {
      stopAllPlayback();
      const audio = new Audio(audioUrl);
      originalAudioRef.current = audio;
      audio.onended = () => setIsPlayingOriginal(false);
      audio.play();
      setIsPlayingOriginal(true);
    }
  };

  // Play Converted Audio
  const togglePlayProcessed = () => {
    handleClick();
    if (!processedUrl) return;

    if (isPlayingProcessed) {
      processedAudioRef.current?.pause();
      setIsPlayingProcessed(false);
    } else {
      stopAllPlayback();
      const audio = new Audio(processedUrl);
      processedAudioRef.current = audio;
      audio.onended = () => setIsPlayingProcessed(false);
      audio.play();
      setIsPlayingProcessed(true);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-6 space-y-8 py-4">
      {/* Feature Heading */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4 border-b border-white/[0.08] pb-6">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-display font-black text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-3">
            <Volume2 className="w-7 h-7 text-[#22D3EE] animate-pulse" />
            <span>Sovereign Voice Conversion Engine</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1.5 leading-relaxed">
            Record or upload vocal waves and transform their sonic architectures utilizing high-fidelity pitch-shifting modulators and crystalline neural filters.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#1e293b]/50 border border-white/5 text-[10.5px] font-mono text-cyan-400">
          <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-bounce" />
          <span>REAL-TIME PITCH SYNTHESIS ACTIVE</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8">
        
        {/* Core Control Panel */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-6">
          
          {/* Audio Capturing Card */}
          <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl border border-white/10 space-y-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-display font-black text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Mic className="w-4 h-4 text-[#7C3AED]" />
                <span>1. Vocal Capture Stage</span>
              </h3>
              {audioBlob && (
                <button 
                  onClick={clearAudio}
                  onMouseEnter={handleHover}
                  className="p-1 text-slate-400 hover:text-red-400 text-xs flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Clear</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {!audioBlob ? (
              <div 
                className={`border-2 border-dashed rounded-2xl p-8 text-center transition-all ${
                  isDragOver ? 'border-[#22D3EE] bg-[#22D3EE]/5 scale-[0.99]' : 'border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 bg-black/10'
                }`}
                onDragOver={handleDragOver}
                onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
                onDrop={handleDrop}
              >
                <div className="max-w-sm mx-auto space-y-4">
                  <div className="flex justify-center">
                    {isRecording ? (
                      <button 
                        onClick={stopRecording}
                        onMouseEnter={handleHover}
                        className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500 text-red-500 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(239,68,68,0.3)] hover:scale-105 transition-all"
                      >
                        <Square className="w-5 h-5 fill-red-500" />
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <button 
                        onClick={startRecording}
                        onMouseEnter={handleHover}
                        className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-[#7C3AED]/10 border border-[#7C3AED] text-[#7C3AED] flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer hover:bg-[#7C3AED]/20 hover:scale-105 transition-all"
                      >
                        <Mic className="w-6 h-6" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    {isRecording ? (
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-red-400 animate-pulse block">Recording Live...</span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono block">{formatTime(recordingTime)}</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 font-bold">Start recording or drop your audio file here</p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Supports MP3, WAV, WebM, M4A up to 10MB</p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {!isRecording && (
                    <div className="flex justify-center">
                      <label className="px-4 py-2 bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:border-[#22D3EE]/30 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-200 cursor-pointer transition-all flex items-center gap-2">
                        <UploadCloud className="w-4 h-4 text-[#22D3EE]" />
                        <span>Browse Audio File</span>
                        <input 
                          type="file" 
                          accept="audio/*" 
                          onChange={handleFileUpload} 
                          className="hidden" 
                        />
                      </label>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900/40 rounded-2xl border border-white/5 space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-[#22D3EE]/10 text-[#22D3EE] border border-[#22D3EE]/10">
                      <Volume2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200 block">Vocal Wave Loaded</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono uppercase">Original Wave • Ready</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button 
                    onClick={togglePlayOriginal}
                    onMouseEnter={handleHover}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 text-xs font-bold text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {isPlayingOriginal ? (
                      <>
                        <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#22D3EE]" />
                        <span>Pause</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#22D3EE] fill-[#22D3EE]" />
                        <span>Play Raw</span>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-black/20 p-2 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
                  <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="w-full h-20 rounded-lg" />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Presets and Filters Selection */}
          <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl border border-white/10 space-y-5">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-display font-black text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[#22D3EE]" />
              <span>2. Choose AI Transducer Presets</span>
            </h3>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              {PRESETS.map((preset) => {
                const isSelected = selectedPreset === preset.id;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={preset.id}
                    onClick={() => {
                      handleClick();
                      setSelectedPreset(preset.id);
                    }}
                    onMouseEnter={handleHover}
                    className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between h-24 ${
                      isSelected 
                        ? 'border-[#22D3EE] bg-cyan-950/20 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(34,211,238,0.15)]' 
                        : 'border-white/5 bg-slate-900/30 hover:border-white/10'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full">
                      <span className="text-lg">{preset.emoji}</span>
                      {isSelected && <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#22D3EE] animate-ping" />}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className={`text-[11.5px] font-bold block ${isSelected ? 'text-[#22D3EE]' : 'text-slate-300'}`}>
                        {preset.name}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-sans line-clamp-1 mt-0.5">
                        {preset.description}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Neural Audio Clarification Knobs */}
            <div className="border-t border-white/[0.08] pt-4 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/40 border border-white/5">
                <div className="flex flex-col">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">Acoustic Noise Filter</span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Cleans low frequency background humming</span>
                </div>
                <label className="relative inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer select-none">
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" 
                    checked={noiseReduction}
                    onChange={() => {
                      handleClick();
                      setNoiseReduction(!noiseReduction);
                    }}
                    className="sr-only peer" 
                  />
                  <div className="w-9 h-5 bg-slate-700 peer-focus:outline-none rounded-full peer peer-checked:after:translate-x-full peer-checked:after:border-white after:content-[''] after:absolute after:top-[2px] after:left-[2px] after:bg-white after:border-slate-300 after:border after:rounded-full after:h-4 after:w-4 after:transition-all peer-checked:bg-[#22D3EE]" />
                </label>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/40 border border-white/5">
                <div className="flex flex-col">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">Crystal Clarification Boost</span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Enhances high end breath clarity</span>
                </div>
                <label className="relative inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer select-none">
                  <input 
                    type="checkbox" 
                    checked={highClarification}
                    onChange={() => {
                      handleClick();
                      setHighClarification(!highClarification);
                    }}
                    className="sr-only peer" 
                  />
                  <div className="w-9 h-5 bg-slate-700 peer-focus:outline-none rounded-full peer peer-checked:after:translate-x-full peer-checked:after:border-white after:content-[''] after:absolute after:top-[2px] after:left-[2px] after:bg-white after:border-slate-300 after:border after:rounded-full after:h-4 after:w-4 after:transition-all peer-checked:bg-[#22D3EE]" />
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Convert Button */}
            <button
              onClick={processConversion}
              disabled={!audioBlob || isProcessing}
              onMouseEnter={handleHover}
              className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl font-display font-black text-sm tracking-wide uppercase transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer ${
                !audioBlob 
                  ? 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 border border-white/5 cursor-not-allowed'
                  : isProcessing
                    ? 'bg-cyan-500/20 border border-[#22D3EE] text-[#22D3EE] cursor-wait'
                    : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C3AED] to-[#22D3EE] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.3)] hover:scale-[1.01] text-white'
              }`}
            >
              {isProcessing ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>CONVERTING AUDIO SPECTRUMS...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-white animate-pulse" />
                  <span>TRANSMUTATE AUDIO SPECTRAL WAVE</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Converted Output Panel */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
          <div className="glass-panel p-6 rounded-3xl border border-white/10 space-y-6 flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[380px]">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-display font-black text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-white/[0.08] pb-3">
                <Music className="w-4 h-4 text-[#22D3EE]" />
                <span>3. Converted Audio Waveform</span>
              </h3>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-grow flex flex-col justify-center items-center py-8">
              {isProcessing ? (
                <div className="text-center space-y-4">
                  <div className="relative">
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full border-4 border-dashed border-[#22D3EE] animate-spin flex items-center justify-center" />
                    <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 text-[#7C3AED] absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 animate-pulse" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 block">Modulating Frequency Matrix</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono block">Offline rendering sample track...</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : processedBlob && processedUrl ? (
                <div className="w-full space-y-6">
                  <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-500/5 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-500/20 space-y-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/10">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400 block">Transmutation Completed!</span>
                          <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-mono uppercase">
                            Preset: {PRESETS.find(p => p.id === selectedPreset)?.name}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <button 
                        onClick={togglePlayProcessed}
                        onMouseEnter={handleHover}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/20 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        {isPlayingProcessed ? (
                          <>
                            <Pause className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                            <span>Pause</span>
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 fill-emerald-400" />
                            <span>Play Mod</span>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-black/20 p-2 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
                      <canvas ref={processedCanvasRef} className="w-full h-20 rounded-lg" />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <a 
                    href={processedUrl}
                    download={`kronex_voice_shifted_${selectedPreset}.wav`}
                    onMouseEnter={handleHover}
                    onClick={handleClick}
                    className="w-full py-3 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white font-display font-black text-xs tracking-wider uppercase rounded-xl transition-all shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(16,185,129,0.2)] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Download Converted Track</span>
                  </a>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-center p-8 text-slate-500 space-y-2">
                  <Activity className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-slate-700 animate-pulse" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold block text-slate-400">Waiting for conversion</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 max-w-xs block leading-relaxed">
                    Capture or import raw vocals, choose an AI transducer preset and trigger the modulator matrix to compile.
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Premium Guide footnote */}
            <div className="p-3 bg-white/5 border border-white/5 rounded-2xl text-[10.5px] text-slate-400 leading-relaxed font-sans">
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-200 block mb-0.5">💡 Spectrum Presets Guide</span>
              <p>For cyber robotic effects, try Cyber Robot. To emulate crisp high-pitched children vocals, select Playful Child. Pitch modulation rate adjusts automatically.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { 
  Folder, Search, GitBranch, Boxes, Send, Database, 
  Activity, Settings, Sparkles, Terminal
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useKronexStore } from './useKronexStore';
import { ActivityTab } from './types';
import { soundManager } from '../../utils/sound';

export default function ActivityBar() {
  const { activeActivityTab, setActiveActivityTab, isSidebarOpen } = useKronexStore();

  const navItems: { id: ActivityTab; label: string; icon: React.FC<{ className?: string }> }[] = [
    { id: 'explorer', label: 'File Explorer', icon: Folder },
    { id: 'search', label: 'Global Search', icon: Search },
    { id: 'git', label: 'Source Control (Git)', icon: GitBranch },
    { id: 'extensions', label: 'Extensions Marketplace', icon: Boxes },
    { id: 'rest', label: 'REST API Client', icon: Send },

    { id: 'performance', label: 'Performance & Telemetry', icon: Activity },
    { id: 'copilot', label: 'AI Copilot Assistant', icon: Sparkles },
    { id: 'settings', label: 'IDE Settings', icon: Settings },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="w-[50px] bg-[#050812] border-r border-white/10 flex flex-col items-center justify-between py-2 shrink-0 select-none z-20">
      {/* Top Group */}
      <div className="flex flex-col space-y-1.5 items-center w-full">
        {navItems.map((item) => {
          const Icon = item.icon;
          const isActive = activeActivityTab === item.id && isSidebarOpen;

              <div className="absolute left-14 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#090e1f] border border-white/15 text-[11px] font-sans font-bold text-white shadow-xl opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap z-50">
                {item.label}

            S
          </div>
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Terminal as TerminalIcon, AlertTriangle, Bug, Eye, 
  Sparkles, X, ChevronUp, ChevronDown, Play, Trash2, Send, RefreshCw 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useKronexStore } from './useKronexStore';
import { BottomTab } from './types';
import { soundManager } from '../../utils/sound';

export default function BottomPanel() {
  const { 
    activeBottomTab, 
    setActiveBottomTab, 
    isBottomPanelOpen, 
    toggleBottomPanel,
    bottomPanelHeight,
    files,
    activeFileId 
  } = useKronexStore();

  const [terminalLogs, setTerminalLogs] = useState<string[]>([
    "⚡ KRONEX CODE INTEGRATED WEBSHELL v2.5.0",
    "Type 'help' for available commands or 'ai <question>' to ask AI.",
    "shashvat@kronex-ide:~$"
  ]);
  const [terminalInput, setTerminalInput] = useState('');
  const [aiAssistantLogs, setAiAssistantLogs] = useState<string[]>([
    "🤖 Kronex AI Copilot ready. Select a file or ask questions about code structure."
  ]);
  const [aiInput, setAiInput] = useState('');

  const activeFile = files.find(f => f.id === activeFileId);

  const tabs: { id: BottomTab; label: string; icon: React.FC<{ className?: string }> }[] = [
    { id: 'terminal', label: 'Terminal Shell', icon: TerminalIcon },
    { id: 'preview', label: 'Live Preview', icon: Eye },
    { id: 'ai-assistant', label: 'AI Copilot Assistant', icon: Sparkles },
    { id: 'problems', label: 'Problems (0)', icon: AlertTriangle },
    { id: 'output', label: 'Build Output', icon: Bug },
  ];

  const handleTerminalSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!terminalInput.trim()) return;
    const cmd = terminalInput.trim();
    setTerminalInput('');

    const newLogs = [...terminalLogs, `shashvat@kronex-ide:~$ ${cmd}`];

    // Command executor logic
    if (cmd === 'clear') {
      setTerminalLogs(["shashvat@kronex-ide:~$"]);
      return;
    } else if (cmd === 'help') {
      newLogs.push(
        "Available commands:",
        "  ls              - List workspace files",
        "  cat <file>      - Output file content",
        "  npm test        - Run test suite",
        "  git status      - Show git status",
        "  clear           - Clear terminal screen",
        "  ai <prompt>     - Ask Kronex AI Assistant"
      );
    } else if (cmd === 'ls') {
      const fileNames = files.map(f => f.isFolder ? `📁 ${f.name}/` : `📄 ${f.name}`).join('   ');
      newLogs.push(fileNames);
    } else if (cmd.startsWith('cat ')) {
      const fileName = cmd.replace('cat ', '').trim();
      const target = files.find(f => f.name.toLowerCase() === fileName.toLowerCase());
      if (target) {
        newLogs.push(target.content);
      } else {
        newLogs.push(`cat: ${fileName}: No such file or directory`);
      }
    } else if (cmd === 'npm test' || cmd === 'node run') {
      newLogs.push(
        "🚀 Executing test suite...",
        "✔ App.tsx render check PASSED (12ms)",
        "✔ API telemetry route check PASSED (8ms)",
        "Snapshots: 2 passed, 2 total"
      );
    } else if (cmd === 'git status') {
      newLogs.push("On branch main. Workspace files synchronized with local storage.");
    } else if (cmd.startsWith('ai ')) {
      const prompt = cmd.replace('ai ', '');
      newLogs.push(`🤖 KRONEX AI RESPONSE: Analyzing '${prompt}'...`);
      newLogs.push(`Analysis complete: Code structure in active file is optimal. No runtime bottlenecks detected.`);
    } else {
      newLogs.push(`bash: ${cmd}: command not found. Type 'help' for options.`);
    }

    newLogs.push("shashvat@kronex-ide:~$");
    setTerminalLogs(newLogs);
    soundManager.playClick();
  };

  const handleAiSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!aiInput.trim()) return;
    const prompt = aiInput.trim();
    setAiInput('');

    soundManager.playSuccess();
    setAiAssistantLogs(prev => [
      ...prev,
      `User: ${prompt}`,
      `🤖 KRONEX AI: Based on active file '${activeFile?.name || 'Workspace'}':`,
      `1. Refactored function parameters into clean TypeScript interfaces.`,
      `2. Optimized state update lifecycle preventing unnecessary re-renders.`
    ]);
  };

  // Generate live preview code
  const getPreviewHtml = () => {
    const htmlFile = files.find(f => f.name.endsWith('.html'));
    const cssFile = files.find(f => f.name.endsWith('.css'));
    const jsFile = files.find(f => f.name === 'App.tsx' || f.name.endsWith('.js'));

    if (htmlFile) return htmlFile.content;

    return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
  <style>
    body { background-color: #080d1a; color: white; font-family: sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-center; height: 100vh; margin: 0; }
    ${cssFile ? cssFile.content : ''}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="text-center p-8 bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl max-w-lg mx-auto shadow-2xl space-y-4">
    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto font-bold text-xl">⚡</div>
    <h2 class="text-2xl font-black text-white">Kronex Live Sandbox</h2>
    <p class="text-sm text-zinc-400">Rendering live component state from <strong>${activeFile?.name || 'App.tsx'}</strong></p>
    <div class="p-3 bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono">
      STATUS: COMPILER RUNNING AT 60 FPS
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
  };

  if (!isBottomPanelOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div 
      style={{ height: `${bottomPanelHeight}px` }}
      className="bg-[#050812] border-t border-white/10 flex flex-col shrink-0 text-xs font-sans text-white select-none relative overflow-hidden"
    >
      
      {/* Panel Tab Header */}
      <div className="h-8 bg-[#060a14] border-b border-white/10 px-3 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
          {tabs.map(tab => {
            const Icon = tab.icon;
            const isActive = activeBottomTab === tab.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  soundManager.playClick();
                  setActiveBottomTab(tab.id);
                }}
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-t-lg text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center space-x-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-[#050812] text-[#00D4FF] border-t-2 border-t-[#00D4FF]'
                    : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <Icon className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isActive ? 'text-[#00D4FF]' : 'text-zinc-500'}`} />
                <span>{tab.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={toggleBottomPanel}
          className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          title="Minimize Panel"
        >
          <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Tab Body Content */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden p-3 relative">
        
        {/* Tab 1: Terminal */}
        {activeBottomTab === 'terminal' && (
          <div className="h-full flex flex-col font-mono text-xs">
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-1 text-zinc-300">
              {terminalLogs.map((log, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} className="leading-relaxed">{log}</div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleTerminalSubmit} className="flex items-center space-x-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10 shrink-0">
              <span className="text-[#00D4FF] font-bold shrink-0">shashvat@kronex-ide:~$</span>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={terminalInput}
                onChange={e => setTerminalInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="type command (e.g. ls, cat App.tsx, help)..."
                className="flex-1 bg-transparent border-none outline-none text-white font-mono text-xs"
                autoFocus
              />
            </form>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tab 2: Live Preview */}
        {activeBottomTab === 'preview' && (
          <div className="h-full w-full rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-white/10 bg-black">
            <iframe
              title="Live Sandbox Preview"
              srcDoc={getPreviewHtml()}
              className="w-full h-full border-none"
            />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tab 3: AI Copilot Assistant */}
        {activeBottomTab === 'ai-assistant' && (
          <div className="h-full flex flex-col space-y-2 font-sans">
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 text-xs">
              {aiAssistantLogs.map((log, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/5 font-mono text-zinc-300">
                  {log}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleAiSubmit} className="flex items-center space-x-2 shrink-0">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={aiInput}
                onChange={e => setAiInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ask AI Copilot to refactor, explain, or fix bugs in active file..."
                className="flex-1 bg-black/60 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 font-mono"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-1"
              >
                <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Ask AI</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tab 4: Problems */}
        {activeBottomTab === 'problems' && (
          <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-center text-zinc-500 font-mono">
            <div className="space-y-1">
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Command, Search, FileCode, Play, Save, Split, 
  Settings, RefreshCw, Sparkles, Terminal, Shield, Boxes, Send 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useKronexStore } from './useKronexStore';
import { soundManager } from '../../utils/sound';

export default function CommandPalette() {
  const { 
    isCommandPaletteOpen, 
    setCommandPaletteOpen, 
    files, 
    openFile, 
    saveActiveFile, 
    toggleSplitView, 
    toggleZenMode, 
    setActiveActivityTab, 
    setActiveBottomTab,
    resetToDefaults 
  } = useKronexStore();

  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');

  if (!isCommandPaletteOpen) return null;

  const commands = [
    { id: 'cmd-save', title: 'File: Save Active File', icon: Save, action: () => saveActiveFile() },
    { id: 'cmd-run', title: 'View: Run Live Preview Sandbox', icon: Play, action: () => setActiveBottomTab('preview') },
    { id: 'cmd-split', title: 'View: Toggle Split Editor View', icon: Split, action: () => toggleSplitView() },
    { id: 'cmd-zen', title: 'View: Toggle Zen Mode', icon: Sparkles, action: () => toggleZenMode() },
    { id: 'cmd-term', title: 'View: Open Terminal Shell', icon: Terminal, action: () => setActiveBottomTab('terminal') },
    { id: 'cmd-git', title: 'Git: Open Source Control', icon: Shield, action: () => setActiveActivityTab('git') },
    { id: 'cmd-rest', title: 'Tool: Open REST API Client', icon: Send, action: () => setActiveActivityTab('rest') },
    { id: 'cmd-ext', title: 'Tool: Open Extensions Marketplace', icon: Boxes, action: () => setActiveActivityTab('extensions') },
    { id: 'cmd-settings', title: 'Preferences: Open IDE Settings', icon: Settings, action: () => setActiveActivityTab('settings') },
    { id: 'cmd-reset', title: 'Workspace: Reset Files to Defaults', icon: RefreshCw, action: () => resetToDefaults() },
  ];

  // Also include files as search results
  const fileResults = files.filter(f => !f.isFolder && f.name.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()));

  const filteredCommands = commands.filter(c => c.title.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase()));

  const handleExecute = (action: () => void) => {
    soundManager.playSuccess();
    action();
    setCommandPaletteOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md z-50 flex items-start justify-center pt-20 p-4 font-sans select-none">
      <div 
        className="bg-[#090e1f] border border-cyan-400/30 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-xl shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,212,255,0.25)] overflow-hidden space-y-2 p-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
        onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Search input header */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 pb-3 border-b border-white/10">
          <Command className="w-5 h-5 text-[#00D4FF]" />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Type a command or file name..."
            value={query}
            onChange={e => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            autoFocus
            className="w-full bg-transparent border-none outline-none text-white text-sm font-mono placeholder:text-zinc-500"
          />
          <button
            onClick={() => setCommandPaletteOpen(false)}
            className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-white px-2 text-xs font-mono"
          >
            ESC
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Results */}
        <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto space-y-1 pt-1">
          {/* File Results */}
          {fileResults.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 block uppercase px-2 font-bold">Files</span>
              {fileResults.map(f => (
                <button
                  key={f.id}
                  onClick={() => handleExecute(() => openFile(f.id))}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-cyan-500/20 text-left flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-white transition-all cursor-pointer group"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <FileCode className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
                    <span>{f.path}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 group-hover:text-cyan-300">Open File</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Command Results */}
          <div className="space-y-1 pt-2">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 block uppercase px-2 font-bold">Commands</span>
            {filteredCommands.map(cmd => {
              const Icon = cmd.icon;
              return (
                <button
                  key={cmd.id}
                  onClick={() => handleExecute(cmd.action)}
                  className="w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] hover:bg-purple-500/20 text-left flex items-center space-x-3 text-xs font-mono text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Icon className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
                  <span>{cmd.title}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import Editor, { OnMount } from '@monaco-editor/react';
import { 
  FileCode, X, Copy, Check, Split, Sparkles, 
  Play, Code2, ChevronRight, Save, Eye 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useKronexStore } from './useKronexStore';
import { soundManager } from '../../utils/sound';

export default function EditorArea() {
  const { 
    files, 
    openFileIds, 
    activeFileId, 
    setActiveFile, 
    closeFile, 
    updateFileContent, 
    settings,
    isSplitView,
    splitFileId,
    setSplitFileId,
    setActiveBottomTab
  } = useKronexStore();

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const editorRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const splitEditorRef = useRef<any>(null);

  const openFiles = files.filter(f => openFileIds.includes(f.id));
  const activeFile = files.find(f => f.id === activeFileId);
  const splitFile = files.find(f => f.id === splitFileId) || openFiles[0];

  const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false);

  // ResizeObserver to trigger monaco layout automatically
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      if (editorRef.current) {
        editorRef.current.layout();
      }
      if (splitEditorRef.current) {
        splitEditorRef.current.layout();
      }
    });
    observer.observe(containerRef.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const handleEditorMount: OnMount = (editor) => {
    editorRef.current = editor;
    setTimeout(() => editor.layout(), 50);
  };

  const handleSplitEditorMount: OnMount = (editor) => {
    splitEditorRef.current = editor;
    setTimeout(() => editor.layout(), 50);
  };

  const handleCopyCode = (content: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(content);
    setCopied(true);
    soundManager.playSuccess();
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  if (!activeFile) {
    return (
      <div className="flex-1 bg-[#080d1a] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-8 text-zinc-500 font-sans space-y-4">
        <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-3xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-400">
          <Code2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-pulse" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">No File Open</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 max-w-sm mt-1">
            Select a file from the explorer on the left or press <kbd className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-black border border-white/10 text-cyan-400 font-mono">Ctrl+P</kbd> to search files.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Map file language to Monaco language mode
  const getMonacoLanguage = (lang: string) => {
    switch (lang.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'typescript': return 'typescript';
      case 'javascript': return 'javascript';
      case 'python': return 'python';
      case 'html': return 'html';
      case 'css': return 'css';
      case 'sql': return 'sql';
      case 'json': return 'json';
      case 'markdown': return 'markdown';
      case 'rust': return 'rust';
      default: return 'plaintext';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={containerRef} className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 min-h-0 bg-[#080d1a] relative overflow-hidden">
      
      {/* Tab Bar Header */}
      <div className="h-9 bg-[#060a14] border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between px-2 overflow-x-auto shrink-0 select-none no-scrollbar">
        
        {/* Active Open Tabs */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 min-w-0">
          {openFiles.map(file => {
            const isActive = file.id === activeFileId;
            return (
              <div
                key={file.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  soundManager.playClick();
                  setActiveFile(file.id);
                }}
                className={`group px-3 py-1.5 rounded-t-xl border-t border-x text-xs font-mono flex items-center space-x-2 cursor-pointer transition-all shrink-0 ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-[#080d1a] border-cyan-400/40 text-[#00D4FF] font-bold shadow-[0_-2px_10px_rgba(0,212,255,0.15)]'
                    : 'bg-black/40 border-transparent text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5'
                }`}
              >
                <FileCode className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isActive ? 'text-[#00D4FF]' : 'text-zinc-500'}`} />
                <span className="truncate max-w-[120px]">{file.name}</span>

                {file.isUnsaved ? (
                  <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 shrink-0" title="Unsaved" />
                ) : (
                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      closeFile(file.id);
                    }}
                    className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-500 hover:text-white opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                    title="Close Tab"
                  >
                    <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Action Controls Right */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 shrink-0 pl-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => handleCopyCode(activeFile.content)}
            className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer text-xs font-mono flex items-center space-x-1"
            title="Copy File Content"
          >
            {copied ? <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              soundManager.playClick();
              setActiveBottomTab('preview');
            }}
            className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-400/30 text-cyan-300 font-mono text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center space-x-1 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 cursor-pointer"
            title="Live Preview"
          >
            <Eye className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>Preview</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Editor Body Grid (Single or Split Pane) */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex min-h-0 relative">
        
        {/* Pane 1 (Primary Active File) */}
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 min-h-0 relative">
          <Editor
            height="100%"
            language={getMonacoLanguage(activeFile.language)}
            value={activeFile.content}
            theme="vs-dark"
            onMount={handleEditorMount}
            onChange={(val) => updateFileContent(activeFile.id, val || '')}
            options={{
              fontSize: settings.fontSize,
              tabSize: settings.tabSize,
              wordWrap: settings.wordWrap,
              minimap: { enabled: settings.minimap },
              fontFamily: settings.fontFamily,
              lineNumbers: settings.lineNumbers,
              smoothScrolling: true,
              cursorBlinking: 'smooth',
              cursorSmoothCaretAnimation: 'on',
              padding: { top: 12 },
              scrollBeyondLastLine: false,
              automaticLayout: true,
            }}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Pane 2 (Split View if Enabled) */}
        {isSplitView && splitFile && (
          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 min-h-0 border-l border-white/10 relative">
            {/* Split Header */}
            <div className="h-7 bg-[#050812] border-b border-white/10 px-3 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-zinc-400 shrink-0">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <Split className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
                <span className="text-white font-bold">{splitFile.name}</span>
              </div>
              <select
                value={splitFile.id}
                onChange={e => setSplitFileId(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-black border border-white/20 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-cyan-300 font-mono outline-none"
              >
                {files.filter(f => !f.isFolder).map(f => (
                  <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>{f.name}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <Editor
              height="100%"
              language={getMonacoLanguage(splitFile.language)}
              value={splitFile.content}
              theme="vs-dark"
              onMount={handleSplitEditorMount}
              onChange={(val) => updateFileContent(splitFile.id, val || '')}
              options={{
                fontSize: settings.fontSize,
                tabSize: settings.tabSize,
                wordWrap: settings.wordWrap,
                minimap: { enabled: false },
                fontFamily: settings.fontFamily,
                lineNumbers: settings.lineNumbers,
                automaticLayout: true,
              }}
            />
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

FILE: src/components/kronex-code/KronexCodeIDE.tsx

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import TitleBar from './TitleBar';
import ActivityBar from './ActivityBar';
import SidebarExplorer from './SidebarExplorer';
import SidebarSearch from './SidebarSearch';
import SidebarGit from './SidebarGit';
import SidebarExtensions from './SidebarExtensions';
import SidebarRestClient from './SidebarRestClient';
import SidebarDbExplorer from './SidebarDbExplorer';
import SidebarPerfMonitor from './SidebarPerfMonitor';
import SidebarSettings from './SidebarSettings';
import SidebarCopilot from './SidebarCopilot';
import EditorArea from './EditorArea';
import BottomPanel from './BottomPanel';
import StatusBar from './StatusBar';
import CommandPalette from './CommandPalette';
import { useKronexStore } from './useKronexStore';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';

export default function KronexCodeIDE() {
  const { 
    activeActivityTab, 
    isSidebarOpen, 
    sidebarWidth,
    setSidebarWidth,
    isBottomPanelOpen,
    bottomPanelHeight,
    setBottomPanelHeight,
    isZenMode, 
    isFullscreen,
    saveActiveFile, 
    setCommandPaletteOpen,
    toggleSidebar,
    toggleBottomPanel 
  } = useKronexStore();

  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [isDraggingSidebar, setIsDraggingSidebar] = useState(false);
  const [isDraggingBottomPanel, setIsDraggingBottomPanel] = useState(false);
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState<boolean>(() => typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768);

  // Mobile detection & resize listener
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < 768);
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, []);

  // Mouse drag listeners for sidebar and bottom panel resizing
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (isDraggingSidebar && containerRef.current) {
        const rect = containerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Activity bar width is 48px
        const newWidth = e.clientX - rect.left - 48;
        setSidebarWidth(newWidth);
      }
      if (isDraggingBottomPanel && containerRef.current) {
        const rect = containerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        // Status bar height is ~24px
        const newHeight = rect.bottom - 24 - e.clientY;
        setBottomPanelHeight(newHeight);
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDraggingSidebar(false);
      setIsDraggingBottomPanel(false);
      document.body.classList.remove('no-select');
    };

    if (isDraggingSidebar || isDraggingBottomPanel) {
      document.body.classList.add('no-select');
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    }

    return () => {
      document.body.classList.remove('no-select');
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [isDraggingSidebar, isDraggingBottomPanel, setSidebarWidth, setBottomPanelHeight]);

  // Keyboard shortcuts
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      // Ctrl+S / Cmd+S
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 's') {
        e.preventDefault();
        saveActiveFile();
      }
      // Ctrl+P / Cmd+P
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'p') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setCommandPaletteOpen(true);
      }
      // Ctrl+B / Cmd+B
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'b') {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleSidebar();
      }
      // Ctrl+`
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === '`') {
        e.preventDefault();
        toggleBottomPanel();
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [saveActiveFile, setCommandPaletteOpen, toggleSidebar, toggleBottomPanel]);

  // Render sidebar tab
  const renderSidebarContent = () => {
    switch (activeActivityTab) {
      case 'explorer': return <SidebarExplorer />;
      case 'search': return <SidebarSearch />;
      case 'git': return <SidebarGit />;
      case 'extensions': return <SidebarExtensions />;
      case 'rest': return <SidebarRestClient />;
      case 'database': return <SidebarDbExplorer />;
      case 'performance': return <SidebarPerfMonitor />;
      case 'copilot': return <SidebarCopilot />;
      case 'settings': return <SidebarSettings />;
      default: return <SidebarExplorer />;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div 
      ref={containerRef}
      className={`w-full h-full flex-1 flex flex-col font-sans select-none overflow-hidden text-white bg-[#050812] ${
        isFullscreen ? 'fixed inset-0 z-[99999] w-screen h-screen' : 'relative'
      }`}
    >
      {/* Top Title Bar */}
      {!isZenMode && <TitleBar />}

      {/* IDE Main Middle Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex min-w-0 min-h-0 relative overflow-hidden">
        
        {/* Activity Bar */}
        {!isZenMode && <ActivityBar />}

        {/* Desktop Collapsible & Resizable Left Sidebar */}
        {!isZenMode && isSidebarOpen && !isMobile && (
          <>
            <div 
              style={{ width: `${sidebarWidth}px` }}
              className="bg-[#060a17] border-r border-white/10 flex flex-col shrink-0 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar relative"
            >
              {renderSidebarContent()}
            </div>

            {/* Vertical Resize Handle */}
            <div 
              onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setIsDraggingSidebar(true); }}
              className={`ide-resize-handle-h ${isDraggingSidebar ? 'active' : ''}`}
              title="Drag to resize sidebar"
            />
          </>
        )}

        {/* Mobile Slide-Over Sidebar Drawer */}
        {!isZenMode && isSidebarOpen && isMobile && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex">
            <div 
              className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm"
              onClick={toggleSidebar}
            />
            <div className="relative z-10 w-72 max-w-[80vw] bg-[#060a17] border-r border-white/10 flex flex-col h-full overflow-y-auto shadow-2xl">
              <div className="p-2 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-cyan-400">Navigation</span>
                <button 
                  onClick={toggleSidebar} 
                  className="p-1 rounded text-zinc-400 hover:text-white"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
              {renderSidebarContent()}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Center Editor & Bottom Panel Container */}
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 min-h-0 relative overflow-hidden">
          
          {/* Main Editor Canvas */}
          <EditorArea />

          {/* Horizontal Drag Handle for Bottom Panel */}
          {!isZenMode && isBottomPanelOpen && (
            <div 
              onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setIsDraggingBottomPanel(true); }}
              className={`ide-resize-handle-v ${isDraggingBottomPanel ? 'active' : ''}`}
              title="Drag to resize bottom panel"
            />
          )}

          {/* Collapsible Terminal & Tools Panel */}
          {!isZenMode && <BottomPanel />}

        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Bottom Status Bar */}
      {!isZenMode && <StatusBar />}

      {/* Command Palette Overlay */}
      <CommandPalette />

    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Sparkles, Bot, Cpu, Zap, Code2, Bug, CheckCircle2, Copy, 
  Send, RefreshCw, FileCode, Layers, Mic, Image, FileText, 
  Settings, ChevronDown, Check, ArrowRight, Wand2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useKronexStore } from './useKronexStore';
import { soundManager } from '../../utils/sound';

type AIModel = 'gemini-2.5-flash' | 'gemini-2.5-pro' | 'gpt-4o' | 'claude-3.5-sonnet' | 'deepseek-r1' | 'grok-3' | 'ollama-local';

type AgentMode = 'autonomous' | 'refactor' | 'debugger' | 'test-gen' | 'architect' | 'vision-code' | 'voice-code';

interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  sender: 'user' | 'assistant';
  text: string;
  codeSnippet?: string;
  targetFile?: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

export default function SidebarCopilot() {

  const [selectedModel, setSelectedModel] = useState<AIModel>('gemini-2.5-flash');
  const [agentMode, setAgentMode] = useState<AgentMode>('autonomous');
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([
    {
      id: '1',
      sender: 'assistant',
```
