```tsx
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
    }
  ]);
  const [inputPrompt, setInputPrompt] = useState('');
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isVoiceActive, setIsVoiceActive] = useState(false);

  const activeFile = files.find(f => f.id === activeFileId);

  const modelsList: { id: AIModel; name: string; provider: string; tag: string }[] = [
    { id: 'gemini-2.5-flash', name: 'Gemini 2.5 Flash', provider: 'Google AI', tag: 'Fastest' },
    { id: 'gemini-2.5-pro', name: 'Gemini 2.5 Pro', provider: 'Google AI', tag: 'Deep Logic' },
    { id: 'gpt-4o', name: 'GPT-4o Omnimodal', provider: 'OpenAI', tag: 'High Precision' },
    { id: 'claude-3.5-sonnet', name: 'Claude 3.5 Sonnet', provider: 'Anthropic', tag: 'Code Master' },
    { id: 'deepseek-r1', name: 'DeepSeek R1', provider: 'DeepSeek', tag: 'Reasoning' },
    { id: 'grok-3', name: 'Grok 3', provider: 'xAI', tag: 'Realtime' },
    { id: 'ollama-local', name: 'Ollama Llama 3.3', provider: 'Local GPU', tag: 'Offline' },
  ];

  const agentModes: { id: AgentMode; label: string; icon: React.FC<{ className?: string }>; desc: string }[] = [
    { id: 'autonomous', label: 'Autonomous Coder', icon: Wand2, desc: 'Generates full modules & file structures' },
    { id: 'refactor', label: 'Refactor Engine', icon: Code2, desc: 'Optimizes logic, type safety & readability' },
    { id: 'debugger', label: 'Smart Debugger', icon: Bug, desc: 'Scans & fixes runtime/syntax errors' },
    { id: 'test-gen', label: 'Test Suite Gen', icon: CheckCircle2, desc: 'Generates unit & integration tests' },
    { id: 'architect', label: 'System Architect', icon: Layers, desc: 'Designs DB schemas & API architecture' },
    { id: 'vision-code', label: 'Mockup-to-Code', icon: Image, desc: 'Converts screenshots into React UI' },
  ];

  const quickPrompts = [
    "Refactor active file for maximum performance",
    "Add complete TypeScript interfaces & type guards",
    "Generate comprehensive Vitest unit test suite",
    "Scan for runtime memory leaks or anti-patterns",
    "Generate full REST API endpoint with error handling"
  ];

  const handleSendPrompt = (promptText?: string) => {
    const query = promptText || inputPrompt;
    if (!query.trim()) return;

    soundManager.playClick();
    const userMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      sender: 'user',
      text: query,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
    };

    setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMsg]);
    if (!promptText) setInputPrompt('');
    setIsGenerating(true);

    // Simulate AI model processing with context awareness
    setTimeout(() => {
      soundManager.playSuccess();
      let responseText = '';
      let snippet = '';

      if (agentMode === 'refactor') {
        responseText = `⚡ Refactored code logic for model [${selectedModel.toUpperCase()}]. Added memoization, clean TypeScript declarations, and strict error handling bounds.`;
        snippet = `// Refactored by Kronex AI (${selectedModel})\nexport interface KronexData {\n  id: string;\n  status: 'active' | 'idle' | 'executing';\n  timestamp: number;\n}\n\nexport const processWorkspaceData = (data: KronexData[]): KronexData[] => {\n  return data.filter(item => item.status !== 'idle').map(item => ({\n    ...item,\n    timestamp: Date.now()\n  }));\n};`;
      } else if (agentMode === 'debugger') {
        responseText = `🐞 Debugger Scan complete using ${selectedModel}. No fatal memory leaks detected. Fixed edge case where active state could become undefined.`;
        snippet = `try {\n  if (!activeFileId) throw new Error("No active file selected in IDE");\n  // Safe state execution\n} catch (err) {\n  console.error("Kronex IDE Debugger caught error:", err);\n}`;
      } else if (agentMode === 'test-gen') {
        responseText = `🧪 Generated 100% coverage unit test suite using ${selectedModel}:`;
        snippet = `import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';\n\ndescribe('Kronex IDE Engine', () => {\n  it('should maintain state integrity under high load', () => {\n    const state = { activeTab: 'explorer', filesCount: 12 };\n    expect(state.filesCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n  });\n});`;
      } else {
        responseText = `🚀 KRONEX AI (${selectedModel}) processed your prompt: "${query}". Context loaded: 128k tokens (100% workspace indexed). Here is the optimized solution:`;
        snippet = `// Generated by Kronex AI Agent\nimport React from 'react';\n\nexport const KronexModule: React.FC = () => {\n  return (\n    <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#080d1a] border border-cyan-500/30 text-white font-mono text-xs shadow-2xl">\n      <p className="text-cyan-400 font-bold">⚡ Active Agent Module Synchronized</p>\n    </div>\n  );\n};`;
      }

      const assistantMsg: ChatMessage = {
        id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(),
        sender: 'assistant',
        text: responseText,
        codeSnippet: snippet,
        targetFile: activeFile?.name || 'App.tsx',
        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
      };

      setMessages(prev => [...prev, assistantMsg]);
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }, 900);
  };

  const handleApplySnippet = (snippet: string) => {
    if (!activeFileId) return;
    updateFileContent(activeFileId, snippet);
    soundManager.playSuccess();
  };

  const handleCreateNewFileWithSnippet = (snippet: string) => {
    const fileName = `KronexGenerated_${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}.tsx`;
    createFile(fileName, false, null);
    const newFiles = useKronexStore.getState().files;
    const created = newFiles.find(f => f.name === fileName);
    if (created) {
      updateFileContent(created.id, snippet);
    }
    soundManager.playSuccess();
  };

  const handleCopy = (id: string, code: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    setCopiedId(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 1800);
  };

  const handleVoiceToggle = () => {
    setIsVoiceActive(!isVoiceActive);
    soundManager.playClick();
    if (!isVoiceActive) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        setInputPrompt("Build an interactive dashboard component with realtime telemetry charts");
        setIsVoiceActive(false);
      }, 2500);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-[#060a17] text-white select-none font-sans overflow-hidden">
      
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="p-3 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-[#050812]">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(0,212,255,0.4)]">
            <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-black font-bold" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-display font-extrabold text-xs tracking-wider text-white">
              AI COPILOT <span className="text-[#00D4FF]">AGENT</span>
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono">Multi-Model Engine v2.5</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 font-mono text-[9px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping" />
            128K CTX
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Model Selector Selector */}
      <div className="p-2.5 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#080d1a] shrink-0 space-y-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
          <span className="text-zinc-400 font-mono font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
            <Cpu className="w-3 h-3 text-[#00D4FF]" /> Active Model
          </span>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-[#00D4FF] font-mono font-bold">Auto-Routing</span>
        </div>

        <select
          value={selectedModel}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setSelectedModel(e.target.value as AIModel);
            soundManager.playClick();
          }}
          className="w-full bg-[#050812] border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-white outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 font-mono cursor-pointer"
        >
          {modelsList.map(m => (
            <option key={m.id} value={m.id} className="bg-[#080d1a] text-white">
              {m.name} ({m.provider}) — [{m.tag}]
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>

        {/* Agent Modes Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 pt-1">
          {agentModes.map(mode => {
            const Icon = mode.icon;
            const isActive = agentMode === mode.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={mode.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  setAgentMode(mode.id);
                  soundManager.playClick();
                }}
                className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg border text-left flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-1 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-cyan-500/20 border-cyan-400/80 text-cyan-300 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,212,255,0.2)]'
                    : 'bg-white/5 border-white/5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10'
                }`}
                title={mode.desc}
              >
                <Icon className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isActive ? 'text-[#00D4FF]' : 'text-zinc-400'}`} />
                <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold truncate w-full text-center">{mode.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Chat Output Stream */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-3 no-scrollbar">
        {messages.map(msg => (
          <div
            key={msg.id}
            className={`flex flex-col space-y-1 ${
              msg.sender === 'user' ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-[10px] text-zinc-400 font-mono px-1">
              <span>{msg.sender === 'user' ? 'You' : `Kronex AI (${selectedModel})`}</span>
              <span>•</span>
              <span>{msg.timestamp}</span>
            </div>

            <div
              className={`p-3 rounded-2xl text-xs leading-relaxed max-w-[95%] shadow-lg ${
                msg.sender === 'user'
                  ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF]/30 to-[#00D4FF]/30 border border-cyan-400/40 text-white font-medium rounded-tr-none'
                  : 'bg-[#0a0f24] border border-white/10 text-zinc-200 rounded-tl-none font-sans'
              }`}
            >
              <p>{msg.text}</p>

              {/* Code snippet block if provided */}
              {msg.codeSnippet && (
                <div className="mt-2.5 rounded-xl border border-cyan-500/30 bg-[#040711] overflow-hidden">
                  <div className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-[#060a17] border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-cyan-400 font-bold">
                      <FileCode className="w-3 h-3" /> {msg.targetFile || 'Generated Code'}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleCopy(msg.id, msg.codeSnippet!)}
                      className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {copiedId === msg.id ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
                      <span>{copiedId === msg.id ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <pre className="p-2.5 font-mono text-[11px] text-cyan-200 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
                    {msg.codeSnippet}
                  </pre>
                  
                  <div className="p-2 bg-[#060a17] border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-end space-x-2">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleCreateNewFileWithSnippet(msg.codeSnippet!)}
                      className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/15 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-zinc-300 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Create File
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleApplySnippet(msg.codeSnippet!)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-black font-mono font-bold text-[10px] cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,212,255,0.3)] hover:opacity-95"
                    >
                      Apply to {activeFile?.name || 'Active File'}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}

        {isGenerating && (
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-cyan-400 text-xs font-mono p-2 bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-xl animate-pulse">
            <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-[#00D4FF]" />
            <span>AI Agent synthesizing response with {selectedModel}...</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Quick Prompt Suggestions */}
      <div className="px-3 py-2 border-t border-white/10 bg-[#050812] shrink-0 space-y-1.5">
        <div className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
          Quick AI Presets
        </div>
        <div className="flex space-x-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar pb-1">
          {quickPrompts.map((prompt, i) => (
            <button
              key={i}
              onClick={() => handleSendPrompt(prompt)}
              className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white/5 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 border border-white/10 hover:border-cyan-400/50 text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-300 hover:text-cyan-300 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
            >
              ⚡ {prompt}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Input Control Box */}
      <div className="p-3 border-t border-white/10 bg-[#060a17] shrink-0 space-y-2">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 bg-[#040711] border border-white/15 focus-within:border-cyan-400 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 transition-colors">
          <input
            type="text"
            value={inputPrompt}
            onChange={(e) => setInputPrompt(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSendPrompt()}
            placeholder={`Ask AI Agent (${agentMode})...`}
            className="flex-1 bg-transparent border-none outline-none text-xs text-white font-mono placeholder:text-zinc-600"
          />

          <button
            onClick={handleVoiceToggle}
            className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              isVoiceActive ? 'bg-red-500/30 border-red-500 text-red-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
            title="Voice Coding Command Listener"
          >
            <Mic className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => handleSendPrompt()}
            disabled={!inputPrompt.trim() || isGenerating}
            className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-black font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              !inputPrompt.trim() || isGenerating ? 'opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed' : 'hover:scale-105 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(0,212,255,0.4)]'
            }`}
          >
            <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono">
          <span>Target: <strong className="text-zinc-300">{activeFile?.name || 'Workspace'}</strong></span>
          <span>Shortcut: <kbd className="px-1 py-0.5 bg-white/10 rounded text-[9px] text-zinc-300">Ctrl+Enter</kbd></span>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Database, Table, Play, CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { useKronexStore } from './useKronexStore';
import { soundManager } from '../../utils/sound';

export default function SidebarDbExplorer() {
  const { dbTables, activeDbTableName } = useKronexStore();

  const [activeTable, setActiveTable] = useState(activeDbTableName);
  const [sqlQuery, setSqlQuery] = useState(`SELECT * FROM ${activeTable} LIMIT 10;`);
  const [queryResult, setQueryResult] = useState<any[] | null>(null);

  const tableData = dbTables.find(t => t.name === activeTable) || dbTables[0];

  const handleRunQuery = () => {
    soundManager.playSuccess();
    setQueryResult(tableData.rows);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-3 space-y-4 text-xs font-sans text-white select-none">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-white/10">
        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-extrabold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
          Database Explorer (Postgres)
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Tables List */}
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 block uppercase">Tables ({dbTables.length})</span>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          {dbTables.map(t => (
            <button
              key={t.name}
              onClick={() => {
                soundManager.playClick();
                setActiveTable(t.name);
                setSqlQuery(`SELECT * FROM ${t.name} LIMIT 10;`);
                setQueryResult(null);
              }}
              className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs flex items-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                activeTable === t.name
                  ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 font-bold'
                  : 'bg-white/5 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Table className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{t.name} ({t.rowCount})</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* SQL Query Runner */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500 block uppercase">SQL Query Runner</span>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <textarea
            value={sqlQuery}
            onChange={e => setSqlQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-black/80 border border-white/15 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-amber-300 font-mono outline-none focus:border-amber-400 resize-none h-16"
          />
          <button
            onClick={handleRunQuery}
            className="w-full py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300 font-bold flex items-center justify-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-amber-300" />
            <span>Execute Query</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table schema & rows view */}
      <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10 font-mono text-[11px]">
        <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 block uppercase">
          Schema: {tableData.name}
        </span>

        <div className="bg-black/60 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2 space-y-1">
          {tableData.columns.map(col => (
            <div key={col.name} className="flex justify-between text-zinc-300 text-[10.5px]">
              <span className="font-bold text-cyan-400">{col.name} {col.pk && '🔑'}</span>
              <span className="text-zinc-500">{col.type}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {queryResult && (
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center space-x-1">
              <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>Query Returned {queryResult.length} rows:</span>
            </span>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto bg-black/80 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2 max-h-40">
              <pre className="text-[10px] text-zinc-300 whitespace-pre">
                {JSON.stringify(queryResult, null, 2)}
              </pre>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

FILE: src/components/kronex-code/SidebarExplorer.tsx

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Folder, FolderOpen, File, FilePlus, FolderPlus, 
  Trash2, Edit3, ChevronRight, ChevronDown, Sparkles, Plus, MoreVertical 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useKronexStore } from './useKronexStore';
import { FileItem } from './types';
import { soundManager } from '../../utils/sound';

export default function SidebarExplorer() {
  const { 
    files, 
    openFile, 
    createFile, 
    deleteFile, 
    renameFile, 
    toggleFolder, 
    activeFileId 
  } = useKronexStore();

  const [newFileName, setNewFileName] = useState('');
  const [isCreatingFile, setIsCreatingFile] = useState<boolean | null>(null); // true = file, false = folder
  const [targetFolderId, setTargetFolderId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [renamingFileId, setRenamingFileId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [renamingName, setRenamingName] = useState('');

  const rootItems = files.filter(f => f.parentId === null);

  const handleCreateSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newFileName.trim()) return;
    soundManager.playSuccess();
    createFile(newFileName.trim(), isCreatingFile === false, targetFolderId);
    setNewFileName('');
    setIsCreatingFile(null);
  };

  const handleRenameSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!renamingName.trim()) return;
    soundManager.playSuccess();
    renameFile(id, renamingName.trim());
    setRenamingFileId(null);
  };

  const renderItem = (item: FileItem, depth: number = 0) => {
    const isSelected = activeFileId === item.id;
    const children = files.filter(f => f.parentId === item.id);

    if (item.isFolder) {
      return (
        <div key={item.id} className="space-y-0.5">
          <div 
            style={{ paddingLeft: `${depth * 12 + 8}px` }}
            className="group flex items-center justify-between py-1 px-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-sans text-zinc-300 hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
            onClick={() => {
              soundManager.playClick();
              toggleFolder(item.id);
            }}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 min-w-0">
              {item.isOpen ? (
                <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 shrink-0" />
              )}
              {item.isOpen ? (
                <FolderOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <Folder className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400/80 shrink-0" />
              )}
              <span className="font-bold text-white truncate">{item.name}</span>
            </div>

            <div className="hidden group-hover:flex items-center space-x-1 shrink-0">
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  setTargetFolderId(item.id);
                  setIsCreatingFile(true);
                }}
                className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white"
                title="New File in Folder"
              >
                <FilePlus className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  if (confirm(`Delete folder '${item.name}' and its contents?`)) {
                    deleteFile(item.id);
                  }
                }}
                className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-400"
                title="Delete Folder"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Render children if folder is open */}
          {item.isOpen && (
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              {children.map(child => renderItem(child, depth + 1))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }

    // Render File
    return (
      <div 
        key={item.id}
        style={{ paddingLeft: `${depth * 12 + 20}px` }}
        onClick={() => {
          soundManager.playClick();
          openFile(item.id);
        }}
        className={`group flex items-center justify-between py-1 px-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-sans cursor-pointer transition-all ${
          isSelected 
            ? 'bg-cyan-500/15 text-[#00D4FF] border border-cyan-500/30 font-bold shadow-sm' 
            : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/[0.04]'
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 min-w-0">
          <File className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 ${isSelected ? 'text-[#00D4FF]' : 'text-zinc-500'}`} />
          
          {renamingFileId === item.id ? (
            <form onSubmit={(e) => handleRenameSubmit(e, item.id)} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={renamingName}
                onChange={e => setRenamingName(e.target.value)}
                autoFocus
                onBlur={() => setRenamingFileId(null)}
                className="bg-black border border-cyan-400 text-white text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded outline-none w-28"
              />
            </form>
          ) : (
            <span className="truncate">{item.name}</span>
          )}

          {item.isUnsaved && (
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 shrink-0" title="Unsaved" />
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="hidden group-hover:flex items-center space-x-1 shrink-0">
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              setRenamingFileId(item.id);
              setRenamingName(item.name);
            }}
            className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white"
            title="Rename File"
          >
            <Edit3 className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              deleteFile(item.id);
            }}
            className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-rose-400"
            title="Delete File"
          >
            <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-3 space-y-3 font-sans text-white text-xs select-none">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-white/10">
        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-extrabold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
          Explorer: Workspace
        </span>

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setTargetFolderId(null);
              setIsCreatingFile(true);
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="New File"
          >
            <FilePlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setTargetFolderId(null);
              setIsCreatingFile(false);
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="New Folder"
          >
            <FolderPlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* New File / Folder Form Input */}
      {isCreatingFile !== null && (
        <form onSubmit={handleCreateSubmit} className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-cyan-400/50 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-cyan-400">
            <span>{isCreatingFile ? 'Create New File' : 'Create New Folder'}</span>
            <button 
              type="button" 
              onClick={() => setIsCreatingFile(null)} 
              className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-white"
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>

          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder={isCreatingFile ? 'e.g. index.ts' : 'e.g. components'}
            value={newFileName}
            onChange={e => setNewFileName(e.target.value)}
            autoFocus
            className="w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/20 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-white outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 font-mono"
          />

          <button
            type="submit"
            className="w-full py-1 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white font-bold text-[11px] cursor-pointer"
          >
            Confirm
          </button>
        </form>
      )}

      {/* File Tree List */}
      <div className="space-y-1">
        {rootItems.map(item => renderItem(item, 0))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { GitBranch, GitCommit, GitPullRequest, Check, Plus, RefreshCw, UploadCloud } from 'lucide-react';
import { useKronexStore } from './useKronexStore';
import { soundManager } from '../../utils/sound';

export default function SidebarGit() {
  const { 
    files, 
    gitBranch, 
    setGitBranch, 
    commits, 
    commitChanges 
  } = useKronexStore();

  const [commitMsg, setCommitMsg] = useState('');
  const [isPushing, setIsPushing] = useState(false);

  const unsavedFiles = files.filter(f => !f.isFolder && f.isUnsaved);

  const handleCommit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!commitMsg.trim()) return;
    soundManager.playSuccess();
    commitChanges(commitMsg.trim());
    setCommitMsg('');
  };

  const handlePush = () => {
    setIsPushing(true);
    soundManager.playSuccess();
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsPushing(false);
      alert(`Pushed latest commit to origin/${gitBranch} successfully!`);
    }, 1200);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-3 space-y-4 text-xs font-sans text-white select-none">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-white/10">
        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-extrabold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
          Source Control
        </span>

        <select
          value={gitBranch}
          onChange={e => setGitBranch(e.target.value)}
          className="bg-black border border-white/20 rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-cyan-400 font-mono outline-none cursor-pointer"
        >
          <option value="main">branch: main</option>
          <option value="develop">branch: develop</option>
          <option value="feature/v2.5">branch: feature/v2.5</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* Commit Input Box */}
      <form onSubmit={handleCommit} className="space-y-2">
        <textarea
          placeholder="Commit message (e.g., feat: add neural router)"
          value={commitMsg}
          onChange={e => setCommitMsg(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/15 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-white outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 font-mono resize-none h-20"
        />

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={!commitMsg.trim()}
            className="flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            <GitCommit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Commit to {gitBranch}</span>
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePush}
            disabled={isPushing}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300 font-bold cursor-pointer"
            title="Push to Remote"
          >
            <UploadCloud className={`w-4 h-4 ${isPushing ? 'animate-bounce' : ''}`} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>

      {/* Changes list */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 block uppercase font-bold">
          Changes ({unsavedFiles.length})
        </span>

        {unsavedFiles.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/5 text-center text-zinc-500 text-[11px] font-mono">
            Working directory clean ✨
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-1">
            {unsavedFiles.map(f => (
              <div key={f.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 font-mono text-[11px]">
                <span className="text-amber-300 truncate">{f.path}</span>
                <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">M</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Commit History Log */}
      <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 block uppercase font-bold">
          Commit History
        </span>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          {commits.map(c => (
            <div key={c.id} className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/5 font-mono text-[11px] space-y-1">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-cyan-400 font-bold">
                <span className="truncate">{c.message}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-zinc-500 text-[10px]">
                <span>{c.id}</span>
                <span>{c.timestamp}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Activity, Cpu, HardDrive, Zap, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';

export default function SidebarPerfMonitor() {
  const [cpuUsage, setCpuUsage] = useState(12);
  const [memoryMb, setMemoryMb] = useState(148);
  const [fps, setFps] = useState(60);

  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setCpuUsage(Math.floor(8 + Math.random() * 15));
      setMemoryMb(Math.floor(140 + Math.random() * 20));
      setFps(Math.floor(58 + Math.random() * 3));
    }, 1500);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="p-3 space-y-4 text-xs font-sans text-white select-none">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-white/10">
```

FILE: src/components/kronex-code/SidebarRestClient.tsx

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Send, Play, Clock, FileCode, CheckCircle, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { useKronexStore } from './useKronexStore';
import { soundManager } from '../../utils/sound';

export default function SidebarRestClient() {
  const { restRequests, activeRestRequestId, setActiveRestRequestId, updateRestRequest } = useKronexStore();

  const req = restRequests.find(r => r.id === activeRestRequestId) || restRequests[0];

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleSendRequest = async () => {
    if (!req.url) return;
    setIsLoading(true);
    soundManager.playClick();

    const startTime = performance.now();
    try {
      const headersObj: Record<string, string> = {};
      req.headers.forEach(h => {
        if (h.key && h.value) headersObj[h.key] = h.value;
      });

      const options: RequestInit = {
        method: req.method,
        headers: headersObj,
      };

      if (['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH'].includes(req.method) && req.body) {
        options.body = req.body;
      }

      const res = await fetch(req.url, options);
      const endTime = performance.now();
      const latency = Math.round(endTime - startTime);

      let data: any;
      const contentType = res.headers.get('content-type');
      if (contentType && contentType.includes('application/json')) {
        data = await res.json();
      } else {
        data = await res.text();
      }

      updateRestRequest({
        ...req,
        response: {
          status: res.status,
          statusText: res.statusText || (res.ok ? 'OK' : 'Error'),
          time: latency,
          size: `${JSON.stringify(data).length} B`,
          data
        }
      });
      soundManager.playSuccess();
    } catch (err: any) {
      const endTime = performance.now();
      updateRestRequest({
        ...req,
        response: {
          status: 0,
          statusText: 'Network / CORS Error',
          time: Math.round(endTime - startTime),
          size: '0 B',
          data: { error: err.message || 'Failed to fetch resource' }
        }
      });
      soundManager.playError();
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-3 space-y-4 text-xs font-sans text-white select-none">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-white/10">
        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-extrabold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
          REST API Client (Postman)
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Select request */}
      <div className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-1 border-b border-white/5">
        {restRequests.map(r => (
          <button
            key={r.id}
            onClick={() => setActiveRestRequestId(r.id)}
            className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold shrink-0 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeRestRequestId === r.id ? 'bg-cyan-500/20 text-[#00D4FF] border border-cyan-400/40' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <span className={r.method === 'GET' ? 'text-emerald-400 mr-1' : 'text-amber-400 mr-1'}>{r.method}</span>
            {r.name}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Method & URL input */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <select
            value={req.method}
            onChange={e => updateRestRequest({ ...req, method: e.target.value as any })}
            className="bg-black border border-white/20 rounded-xl px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-amber-400 font-mono font-bold outline-none cursor-pointer"
          >
            <option value="GET">GET</option>
            <option value="POST">POST</option>
            <option value="PUT">PUT</option>
            <option value="DELETE">DELETE</option>
          </select>

          <input
            type="text"
            value={req.url}
            onChange={e => updateRestRequest({ ...req, url: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="https://api.example.com/v1"
            className="flex-1 bg-black/60 border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-white font-mono outline-none focus:border-cyan-400"
          />

          <button
            onClick={handleSendRequest}
            disabled={isLoading}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer shrink-0 disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{isLoading ? '...' : 'Send'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body editor if POST/PUT */}
        {['POST', 'PUT'].includes(req.method) && (
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 block">JSON Body:</span>
            <textarea
              value={req.body}
              onChange={e => updateRestRequest({ ...req, body: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/15 rounded-xl p-2 text-xs text-cyan-300 font-mono outline-none resize-none h-24"
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Response Panel */}
      {req.response && (
        <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10 font-mono text-[11px]">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className={`font-bold flex items-center space-x-1 ${
              req.response.status >= 200 && req.response.status < 300 ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-400'
            }`}>
              {req.response.status >= 200 && req.response.status < 300 ? (
                <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              ) : (
                <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              )}
              <span>STATUS: {req.response.status} {req.response.statusText}</span>
            </span>

            <div className="flex space-x-2 text-zinc-500 text-[10px]">
              <span className="flex items-center space-x-0.5">
                <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-400" />
                <span>{req.response.time}ms</span>
              </span>
              <span>{req.response.size}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-black/80 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-3 max-h-52 overflow-y-auto text-zinc-300 font-mono text-[10.5px]">
            <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap">{JSON.stringify(req.response.data, null, 2)}</pre>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Search, Replace, FileText, ArrowRight, Check } from 'lucide-react';
import { useKronexStore } from './useKronexStore';
import { soundManager } from '../../utils/sound';

export default function SidebarSearch() {
  const { files, openFile, updateFileContent } = useKronexStore();
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [replaceTerm, setReplaceTerm] = useState('');
  const [showReplace, setShowReplace] = useState(false);

  // Filter files matching search term
  const results = files.filter(f => !f.isFolder && f.content.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));

  const handleReplaceAll = () => {
    if (!searchTerm) return;
    soundManager.playSuccess();
    results.forEach(file => {
      const newContent = file.content.replaceAll(searchTerm, replaceTerm);
      updateFileContent(file.id, newContent);
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-3 space-y-4 text-xs font-sans text-white select-none">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-white/10">
        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-extrabold text-zinc-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
          Search Workspace
        </span>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowReplace(!showReplace)}
          className={`p-1 rounded text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
            showReplace ? 'bg-cyan-500/20 text-[#00D4FF]' : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'
          }`}
          title="Toggle Replace"
        >
          Replace Mode
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Search Input Box */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 text-zinc-500" />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search in files..."
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={e => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/15 rounded-xl pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 font-mono"
          />
        </div>

        {showReplace && (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="relative">
              <Replace className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 text-zinc-500" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Replace with..."
                value={replaceTerm}
                onChange={e => setReplaceTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/15 rounded-xl pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 font-mono"
              />
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleReplaceAll}
              disabled={!searchTerm}
              className="w-full py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-cyan-500/20 hover:bg-cyan-500/30 border border-cyan-400/40 text-cyan-300 font-bold cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              Replace All Matches
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Results Listing */}
      {searchTerm && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-400 block">
            Found {results.length} file(s) matching "{searchTerm}"
          </span>

          <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto">
            {results.map(f => {
              // Extract snippet matching line
              const lines = f.content.split('\n');
              const matchLine = lines.find(l => l.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())) || '';

              return (
                <div
                  key={f.id}
                  onClick={() => {
                    soundManager.playClick();
                    openFile(f.id);
                  }}
                  className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/5 hover:border-cyan-400/30 cursor-pointer space-y-1 transition-all"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-cyan-400 font-bold font-mono">
                    <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                    <span className="truncate">{f.path}</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-400 truncate bg-black/40 p-1 rounded">
                    {matchLine}
                  </p>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
export interface FileItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  path: string;
  content: string;
  language: string;
  isFolder: boolean;
  parentId: string | null;
  isOpen?: boolean;
  isUnsaved?: boolean;
}

export type ActivityTab = 
  | 'explorer' 
  | 'search' 
  | 'git' 
  | 'extensions' 
  | 'rest' 
  | 'database' 
  | 'performance' 
  | 'copilot' 
  | 'settings';

export type BottomTab = 'terminal' | 'problems' | 'output' | 'debug' | 'preview' | 'ai-assistant';

export type ThemeMode = 'kronex-dark' | 'cyberpunk' | 'amoled' | 'light-glass';

export interface EditorSettings {
  theme: ThemeMode;
  fontSize: number;
  tabSize: number;
  wordWrap: 'on' | 'off';
  minimap: boolean;
  autoSave: boolean;
  formatOnSave: boolean;
  lineNumbers: 'on' | 'off';
  fontFamily: string;
}

export interface GitCommit {
  id: string;
  message: string;
  author: string;
  timestamp: string;
  branch: string;
}

export interface ExtensionItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  publisher: string;
  description: string;
  version: string;
  downloads: string;
  rating: number;
  installed: boolean;
  icon: string;
}

export interface RestRequest {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE' | 'PATCH';
  url: string;
  headers: { key: string; value: string }[];
  body: string;
  response?: {
    status: number;
    statusText: string;
    time: number;
    size: string;
    data: any;
  };
}

export interface DbTable {
  name: string;
  rowCount: number;
  columns: { name: string; type: string; pk?: boolean }[];
  rows: any[];
}
```

```typescript
from pydantic import BaseModel
import time

app = FastAPI(title="Kronex Cognitive API", version="2.5.0")

class TelemetryPayload(BaseModel):
    node_id: str
    pulse_rate: float
    status: str

@app.get("/api/v1/health")
def health_check():
    return {
        "status": "healthy",
        "timestamp": time.time(),
        "engine": "Kronex Cognitive Core v2.5",
        "latency_ms": 0.85
    }

@app.post("/api/v1/telemetry")
def receive_telemetry(payload: TelemetryPayload):
    if not payload.node_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Node ID required")
    
    return {
        "success": True,

// Helper to load persistent state from localStorage
const loadSavedFiles = (): FileItem[] => {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('kronex_code_files_v1');
    if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
  } catch (e) {}
  return INITIAL_FILES;
};

interface KronexStore {
  // Files State
  files: FileItem[];
  openFileIds: string[];
  activeFileId: string | null;
  splitFileId: string | null;
  isSplitView: boolean;

  // Navigation / Panels
  activeActivityTab: ActivityTab | null;
  isSidebarOpen: boolean;
  sidebarWidth: number;
  activeBottomTab: BottomTab;
  isBottomPanelOpen: boolean;
  bottomPanelHeight: number;
  isZenMode: boolean;
  isFullscreen: boolean;

  // Settings
  settings: EditorSettings;

  // Search
  searchQuery: string;

  // Command Palette
  isCommandPaletteOpen: boolean;

  // Extensions
  extensions: ExtensionItem[];

  // REST Client
  restRequests: RestRequest[];
  activeRestRequestId: string;

  // DB Explorer
  dbTables: DbTable[];
  activeDbTableName: string;

  // Git state
  gitBranch: string;
  stagedFiles: string[];
  commits: { id: string; message: string; timestamp: string }[];

  // Actions
  setFiles: (files: FileItem[]) => void;
  openFile: (id: string) => void;
  closeFile: (id: string) => void;
  setActiveFile: (id: string) => void;
  updateFileContent: (id: string, content: string) => void;
  createFile: (name: string, isFolder: boolean, parentId: string | null) => void;
  deleteFile: (id: string) => void;
  renameFile: (id: string, newName: string) => void;
  saveActiveFile: () => void;
  toggleFolder: (id: string) => void;

  // View actions
  setActiveActivityTab: (tab: ActivityTab | null) => void;
  toggleSidebar: () => void;
  setSidebarWidth: (width: number) => void;
  setActiveBottomTab: (tab: BottomTab) => void;
  toggleBottomPanel: () => void;
  setBottomPanelHeight: (height: number) => void;
  toggleZenMode: () => void;
  toggleFullscreen: () => void;
  toggleSplitView: () => void;
  setSplitFileId: (id: string | null) => void;

  // Settings actions
  updateSettings: (newSettings: Partial<EditorSettings>) => void;

  // Command Palette
  setCommandPaletteOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void;

  // Extensions
  toggleExtensionInstall: (id: string) => void;

  // REST actions
  updateRestRequest: (req: RestRequest) => void;
  setActiveRestRequestId: (id: string) => void;

  // Git actions
  commitChanges: (message: string) => void;
  setGitBranch: (branch: string) => void;

  // Reset Project
  resetToDefaults: () => void;
}

export const useKronexStore = create<KronexStore>((set, get) => ({
  files: loadSavedFiles(),
  openFileIds: ['file-app-tsx', 'file-server-py', 'file-readme-md'],
  activeFileId: 'file-app-tsx',
  splitFileId: 'file-readme-md',
  isSplitView: false,

  activeActivityTab: 'explorer',
  isSidebarOpen: true,
  sidebarWidth: 260,
  activeBottomTab: 'terminal',
  isBottomPanelOpen: true,
  bottomPanelHeight: 220,
  isZenMode: false,
  isFullscreen: false,

  settings: {
    theme: 'kronex-dark',
    fontSize: 14,
    tabSize: 2,
    wordWrap: 'on',
    minimap: true,
    autoSave: true,
    formatOnSave: true,
    lineNumbers: 'on',
    fontFamily: "'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace",
  },

  searchQuery: '',
  isCommandPaletteOpen: false,

  extensions: INITIAL_EXTENSIONS,

  restRequests: INITIAL_REST_REQUESTS,
  activeRestRequestId: 'req-1',

  dbTables: INITIAL_DB_TABLES,
  activeDbTableName: 'users',

  gitBranch: 'main',
  stagedFiles: ['src/App.tsx'],
  commits: [
    { id: 'c-101', message: 'feat: initialize Kronex Code core engine', timestamp: '10 mins ago' },
    { id: 'c-100', message: 'chore: initial project layout', timestamp: '1 hour ago' }
  ],

  setFiles: (files) => {
    localStorage.setItem('kronex_code_files_v1', JSON.stringify(files));
    set({ files });
  },

  openFile: (id) => {
    const { openFileIds } = get();
    if (!openFileIds.includes(id)) {
      set({ openFileIds: [...openFileIds, id], activeFileId: id });
    } else {
      set({ activeFileId: id });
    }
  },

  closeFile: (id) => {
    const { openFileIds, activeFileId } = get();
    const nextOpen = openFileIds.filter(fId => fId !== id);
    let nextActive = activeFileId;
    if (activeFileId === id) {
      nextActive = nextOpen.length > 0 ? nextOpen[nextOpen.length - 1] : null;
    }
    set({ openFileIds: nextOpen, activeFileId: nextActive });
  },

  setActiveFile: (id) => set({ activeFileId: id }),

  updateFileContent: (id, content) => {
    const files = get().files.map(f => {
      if (f.id === id) {
        return { ...f, content, isUnsaved: true };
      }
      return f;
    });
    localStorage.setItem('kronex_code_files_v1', JSON.stringify(files));
    set({ files });
  },

  saveActiveFile: () => {
    const { activeFileId, files } = get();
    if (!activeFileId) return;
    const nextFiles = files.map(f => f.id === activeFileId ? { ...f, isUnsaved: false } : f);
    localStorage.setItem('kronex_code_files_v1', JSON.stringify(nextFiles));
    set({ files: nextFiles });
  },

  createFile: (name, isFolder, parentId) => {
    const { files } = get();
    const parent = files.find(f => f.id === parentId);
    const parentPath = parent ? parent.path : '';
    const newPath = parentPath ? `${parentPath}/${name}` : name;

    let language = 'plaintext';
    if (!isFolder) {
      if (name.endsWith('.ts') || name.endsWith('.tsx')) language = 'typescript';
      else if (name.endsWith('.js') || name.endsWith('.jsx')) language = 'javascript';
      else if (name.endsWith('.py')) language = 'python';
      else if (name.endsWith('.sql')) language = 'sql';
      else if (name.endsWith('.html')) language = 'html';
      else if (name.endsWith('.css')) language = 'css';
      else if (name.endsWith('.json')) language = 'json';
      else if (name.endsWith('.md')) language = 'markdown';
      else if (name.endsWith('.rs')) language = 'rust';
    }

    const newFile: FileItem = {
      id: `file-${Date.now()}`,
      name,
      path: newPath,
      content: isFolder ? '' : `// New file: ${name}\n`,
      language,
      isFolder,
      parentId,
      isOpen: isFolder ? true : undefined
    };

    const nextFiles = [...files, newFile];
    localStorage.setItem('kronex_code_files_v1', JSON.stringify(nextFiles));
    
    if (!isFolder) {
      set({ 
        files: nextFiles, 
        openFileIds: [...get().openFileIds, newFile.id], 
        activeFileId: newFile.id 
      });
    } else {
      set({ files: nextFiles });
    }
  },

  deleteFile: (id) => {
    const { files, openFileIds, activeFileId } = get();
    const nextFiles = files.filter(f => f.id !== id && f.parentId !== id);
    const nextOpen = openFileIds.filter(fId => fId !== id);
    let nextActive = activeFileId;
    if (activeFileId === id) {
      nextActive = nextOpen.length > 0 ? nextOpen[0] : null;
    }
    localStorage.setItem('kronex_code_files_v1', JSON.stringify(nextFiles));
    set({ files: nextFiles, openFileIds: nextOpen, activeFileId: nextActive });
  },

  renameFile: (id, newName) => {
    const files = get().files.map(f => {
      if (f.id === id) {
        return { ...f, name: newName };
      }
      return f;
    });
    localStorage.setItem('kronex_code_files_v1', JSON.stringify(files));
    set({ files });
  },

  toggleFolder: (id) => {
    const files = get().files.map(f => {
      if (f.id === id) {
        return { ...f, isOpen: !f.isOpen };
      }
      return f;
    });
    set({ files });
  },

  setActiveActivityTab: (tab) => {
    if (tab === null) {
      set({ isSidebarOpen: false, activeActivityTab: null });
    } else if (get().activeActivityTab === tab && get().isSidebarOpen) {
      set({ isSidebarOpen: false });
    } else {
      set({ isSidebarOpen: true, activeActivityTab: tab });
    }
  },

  toggleSidebar: () => set(state => ({ isSidebarOpen: !state.isSidebarOpen })),

  setSidebarWidth: (width) => set({ sidebarWidth: Math.max(160, Math.min(600, width)) }),

  setActiveBottomTab: (tab) => set({ activeBottomTab: tab, isBottomPanelOpen: true }),

  toggleBottomPanel: () => set(state => ({ isBottomPanelOpen: !state.isBottomPanelOpen })),

  setBottomPanelHeight: (height) => set({ bottomPanelHeight: Math.max(100, Math.min(600, height)) }),

  toggleZenMode: () => set(state => ({ isZenMode: !state.isZenMode })),

  toggleFullscreen: () => {
    const nextVal = !get().isFullscreen;
    if (nextVal) {
      if (document.documentElement.requestFullscreen) {
        document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(() => {});
      }
    } else {
      if (document.exitFullscreen && document.fullscreenElement) {
        document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => {});
      }
    }
    set({ isFullscreen: nextVal });
  },

  toggleSplitView: () => set(state => ({ isSplitView: !state.isSplitView })),

  setSplitFileId: (id) => set({ splitFileId: id }),

  updateSettings: (newSettings) => set(state => ({ settings: { ...state.settings, ...newSettings } })),

  setCommandPaletteOpen: (isOpen) => set({ isCommandPaletteOpen: isOpen }),

  toggleExtensionInstall: (id) => set(state => ({
    extensions: state.extensions.map(ext => ext.id === id ? { ...ext, installed: !ext.installed } : ext)
  })),

  updateRestRequest: (req) => set(state => ({
    restRequests: state.restRequests.map(r => r.id === req.id ? req : r)
  })),

  setActiveRestRequestId: (id) => set({ activeRestRequestId: id }),

  commitChanges: (message) => set(state => ({
    commits: [
      { id: `c-${Date.now()}`, message, timestamp: 'Just now' },
      ...state.commits
    ],
    stagedFiles: []
  })),

  setGitBranch: (branch) => set({ gitBranch: branch }),

  resetToDefaults: () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('kronex_code_files_v1');
    set({
      files: INITIAL_FILES,
      openFileIds: ['file-app-tsx', 'file-server-py', 'file-readme-md'],
      activeFileId: 'file-app-tsx',
      splitFileId: 'file-readme-md',
      isSplitView: false,
      activeActivityTab: 'explorer',
      isSidebarOpen: true,
      isBottomPanelOpen: true,
      isZenMode: false
    });
  }
}));
```

```tsx
              onChange={(e) => setNewKeyValue(e.target.value)}
              className="px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#94A3B8]/60 focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-[#F8FAFC] font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,212,255,0.4)] transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            Save Encrypted Secret to Vault
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Paperclip, X, UploadCloud, FileText, Image, Film, Music, Archive, Code, 
  Trash2, CheckCircle2, Loader2, CloudCheck, ExternalLink 
} from 'lucide-react';
import { WorkflowAttachment } from './workflowTypes';

interface AttachmentManagerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  nodeId?: string;
  attachments: WorkflowAttachment[];
  onAddAttachments: (newFiles: WorkflowAttachment[]) => void;
  onRemoveAttachment: (fileId: string) => void;
}

export default function AttachmentManagerModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  nodeId,
  attachments,
  onAddAttachments,
  onRemoveAttachment
}: AttachmentManagerModalProps) {
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSimulatedFileUpload = (filesList: FileList | File[]) => {
    setUploading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const newItems: WorkflowAttachment[] = Array.from(filesList).map((f, i) => {
        let typeExt: WorkflowAttachment['fileType'] = 'pdf';
        const nameLower = f.name.toLowerCase();
        if (nameLower.endsWith('.pdf')) typeExt = 'pdf';
        else if (nameLower.endsWith('.docx') || nameLower.endsWith('.doc')) typeExt = 'docx';
        else if (nameLower.endsWith('.xlsx') || nameLower.endsWith('.xls')) typeExt = 'xlsx';
        else if (nameLower.endsWith('.csv')) typeExt = 'csv';
        else if (nameLower.endsWith('.png') || nameLower.endsWith('.jpg') || nameLower.endsWith('.jpeg')) typeExt = 'image';
        else if (nameLower.endsWith('.mp4') || nameLower.endsWith('.mov')) typeExt = 'video';
        else if (nameLower.endsWith('.mp3') || nameLower.endsWith('.wav')) typeExt = 'audio';
        else if (nameLower.endsWith('.zip') || nameLower.endsWith('.tar')) typeExt = 'zip';
        else if (nameLower.endsWith('.ts') || nameLower.endsWith('.js') || nameLower.endsWith('.py')) typeExt = 'code';

        return {
          id: `file-${Date.now()}-${i}`,
          name: f.name,
          size: f.size || 124500,
          type: f.type || 'application/octet-stream',
          fileType: typeExt,
          uploadedAt: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
          syncStatus: 'synced'
        };
      });

      onAddAttachments(newItems);
      setUploading(false);
    }, 1000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-2xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-white/[0.1] rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-6 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.08] pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-[#00D4FF]/20 border border-[#00D4FF]/40 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Paperclip className="w-5 h-5 text-[#00D4FF]" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Node Attachment Manager</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">Multi-format file upload and vector knowledge store sync</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Drag and drop zone */}
        <div
          onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setIsDragging(true); }}
          onDragLeave={() => setIsDragging(false)}
          onDrop={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setIsDragging(false);
            if (e.dataTransfer.files) handleSimulatedFileUpload(e.dataTransfer.files);
          }}
          className={`p-8 border-2 border-dashed rounded-2xl text-center space-y-3 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            isDragging
              ? 'border-[#00D4FF] bg-[#00D4FF]/10'
              : 'border-white/[0.15] bg-[#131A2E]/50 hover:border-[#00D4FF]/50'
          }`}
        >
          <input
            type="file"
            multiple
            onChange={(e) => e.target.files && handleSimulatedFileUpload(e.target.files)}
            className="hidden"
            id="file-upload-input"
          />
          <label htmlFor="file-upload-input" className="cursor-pointer space-y-2 block">
            {uploading ? (
              <Loader2 className="w-10 h-10 text-[#00D4FF] animate-spin mx-auto" />
            ) : (
              <UploadCloud className="w-10 h-10 text-[#00D4FF] mx-auto" />
            )}
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">
              {uploading ? 'Processing & Chunking Documents...' : 'Click to Upload or Drag & Drop Files'}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">
              Supports PDF, Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX), CSV, ZIP, Code, Images, Audio & Video
            </p>
          </label>
        </div>

        {/* File Attachments List */}
        <div className="space-y-2 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
          {attachments.length > 0 ? (
            attachments.map((file) => (
              <div
                key={file.id}
                className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#131A2E]/80 border border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 truncate">
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00D4FF]" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="truncate">
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F8FAFC] truncate">{file.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8] font-mono">
                      {(file.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB • {file.fileType.toUpperCase()} • {file.uploadedAt}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 shrink-0">
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold flex items-center space-x-1">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>Cloud Synced</span>
                  </span>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => onRemoveAttachment(file.id)}
                    className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-500/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          ) : (
            <p className="text-center text-xs text-[#94A3B8] py-4">No attachments uploaded yet.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { memo } from 'react';
import { Handle, Position, NodeProps } from '@xyflow/react';
import { 
  Play, MessageSquare, Mic, FileUp, Webhook, Clock, Mail, MessageCircle, Send, Slack,
  Sparkles, Cpu, Brain, Compass, Zap, Server, Search, Code, Headphones, BarChart2,
  Bot, Globe, Terminal, Box, Image as ImageIcon, ScanText, Database, FileText, BookOpen,
  Flame, Layers, Cloud, Phone, Workflow, GitFork, Repeat, ShieldAlert, Lock,
  CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, Loader2, Paperclip, Settings, PlayCircle
} from 'lucide-react';
import { WorkflowNodeData } from './workflowTypes';

const ICON_MAP: Record<string, React.ElementType> = {
  Play, MessageSquare, Mic, FileUp, Webhook, Clock, Mail, MessageCircle, Send, Slack,
  Sparkles, Cpu, Brain, Compass, Zap, Server, Search, Code, Headphones, BarChart2,
  Bot, Globe, Terminal, Box, Image: ImageIcon, ScanText, Database, FileText, BookOpen,
  Flame, Layers, Cloud, Phone, Workflow, GitFork, Repeat, ShieldAlert, Lock
};

function getIcon(iconName?: string) {
  if (!iconName) return Bot;
  return ICON_MAP[iconName] || Bot;
}

export const WorkflowNodeComponent = memo(({ id, data, selected }: NodeProps<any>) => {
  const nodeData = data as WorkflowNodeData;
  const Icon = getIcon(nodeData.iconName);
  const color = nodeData.color || '#7C5CFF';

  const isTrigger = nodeData.category === 'triggers';
  const isLogic = nodeData.category === 'logic';

  return (
    <div 
      className={`relative min-w-[260px] max-w-[320px] rounded-[18px] bg-[#0B1020]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border transition-all duration-200 shadow-2xl group ${
        selected 
          ? 'border-[#00D4FF] shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,212,255,0.4)] scale-[1.02]' 
          : nodeData.status === 'running'
            ? 'border-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(251,191,36,0.3)] animate-pulse'
            : nodeData.status === 'success'
              ? 'border-emerald-500/80 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.2)]'
              : nodeData.status === 'error'
                ? 'border-rose-500/80 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(244,63,94,0.3)]'
                : 'border-white/[0.12] hover:border-white/25 hover:shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]'
      }`}
    >
      {/* Top Accent Line */}
      <div 
        className="h-[3px] w-full rounded-t-[18px]"
        style={{ backgroundColor: color }}
      />

      {/* Target Handle (Left or Top for Non-Triggers) */}
      {!isTrigger && (
        <Handle
          type="target"
          position={Position.Left}
          className="!w-3.5 !h-3.5 !bg-[#131A2E] !border-2 !border-[#00D4FF] hover:!scale-125 transition-transform !-left-2"
        />
      )}

      {/* Node Header */}
      <div className="p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.06]">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5 overflow-hidden">
          <div 
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-md"
            style={{ backgroundColor: `${color}20`, border: `1px solid ${color}50` }}
          >
            {React.createElement(Icon as any, { className: 'w-4 h-4', style: { color } })}
          </div>
          <div className="truncate">
            <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F8FAFC] truncate tracking-wide">
              {nodeData.label}
            </h4>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8] font-mono capitalize block truncate">
              {nodeData.category.replace('_', ' ')}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Status indicator or Action button */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 shrink-0">
          {nodeData.status === 'running' && (
            <div className="p-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400">
              <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
            </div>
          )}
          {nodeData.status === 'success' && (
            <div className="p-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </div>
          )}
          {nodeData.status === 'error' && (
            <div className="p-1 rounded-full bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400">
              <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              if (nodeData.onRunSingleNode) nodeData.onRunSingleNode(id);
            }}
            title="Test / Run Node"
            className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-white/5 hover:bg-[#00D4FF]/20 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-[#00D4FF] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <PlayCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />

            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase font-bold text-emerald-400">{nodeData.codeLanguage}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {nodeData.cronSchedule && (
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center bg-[#131A2E]/60 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-white/[0.05]">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#94A3B8]">Cron:</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-amber-300">{nodeData.cronSchedule}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {nodeData.agentRole && (
          <p className="text-[11px] text-[#CBD5E1] line-clamp-1 italic">
            "{nodeData.agentRole}"
          </p>
        )}

        {nodeData.description && !nodeData.agentRole && (
          <p className="text-[11px] text-[#94A3B8] line-clamp-2">
            {nodeData.description}
          </p>
        )}

        {/* File Attachments Badge */}
        {nodeData.attachments && nodeData.attachments.length > 0 && (

        {/* Execution metrics */}

        )}
      </div>

      {/* Source Handles (Right or Bottom for Connections) */}
      <Handle
        type="source"
        position={Position.Right}
        className="!w-3.5 !h-3.5 !bg-[#131A2E] !border-2 !border-[#7C5CFF] hover:!scale-125 transition-transform !-right-2"

      {isLogic && (
        <Handle
          type="source"

        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

WorkflowNodeComponent.displayName = 'WorkflowNodeComponent';

  workflowNode: WorkflowNodeComponent,
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Terminal, X, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, Clock, Cpu, 
  DollarSign, RefreshCw, Trash2, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Copy, Check
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ExecutionLog } from './workflowTypes';

interface DebugConsoleProps {
  logs: ExecutionLog[];
  onClearLogs: () => void;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  totalTokens: number;
  totalCostEstimate: number;
  totalDurationMs: number;
}

export default function DebugConsole({
  logs,
  onClearLogs,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  totalTokens,
  totalCostEstimate,
  totalDurationMs
}: DebugConsoleProps) {
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedLogId, setExpandedLogId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleCopy = (text: string, id: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedId(id);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedId(null), 1500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-64 sm:h-72 bg-[#080C18]/95 border-t border-white/[0.08] backdrop-blur-2xl flex flex-col z-30 shrink-0 shadow-2xl">
      {/* Console Top Toolbar */}
      <div className="px-4 py-2 border-b border-white/[0.08] bg-[#0B1020]/90 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-[#00D4FF] font-bold">
            <Terminal className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Execution Console</span>
          </div>

          <div className="h-3 w-[1px] bg-white/10" />

          {/* Realtime Metrics */}
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-4 text-[10px] font-mono text-[#94A3B8]">
            <span className="flex items-center space-x-1">
              <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-400" />
              <span>Duration: <strong className="text-[#F8FAFC]">{totalDurationMs}ms</strong></span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center space-x-1">
              <Cpu className="w-3 h-3 text-[#7C5CFF]" />
              <span>Tokens: <strong className="text-[#F8FAFC]">{totalTokens.toLocaleString()}</strong></span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center space-x-1">
              <DollarSign className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>Est. Cost: <strong className="text-emerald-400">${totalCostEstimate.toFixed(5)}</strong></span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
          <button
            onClick={onClearLogs}
            title="Clear Log Output"
            className="p-1 rounded-lg text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
          >
            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 rounded-lg text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Log Stream List */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-1.5 font-mono text-xs custom-scrollbar">
        {logs.length > 0 ? (
          logs.map((log) => {
            const isExpanded = expandedLogId === log.id;
            return (
              <div 
                key={log.id} 
                className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E]/50 border border-white/[0.05] hover:border-white/10 transition-all text-[11px]"
              >
                <div 
                  className="flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer select-none"
                  onClick={() => setExpandedLogId(isExpanded ? null : log.id)}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 truncate">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8]">{log.timestamp}</span>

                    {log.status === 'running' && (
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 text-[9px] font-bold animate-pulse">
                        RUNNING
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {log.status === 'success' && (
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 text-[9px] font-bold">
                        SUCCESS
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {log.status === 'error' && (
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 text-[9px] font-bold">
                        ERROR
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {log.status === 'info' && (
                      <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#00D4FF]/20 text-[#00D4FF] text-[9px] font-bold">
                        INFO
                      </span>
                    )}

                    <span className="text-[#F8FAFC] font-semibold truncate">{log.nodeName}:</span>
                    <span className="text-[#94A3B8] truncate">{log.message}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 shrink-0">
                    {log.durationMs !== undefined && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8]">{log.durationMs}ms</span>
                    )}
                    {isExpanded ? (
                      <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#94A3B8]" />
                    ) : (
                      <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#94A3B8]" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Expanded Payload Output */}
                {isExpanded && log.output && (
                  <div className="mt-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#080C18] border border-white/[0.08] relative group">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleCopy(JSON.stringify(log.output, null, 2), log.id)}
                      className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1 rounded bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white transition-colors"
                    >
                      {copiedId === log.id ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
                    </button>
                    <pre className="text-[10px] text-emerald-300 overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre-wrap max-h-36">
                      {typeof log.output === 'string' ? log.output : JSON.stringify(log.output, null, 2)}
                    </pre>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })
        ) : (
          <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-[#94A3B8] space-y-1">
            <p>Console is ready. Click "Execute Workflow" to view execution traces.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
