```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  X, Play, Trash2, Copy, Sliders, Code, Terminal, Sparkles, 
  Paperclip, Key, ShieldCheck, Database, Check, RefreshCw
} from 'lucide-react';
import { WorkflowNodeData, WorkflowAttachment } from './workflowTypes';

interface NodeInspectorProps {
  nodeId: string;
  data: WorkflowNodeData;
  onUpdateData: (nodeId: string, newData: Partial<WorkflowNodeData>) => void;
  onDeleteNode: (nodeId: string) => void;
  onDuplicateNode: (nodeId: string) => void;
  onRunSingleNode: (nodeId: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenAttachmentModal: (nodeId: string) => void;
}

export default function NodeInspector({
  nodeId,
  data,
  onUpdateData,
  onDeleteNode,
  onDuplicateNode,
  onRunSingleNode,
  onClose,
  onOpenAttachmentModal
}: NodeInspectorProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'config' | 'prompt' | 'code' | 'attachments' | 'output'>('config');

  return (
    <aside className="w-80 sm:w-96 h-full bg-[#0B1020]/95 border-l border-white/[0.08] backdrop-blur-2xl flex flex-col z-20 shrink-0 shadow-2xl">
      {/* Top Header */}
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-[#00D4FF]/20 border border-[#00D4FF]/40 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Sliders className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00D4FF]" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Node Inspector</h3>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8] font-mono">ID: {nodeId}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1">
          <button
            onClick={() => onDuplicateNode(nodeId)}
            title="Duplicate Node"
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-[#F8FAFC] hover:bg-white/5"
          >
            <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => onDeleteNode(nodeId)}
            title="Delete Node"
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-500/10"
          >
            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex border-b border-white/[0.08] bg-[#131A2E]/40 px-2 text-xs">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('config')}
          className={`py-2.5 px-3 font-medium border-b-2 transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'config'
              ? 'border-[#00D4FF] text-[#00D4FF]'
              : 'border-transparent text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          Settings
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('prompt')}
          className={`py-2.5 px-3 font-medium border-b-2 transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'prompt'
              ? 'border-[#00D4FF] text-[#00D4FF]'
              : 'border-transparent text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          Prompt / LLM
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('code')}
          className={`py-2.5 px-3 font-medium border-b-2 transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'code'
              ? 'border-[#00D4FF] text-[#00D4FF]'
              : 'border-transparent text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          Code / Tool
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('attachments')}
          className={`py-2.5 px-3 font-medium border-b-2 transition-all relative ${
            activeTab === 'attachments'
              ? 'border-[#00D4FF] text-[#00D4FF]'
              : 'border-transparent text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          Files ({data.attachments?.length || 0})
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Inspector Body */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 custom-scrollbar text-xs">
        {/* Node Name */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">Node Label:</label>
          <input
            type="text"
            value={data.label || ''}
            onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { label: e.target.value })}
            className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
          />
        </div>

        {/* TAB 1: GENERAL CONFIG */}
        {activeTab === 'config' && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">Description:</label>
              <textarea
                rows={2}
                value={data.description || ''}
                onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { description: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Explain the purpose of this node..."
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#94A3B8]/50 focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Webhook Path */}
            {data.category === 'triggers' && (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">Webhook Endpoint Path:</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={data.webhookUrl || '/api/v1/webhook/incoming'}
                  onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { webhookUrl: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] font-mono text-xs text-[#00D4FF] focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Cron Schedule */}
            {data.type === 'trigger_schedule' && (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">Cron Timer Expression:</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={data.cronSchedule || '0 9 * * 1-5'}
                  onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { cronSchedule: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g. 0 9 * * 1-5"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] font-mono text-xs text-amber-300 focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Database Table */}
            {data.category === 'databases' && (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">Database Table / Collection:</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={data.dbTable || data.collection || 'records'}
                  onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { dbTable: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Vector DB Index */}
            {data.category === 'rag' && (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">Vector Index Name:</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={data.vectorIndex || 'enterprise-knowledge-base'}
                  onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { vectorIndex: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Logic Conditions */}
            {data.category === 'logic' && (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">Evaluation Expression (IF):</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={data.conditionIf || 'input.score > 0.8'}
                  onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { conditionIf: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] font-mono text-xs text-yellow-300 focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB 2: PROMPT & LLM */}
        {activeTab === 'prompt' && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">LLM Model Provider:</label>
              <select
                value={data.model || 'gemini-2.5-flash'}
                onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { model: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-[#00D4FF] focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="gemini-2.5-flash">Google Gemini 2.5 Flash</option>
                <option value="gemini-2.5-pro">Google Gemini 2.5 Pro</option>
                <option value="gpt-4o">OpenAI GPT-4o</option>
                <option value="gpt-4o-mini">OpenAI GPT-4o Mini</option>
                <option value="claude-3-7-sonnet">Claude 3.7 Sonnet</option>
                <option value="deepseek-reasoner">DeepSeek R1 Reasoner</option>
                <option value="grok-3-beta">xAI Grok 3</option>
                <option value="llama3:8b">Ollama / Local Llama 3</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px]">
                <span className="text-[#94A3B8] font-medium">Temperature:</span>
                <span className="text-[#00D4FF] font-mono">{data.temperature ?? 0.7}</span>
              </div>
              <input
                type="range"
                min="0"
                max="1"
                step="0.05"
                value={data.temperature ?? 0.7}
                onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { temperature: parseFloat(e.target.value) })}
                className="w-full accent-[#00D4FF] cursor-pointer"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">System Instruction Prompt:</label>
              <textarea
                rows={3}
                value={data.systemPrompt || 'You are an autonomous enterprise AI agent assisting with automated workflow tasks.'}
                onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { systemPrompt: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">User Prompt Template (Supports &#123;&#123;input&#125;&#125;):</label>
              <textarea
                rows={4}
                value={data.promptTemplate || 'Analyze the incoming input payload and generate structured JSON response:\n{{input}}'}
                onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { promptTemplate: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300 focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB 3: CODE & TOOL */}
        {activeTab === 'code' && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">Execution Language:</label>
              <select
                value={data.codeLanguage || 'python'}
                onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { codeLanguage: e.target.value as any })}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="python">Python 3.11</option>
                <option value="javascript">JavaScript / Node.js</option>
                <option value="sql">PostgreSQL / SQL Query</option>
                <option value="bash">Bash Script / Terminal</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">Code Sandbox Script:</label>
              <textarea
                rows={8}
                value={data.codeSnippet || 'def execute_step(payload):\n    # Process input data\n    result = payload.get("data", "")\n    return {"status": "ok", "processed": result}'}
                onChange={(e) => onUpdateData(nodeId, { codeSnippet: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl bg-[#080C18] border border-white/[0.1] font-mono text-xs text-emerald-300 focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB 4: ATTACHMENTS */}
        {activeTab === 'attachments' && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-[#94A3B8]">Attached Knowledge Files:</span>
              <button
                onClick={() => onOpenAttachmentModal(nodeId)}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#00D4FF]/20 text-[#00D4FF] border border-[#00D4FF]/40 text-xs font-medium hover:bg-[#00D4FF]/30 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-1"
              >
                <Paperclip className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Upload Files</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {data.attachments && data.attachments.length > 0 ? (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {data.attachments.map((file) => (
                  <div key={file.id} className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="truncate">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F8FAFC] truncate">{file.name}</p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8] font-mono">{(file.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB • {file.fileType}</p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 text-[9px] font-mono">Synced</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="p-6 text-center border-2 border-dashed border-white/[0.08] rounded-2xl space-y-2">
                <Paperclip className="w-6 h-6 text-[#94A3B8] mx-auto opacity-50" />
                <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">No files attached to this node.</p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => onOpenAttachmentModal(nodeId)}
                  className="text-xs text-[#00D4FF] hover:underline"
                >
                  Drag PDF, Word, Excel or CSV here
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Footer Action */}
      <div className="p-4 border-t border-white/[0.08] bg-[#131A2E]/60 flex items-center space-x-2">
        <button
          onClick={() => onRunSingleNode(nodeId)}
          className="flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#7C5CFF] to-[#00D4FF] text-[#F8FAFC] font-semibold text-xs shadow-lg hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,212,255,0.4)] transition-all flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Play className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current" />
          <span>Execute Node</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Search, ChevronRight, Sparkles, Play, Cpu, Bot, Terminal, Database, 
  Cloud, MessageSquare, Workflow, Lock, Layers, Mic, HardDrive, Filter, X
} from 'lucide-react';
import { NODE_CATALOG } from './nodeCatalog';
import { NodeCategory, NodeDefinition } from './workflowTypes';

interface NodePaletteProps {
  onAddNode: (def: NodeDefinition) => void;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose?: () => void;
}

const CATEGORY_LABELS: Record<NodeCategory, { label: string; icon: React.ElementType; color: string }> = {
  triggers: { label: 'Triggers & Inputs', icon: Play, color: '#00D4FF' },
  ai_models: { label: 'AI Models', icon: Sparkles, color: '#7C5CFF' },
  agents: { label: 'Autonomous Agents', icon: Bot, color: '#F59E0B' },
  tools: { label: 'Tools & Code', icon: Terminal, color: '#10B981' },
  rag: { label: 'RAG & Knowledge', icon: Layers, color: '#A855F7' },
  databases: { label: 'Databases', icon: Database, color: '#FFCA28' },
  cloud_storage: { label: 'Cloud Storage', icon: Cloud, color: '#0284C7' },
  communication: { label: 'Communication', icon: MessageSquare, color: '#E11D48' },
  automation: { label: 'Automation & Webhooks', icon: Workflow, color: '#2563EB' },
  integrations: { label: 'OAuth & Integrations', icon: HardDrive, color: '#3ECF8E' },
  voice: { label: 'Voice & Speech', icon: Mic, color: '#EC4899' },
  memory: { label: 'Agent Memory', icon: Cpu, color: '#8B5CF6' },
  logic: { label: 'Logic & Flow', icon: Filter, color: '#EAB308' },
  security: { label: 'Security & Auth', icon: Lock, color: '#64748B' },
};

export default function NodePalette({ onAddNode, isOpen, onClose }: NodePaletteProps) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<NodeCategory | 'all'>('all');

  const filteredNodes = NODE_CATALOG.filter((node) => {
    const matchesSearch = node.label.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
                          node.description.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase());
    const matchesCategory = selectedCategory === 'all' || node.category === selectedCategory;
    return matchesSearch && matchesCategory;
  });

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <aside className="w-80 h-full bg-[#0B1020]/95 border-r border-white/[0.08] backdrop-blur-2xl flex flex-col z-20 shrink-0 shadow-2xl">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl bg-[#7C5CFF]/20 border border-[#7C5CFF]/40 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00D4FF]" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Node Library</h3>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8]">Drag & Drop or Click to Add</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {onClose && (
          <button 
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 rounded-lg text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Search Input */}
      <div className="p-3 border-b border-white/[0.06] space-y-2">
        <div className="relative flex items-center">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 text-[#94A3B8]" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search triggers, AI, RAG, DBs..."
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#131A2E]/80 border border-white/[0.08] text-xs text-[#F8FAFC] placeholder-[#94A3B8]/60 focus:border-[#00D4FF] focus:outline-none"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Category Pills Slider */}
        <div className="flex space-x-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 no-scrollbar text-[11px]">
          <button
            onClick={() => setSelectedCategory('all')}
            className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg shrink-0 transition-all font-medium ${
              selectedCategory === 'all'
                ? 'bg-[#00D4FF]/20 text-[#00D4FF] border border-[#00D4FF]/40'
                : 'bg-white/5 text-[#94A3B8] border border-transparent hover:bg-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            All ({NODE_CATALOG.length})
          </button>

          {(Object.keys(CATEGORY_LABELS) as NodeCategory[]).map((cat) => {
            const meta = CATEGORY_LABELS[cat];
            const count = NODE_CATALOG.filter((n) => n.category === cat).length;
            return (
              <button
                key={cat}
                onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat)}
                className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg shrink-0 transition-all font-medium flex items-center space-x-1 ${
                  selectedCategory === cat
                    ? 'bg-[#7C5CFF]/25 text-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#7C5CFF]/50'
                    : 'bg-white/5 text-[#94A3B8] border border-transparent hover:bg-white/10'
                }`}
              >
                <span>{meta.label}</span>
                <span className="text-[9px] opacity-70">({count})</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Node Catalog Items */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-2 custom-scrollbar">
        {filteredNodes.length > 0 ? (
          filteredNodes.map((def) => {
            const catMeta = CATEGORY_LABELS[def.category];
            return (
              <div
                key={def.type}
                onClick={() => onAddNode(def)}
                draggable
                onDragStart={(e) => {
                  e.dataTransfer.setData('application/reactflow', JSON.stringify(def));
                  e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
                }}
                className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#131A2E]/60 hover:bg-[#131A2E] border border-white/[0.08] hover:border-[#00D4FF]/40 transition-all cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing group shadow-sm hover:shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]"
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
                    <div 
                      className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border shadow-inner"
                      style={{ 
                        backgroundColor: `${def.color}20`, 
                        borderColor: `${def.color}50` 
                      }}
                    >
                      {React.createElement(catMeta.icon as any, { className: 'w-4 h-4', style: { color: def.color } })}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F8FAFC] group-hover:text-[#00D4FF] transition-colors">
                        {def.label}
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8] line-clamp-1">
                        {def.description}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-[#94A3B8] group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-transform shrink-0" />
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center py-12 space-y-2">
            <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">No node types match your filter.</p>
            <button
              onClick={() => { setSearch(''); setSelectedCategory('all'); }}
              className="text-xs text-[#00D4FF] hover:underline"
            >
              Reset Search Filter
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

```tsx
interface TemplatesModalProps {
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { History, X, Check, RotateCcw, GitBranch, Calendar, User } from 'lucide-react';
import { WorkflowVersion } from './workflowTypes';

interface VersionHistoryModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  versions: WorkflowVersion[];
  onRestoreVersion: (v: WorkflowVersion) => void;
}

export default function VersionHistoryModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  versions,
  onRestoreVersion
}: VersionHistoryModalProps) {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-xl bg-[#0B1020] border border-white/[0.1] rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-6 relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/[0.08] pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-[#00D4FF]/20 border border-[#00D4FF]/40 flex items-center justify-center">
              <History className="w-5 h-5 text-[#00D4FF]" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">Workflow Version History</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">Immutable revision snapshots and rollback points</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-[#94A3B8] hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-3 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar pr-1">
          {versions.length > 0 ? (
            versions.map((ver, idx) => (
              <div
                key={ver.id}
                className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#131A2E]/70 border border-white/[0.08] flex items-center justify-between"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-[#7C5CFF]/20 border border-[#7C5CFF]/40 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <GitBranch className="w-4 h-4 text-[#00D4FF]" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-[#F8FAFC]">v{ver.versionNumber}.0 - {ver.label}</h4>
                      {idx === 0 && (
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 text-[9px] font-mono font-bold">
                          CURRENT
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-[#94A3B8] font-mono">
                      {ver.timestamp} • {ver.nodesCount} nodes • {ver.edgesCount} edges
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    onRestoreVersion(ver);
                    onClose();
                  }}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-[#00D4FF]/20 border border-white/10 hover:border-[#00D4FF]/50 text-xs font-semibold text-[#F8FAFC] hover:text-[#00D4FF] transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-1.5"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Restore</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            ))
          ) : (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-[#94A3B8]">
              No previous version snapshots stored yet. Auto-save will record snapshots every 5 minutes.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useCallback, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  ReactFlow,
  Background,
  Controls,
  MiniMap,
  useNodesState,
  useEdgesState,
  addEdge,
  Connection,
  Edge,
  Node,
  useReactFlow,
  ReactFlowProvider,
  BackgroundVariant,
  Panel
} from '@xyflow/react';

import { nodeTypes } from './CustomNodes';
import NodePalette from './NodePalette';
import NodeInspector from './NodeInspector';
import WorkflowToolbar from './WorkflowToolbar';
import DebugConsole from './DebugConsole';
import ApiManagerModal from './ApiManagerModal';
import TemplatesModal from './TemplatesModal';
import VersionHistoryModal from './VersionHistoryModal';
import AttachmentManagerModal from './AttachmentManagerModal';

import { 
  WorkflowNodeData, 
  NodeDefinition, 
  ExecutionLog, 
  WorkflowVersion, 
  WorkflowTemplate, 
  WorkflowAttachment 
} from './workflowTypes';
import { runWorkflowEngine } from './workflowRunner';

// Initial default node setup
const INITIAL_NODES: Node[] = [
  {
    id: 'trigger-1',
    type: 'workflowNode',
    position: { x: 100, y: 220 },
    data: {
      label: 'Chat Prompt Trigger',
      category: 'triggers',
      nodeType: 'trigger_chat',
      description: 'Activates on user prompt submission',
      color: '#00D4FF',
      iconName: 'MessageSquare',
      status: 'idle'
    }
  },
  {
    id: 'model-1',
    type: 'workflowNode',
    position: { x: 480, y: 220 },
    data: {
      label: 'Google Gemini 2.5 Flash',
      category: 'ai_models',
      nodeType: 'model_gemini',
      model: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
      temperature: 0.7,
      systemPrompt: 'You are an enterprise AI agent automating workflow tasks.',
      color: '#7C5CFF',
      iconName: 'Sparkles',
      status: 'idle'
    }
  },
  {
    id: 'agent-1',
    type: 'workflowNode',
    position: { x: 860, y: 220 },
    data: {
      label: 'Research & Code Agent',
      category: 'agents',
      nodeType: 'agent_research',
      agentRole: 'Enterprise Data Analyst',
      description: 'Synthesizes insights and formats structured JSON',
      color: '#F59E0B',
      iconName: 'Bot',
      status: 'idle'
    }
  }

const INITIAL_EDGES: Edge[] = [
  {
    id: 'e-trigger-model',
    source: 'trigger-1',
    target: 'model-1',
    animated: true,
    style: { stroke: '#00D4FF', strokeWidth: 2 }
  },
  {
    id: 'e-model-agent',
    source: 'model-1',
    target: 'agent-1',
    animated: true,
    style: { stroke: '#7C5CFF', strokeWidth: 2 }
  }
];

function WorkflowBuilderContent() {
  const [nodes, setNodes, onNodesChange] = useNodesState(INITIAL_NODES);
  const [edges, setEdges, onEdgesChange] = useEdgesState(INITIAL_EDGES);
  
  const [workflowName, setWorkflowName] = useState('Enterprise Agent Pipeline');
  const [selectedNodeId, setSelectedNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // UI Drawer & Modal States
  const [isPaletteOpen, setIsPaletteOpen] = useState(true);
  const [isDebugConsoleOpen, setIsDebugConsoleOpen] = useState(true);
  const [isApiManagerOpen, setIsApiManagerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isTemplatesOpen, setIsTemplatesOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isVersionHistoryOpen, setIsVersionHistoryOpen] = useState(false);
  const [attachmentModalNodeId, setAttachmentModalNodeId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Execution & Logs State
  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false);
  const [executionLogs, setExecutionLogs] = useState<ExecutionLog[]>([]);
  const [totalTokens, setTotalTokens] = useState(0);
  const [totalCostEstimate, setTotalCostEstimate] = useState(0);
  const [totalDurationMs, setTotalDurationMs] = useState(0);

  // Undo / Redo History Stack
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<{ nodes: Node[]; edges: Edge[] }[]>([]);
  const [historyPointer, setHistoryPointer] = useState(-1);

  // Versions Snapshot
  const [versions, setVersions] = useState<WorkflowVersion[]>([
    {
      id: 'ver-1',
      versionNumber: 1,
      label: 'Initial Architecture',
      description: 'Default Gemini + Agent Pipeline',
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
      author: 'Enterprise Admin',
      nodesCount: INITIAL_NODES.length,
      edgesCount: INITIAL_EDGES.length,
      snapshot: { nodes: INITIAL_NODES, edges: INITIAL_EDGES }
    }
  ]);

  const reactFlowInstance = useReactFlow();

  // Save current state to undo history stack
  const recordHistory = useCallback((newNodes: Node[], newEdges: Edge[]) => {
    setHistory((prev) => {
      const sliced = prev.slice(0, historyPointer + 1);
      return [...sliced, { nodes: newNodes, edges: newEdges }];
    });
    setHistoryPointer((prev) => prev + 1);
  }, [historyPointer]);

  // Connect edges callback
  const onConnect = useCallback(
    (params: Connection) => {
      setEdges((eds) => {
        const nextEdges = addEdge(
          { ...params, animated: true, style: { stroke: '#00D4FF', strokeWidth: 2 } },
          eds
        );
        recordHistory(nodes, nextEdges);
        return nextEdges;
      });
    },
    [setEdges, nodes, recordHistory]
  );

  // Handle node selection callback
  const onNodeClick = useCallback((_: React.MouseEvent, node: Node) => {
    setSelectedNodeId(node.id);
  }, []);

  const onPaneClick = useCallback(() => {
    setSelectedNodeId(null);
  }, []);

  // Open Inspector
  const handleOpenInspector = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setSelectedNodeId(id);
  }, []);

  // Run single node test
  const handleRunSingleNode = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    setNodes((prev) =>
      prev.map((n) => (n.id === id ? { ...n, data: { ...n.data, status: 'running' } } : n))
    );

    setTimeout(() => {
      setNodes((prev) =>
        prev.map((n) =>
          n.id === id
            ? {
                ...n,
                data: {
                  ...n.data,
                  status: 'success',
                  lastOutput: `Single node test executed successfully at ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}`,
                  executionTimeMs: 142
                }
              }
            : n
        )
      );
    }, 800);
  }, [setNodes]);

  // Inject callbacks into node data
  useEffect(() => {
    setNodes((prevNodes) =>
      prevNodes.map((n) => ({
        ...n,
        data: {
          ...n.data,
          onOpenInspector: handleOpenInspector,
          onRunSingleNode: handleRunSingleNode
        }
      }))
    );
  }, [handleOpenInspector, handleRunSingleNode, setNodes]);

  // Drag and drop node insertion
  const onDragOver = useCallback((event: React.DragEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
  }, []);

  const onDrop = useCallback(
    (event: React.DragEvent) => {
      event.preventDefault();

      const reactFlowData = event.dataTransfer.getData('application/reactflow');
      if (!reactFlowData) return;

      const def: NodeDefinition = JSON.parse(reactFlowData);
      const position = reactFlowInstance.screenToFlowPosition({
        x: event.clientX,
        y: event.clientY
      });

      const newNodeId = `node-${Date.now()}`;
      const newNode: Node = {
        id: newNodeId,
        type: 'workflowNode',
        position,
        data: {
          label: def.label,
          category: def.category,
          nodeType: def.type,
          description: def.description,
          color: def.color,
          iconName: def.iconName,
          status: 'idle',
          ...def.defaultData
        }
      };

      setNodes((nds) => {
        const updated = [...nds, newNode];
        recordHistory(updated, edges);
        return updated;
      });
      setSelectedNodeId(newNodeId);
    },
    [reactFlowInstance, setNodes, edges, recordHistory]
  );

  // Click to add node from palette
  const handleAddNodeFromPalette = (def: NodeDefinition) => {
    const newNodeId = `node-${Date.now()}`;
    const newNode: Node = {
      id: newNodeId,
      type: 'workflowNode',
      position: {
        x: 350 + Math.random() * 80,
        y: 200 + Math.random() * 80
      },
      data: {
        label: def.label,
        category: def.category,
        nodeType: def.type,
        description: def.description,
        color: def.color,
        iconName: def.iconName,
        status: 'idle',
        ...def.defaultData
      }
    };

    setNodes((nds) => {
      const updated = [...nds, newNode];
      recordHistory(updated, edges);
      return updated;
    });
    setSelectedNodeId(newNodeId);
  };

  // Node Inspector updates
  const handleUpdateNodeData = (id: string, newData: Partial<WorkflowNodeData>) => {
    setNodes((nds) =>
      nds.map((n) => (n.id === id ? { ...n, data: { ...n.data, ...newData } } : n))
    );
  };

  const handleDeleteNode = (id: string) => {
    setNodes((nds) => nds.filter((n) => n.id !== id));
    setEdges((eds) => eds.filter((e) => e.source !== id && e.target !== id));
    setSelectedNodeId(null);
  };

  const handleDuplicateNode = (id: string) => {
    const sourceNode = nodes.find((n) => n.id === id);
    if (!sourceNode) return;

    const dupId = `node-dup-${Date.now()}`;
    const dupNode: Node = {
      ...sourceNode,
      id: dupId,
      position: {
        x: sourceNode.position.x + 40,
        y: sourceNode.position.y + 40
      },
      data: {
        ...sourceNode.data,
        label: `${sourceNode.data.label} (Copy)`
      }
    };

    setNodes((nds) => [...nds, dupNode]);
    setSelectedNodeId(dupId);
  };

  // Execute Entire Workflow
  const handleRunWorkflow = async () => {
    setIsRunning(true);
    setIsDebugConsoleOpen(true);

    const result = await runWorkflowEngine(
      nodes,
      edges,
      undefined,
      (newLog) => {
        setExecutionLogs((prev) => [...prev, newLog]);
      }
    );

    // Apply Node Updates
    setNodes((nds) =>
      nds.map((n) => {
        const update = result.nodeUpdates[n.id];
        return update ? { ...n, data: { ...n.data, ...update } } : n;
      })
    );

    setTotalTokens(result.totalTokens);
    setTotalCostEstimate(result.totalCostEstimate);
    setTotalDurationMs(result.totalDurationMs);
    setIsRunning(false);
  };

  // Template Loader
  const handleSelectTemplate = (template: WorkflowTemplate) => {
    setNodes(template.nodes);
    setEdges(template.edges);
    setWorkflowName(template.title);
    setExecutionLogs([]);
  };

  // Export JSON
  const handleExportWorkflow = () => {
    const dataStr = 'data:text/json;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({ name: workflowName, nodes, edges }, null, 2));
    const downloadAnchor = document.createElement('a');
    downloadAnchor.setAttribute('href', dataStr);
    downloadAnchor.setAttribute('download', `${workflowName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')}-workflow.json`);
    document.body.appendChild(downloadAnchor);
    downloadAnchor.click();
    downloadAnchor.remove();
  };

  // Import JSON
  const handleImportWorkflow = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const fileReader = new FileReader();
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      fileReader.readAsText(e.target.files[0], 'UTF-8');
      fileReader.onload = (event) => {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(event.target?.result as string);
          if (parsed.nodes && parsed.edges) {
            setNodes(parsed.nodes);
            setEdges(parsed.edges);
            if (parsed.name) setWorkflowName(parsed.name);
          }
        } catch (err) {
          console.error('Invalid workflow JSON file:', err);
        }
      };
    }
  };

  // Undo / Redo
  const handleUndo = () => {
    if (historyPointer > 0) {
      const prev = history[historyPointer - 1];
      setNodes(prev.nodes);
      setEdges(prev.edges);
      setHistoryPointer(historyPointer - 1);
    }
  };

  const handleRedo = () => {
    if (historyPointer < history.length - 1) {
      const next = history[historyPointer + 1];
      setNodes(next.nodes);
      setEdges(next.edges);
      setHistoryPointer(historyPointer + 1);
    }
  };

  const selectedNode = nodes.find((n) => n.id === selectedNodeId);

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-screen bg-[#080C18] flex flex-col overflow-hidden select-none font-sans text-white">
      {/* Top Header & Control Toolbar */}
      <WorkflowToolbar
        workflowName={workflowName}
        onUpdateWorkflowName={setWorkflowName}
        onRunWorkflow={handleRunWorkflow}
        isRunning={isRunning}
        onTogglePalette={() => setIsPaletteOpen(!isPaletteOpen)}
        isPaletteOpen={isPaletteOpen}
        onOpenTemplates={() => setIsTemplatesOpen(true)}
        onOpenApiManager={() => setIsApiManagerOpen(true)}
        onOpenVersionHistory={() => setIsVersionHistoryOpen(true)}
        onToggleDebugConsole={() => setIsDebugConsoleOpen(!isDebugConsoleOpen)}
        isDebugConsoleOpen={isDebugConsoleOpen}
        onExportWorkflow={handleExportWorkflow}
        onImportWorkflow={handleImportWorkflow}
        onUndo={handleUndo}
        onRedo={handleRedo}
        canUndo={historyPointer > 0}
        canRedo={historyPointer < history.length - 1}
        onZoomIn={() => reactFlowInstance.zoomIn()}
        onZoomOut={() => reactFlowInstance.zoomOut()}
        onFitView={() => reactFlowInstance.fitView({ padding: 0.2 })}
      />

      {/* Main Canvas Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex relative overflow-hidden">
        {/* Left Node Library Drawer */}
        <NodePalette
          isOpen={isPaletteOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsPaletteOpen(false)}
          onAddNode={handleAddNodeFromPalette}
        />

        {/* Center Canvas */}
        <div 
          className="flex-1 h-full relative"
          onDragOver={onDragOver}
          onDrop={onDrop}
        >
          <ReactFlow
            nodes={nodes}
            edges={edges}
            nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
            onNodesChange={onNodesChange}
            onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}
            onConnect={onConnect}
            onNodeClick={onNodeClick}
            onPaneClick={onPaneClick}
            fitView
            snapToGrid
            snapGrid={[15, 15]}
            defaultEdgeOptions={{ animated: true }}
            className="bg-[#080C18]"
          >
            {/* Grid Dots / Lines */}
            <Background 
              variant={BackgroundVariant.Dots} 
              gap={24} 
              size={1.5} 
              color="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)" 
            />

            {/* Minimap Overlay */}
            <MiniMap
              zoomable
              pannable
              nodeColor={(n) => (n.data as WorkflowNodeData).color || '#7C5CFF'}
              maskColor="rgba(8, 12, 24, 0.85)"
              className="!bg-[#0B1020]/90 !border !border-white/[0.1] !rounded-2xl !shadow-2xl overflow-hidden !bottom-4 !right-4"
            />

            <Controls className="!bg-[#0B1020]/90 !border !border-white/[0.1] !rounded-xl !text-white" />
          </ReactFlow>
        </div>

        {/* Right Node Inspector Panel */}
        {selectedNode && (
          <NodeInspector
            nodeId={selectedNode.id}
            data={selectedNode.data as WorkflowNodeData}
            onUpdateData={handleUpdateNodeData}
            onDeleteNode={handleDeleteNode}
            onDuplicateNode={handleDuplicateNode}
            onRunSingleNode={handleRunSingleNode}
            onClose={() => setSelectedNodeId(null)}
            onOpenAttachmentModal={(nodeId) => setAttachmentModalNodeId(nodeId)}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Realtime Execution Console */}
      <DebugConsole
        logs={executionLogs}
        onClearLogs={() => setExecutionLogs([])}
        isOpen={isDebugConsoleOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsDebugConsoleOpen(false)}
        totalTokens={totalTokens}
        totalCostEstimate={totalCostEstimate}
        totalDurationMs={totalDurationMs}
      />

      {/* MODALS */}
      <ApiManagerModal
        isOpen={isApiManagerOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsApiManagerOpen(false)}
      />

      <TemplatesModal
        isOpen={isTemplatesOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsTemplatesOpen(false)}
        onSelectTemplate={handleSelectTemplate}
      />

      <VersionHistoryModal
        isOpen={isVersionHistoryOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsVersionHistoryOpen(false)}
        versions={versions}
        onRestoreVersion={(ver) => {
          setNodes(ver.snapshot.nodes);
          setEdges(ver.snapshot.edges);
        }}
      />

      {attachmentModalNodeId && (
        <AttachmentManagerModal
          isOpen={!!attachmentModalNodeId}
          onClose={() => setAttachmentModalNodeId(null)}
          nodeId={attachmentModalNodeId}
          attachments={
            (nodes.find((n) => n.id === attachmentModalNodeId)?.data as WorkflowNodeData)?.attachments || []
          }
          onAddAttachments={(newFiles) => {
            const current = (nodes.find((n) => n.id === attachmentModalNodeId)?.data as WorkflowNodeData)?.attachments || [];
            handleUpdateNodeData(attachmentModalNodeId, { attachments: [...current, ...newFiles] });
          }}
          onRemoveAttachment={(fileId) => {
            const current = (nodes.find((n) => n.id === attachmentModalNodeId)?.data as WorkflowNodeData)?.attachments || [];
            handleUpdateNodeData(attachmentModalNodeId, { attachments: current.filter((f) => f.id !== fileId) });
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function WorkflowBuilder() {
  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <WorkflowBuilderContent />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}
```

```tsx
interface WorkflowToolbarProps {
  workflowName: string;

  onUndo: () => void;
  onRedo: () => void;
  canUndo: boolean;
  canRedo: boolean;
  onZoomIn: () => void;
  onZoomOut: () => void;
  onFitView: () => void;
}

export default function WorkflowToolbar({
  workflowName,
  onUpdateWorkflowName,
  onRunWorkflow,
  isRunning,
  onTogglePalette,
  isPaletteOpen,
  onOpenTemplates,
  onOpenApiManager,
  onOpenVersionHistory,

  isDebugConsoleOpen,
  onExportWorkflow,
  onImportWorkflow,
  onUndo,
  onRedo,
  canUndo,
  canRedo,
  onZoomIn,
  onZoomOut,
  onFitView
```

```typescript
import { GoogleGenAI } from '@google/genai';
import { ExecutionLog, WorkflowNodeData } from './workflowTypes';

export interface WorkflowExecutionResult {
  logs: ExecutionLog[];
  nodeUpdates: Record<string, Partial<WorkflowNodeData>>;
  finalOutput: any;
  totalTokens: number;
  totalCostEstimate: number;
  totalDurationMs: number;
}

export async function runWorkflowEngine(
  nodes: any[],
  edges: any[],
  apiKey?: string,
  onLogUpdate?: (log: ExecutionLog) => void
): Promise<WorkflowExecutionResult> {
  const startTime = Date.now();
  const logs: ExecutionLog[] = [];
  const nodeUpdates: Record<string, Partial<WorkflowNodeData>> = {};
  
  let totalTokens = 0;
  let totalCostEstimate = 0;
  let currentPayload: any = { message: 'Workflow execution initiated', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() };

  // Helper logger
  const addLog = (
    nodeId: string, 
    nodeName: string, 
    status: ExecutionLog['status'], 
    message: string, 
    output?: any, 
    tokens = 0,
    durationMs = 0
  ) => {
    const log: ExecutionLog = {
      id: `log-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5)}`,
      nodeId,
      nodeName,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
      status,
      message,
      output,
      tokens,
      costEstimate: tokens * 0.0000002, // Estimated $0.0002 per 1k tokens
      durationMs
    };
    logs.push(log);
    if (onLogUpdate) onLogUpdate(log);
  };

  // Find root trigger nodes
  const triggerNodes = nodes.filter((n) => n.data.category === 'triggers');
  const startNode = triggerNodes.length > 0 ? triggerNodes[0] : nodes[0];

  if (!startNode) {
    addLog('system', 'Engine', 'error', 'Workflow is empty. Please add at least one node.');
    return { logs, nodeUpdates, finalOutput: null, totalTokens: 0, totalCostEstimate: 0, totalDurationMs: 0 };
  }

  // Initialize Gemini AI Client
  let aiClient: GoogleGenAI | null = null;
  const effectiveKey = apiKey || process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY || (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY;
  if (effectiveKey) {
    try {
      aiClient = new GoogleGenAI({ apiKey: effectiveKey });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to initialize Gemini client:', e);
    }
  }

  // Traverse nodes in topological order starting from startNode
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const queue = [startNode.id];

  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const currentNodeId = queue.shift()!;
    if (visited.has(currentNodeId)) continue;
    visited.add(currentNodeId);

    const node = nodes.find((n) => n.id === currentNodeId);
    if (!node) continue;

    const nodeData = node.data as WorkflowNodeData;
    const stepStart = Date.now();

    // Mark running
    nodeUpdates[currentNodeId] = { status: 'running' };
    addLog(currentNodeId, nodeData.label, 'running', `Executing node: ${nodeData.label}`);

    // Wait short delay for realistic UI step animation
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600));

    try {
      let stepOutput: any = null;
      let tokensUsed = 0;

      // NODE TYPE EXECUTION LOGIC
      if (nodeData.category === 'triggers') {
        stepOutput = {
          triggered: true,
          triggerType: nodeData.nodeType,
          inputData: currentPayload,
          webhookUrl: nodeData.webhookUrl
        };
        tokensUsed = 12;
      } else if (nodeData.category === 'ai_models' || nodeData.category === 'agents') {
        const systemInstruction = nodeData.systemPrompt || 'You are an autonomous AI agent.';
        const userPrompt = (nodeData.promptTemplate || 'Process incoming input: {{input}}')
          .replace('{{input}}', typeof currentPayload === 'string' ? currentPayload : JSON.stringify(currentPayload));

        if (aiClient) {
          try {
            const modelName = nodeData.model?.includes('flash') ? 'gemini-2.5-flash' : 'gemini-2.5-pro';
            const response = await aiClient.models.generateContent({
              model: modelName,
              contents: userPrompt,
              config: {
                systemInstruction: systemInstruction,
                temperature: nodeData.temperature || 0.7,
              }
            });
            stepOutput = response.text || 'Response received from Gemini model.';
            tokensUsed = userPrompt.length / 4 + (response.text?.length || 0) / 4;
          } catch (err: any) {
            stepOutput = `[Simulated Model Output for ${nodeData.model || 'Gemini'}]: Processed request successfully with structured analysis.`;
            tokensUsed = 150;
          }
        } else {
          stepOutput = `[Agent ${nodeData.label}]: Analyzed data pipeline step. Recommended action: Approve and route downstream.`;
          tokensUsed = 120;
        }
      } else if (nodeData.category === 'tools') {
        if (nodeData.type === 'tool_web_search') {
          stepOutput = {
            searchQuery: 'Enterprise AI Agent Automation Workflows',
            results: [
              { title: 'KRONEX AI Agent Workflows 2026', snippet: 'High performance autonomous agent execution engine with vector memory.' },
              { title: 'Langflow & Flowise Integration', snippet: 'Unified multi-modal agentic platform.' }
            ]
          };
          tokensUsed = 85;
        } else if (nodeData.type === 'tool_code_interpreter') {
          stepOutput = {
            language: nodeData.codeLanguage || 'python',
            stdout: 'Process returned exit code 0. Execution completed in 14ms.',
            result: { data: 'Code execution verified.', recordsProcessed: 42 }
          };
          tokensUsed = 45;
        } else {
          stepOutput = { status: 'success', tool: nodeData.label, output: 'Tool execution completed.' };
          tokensUsed = 30;
        }
      } else if (nodeData.category === 'rag') {
        stepOutput = {
          retrievedDocuments: [
            { id: 'doc-101', score: 0.94, text: 'KRONEX Security Protocol v4.2 requires encrypted secret vault storage.' },
            { id: 'doc-102', score: 0.88, text: 'RAG Chunking strategy default window: 1000 tokens with 200 overlap.' }
          ],
          vectorIndex: nodeData.vectorIndex || 'enterprise-kb'
        };
        tokensUsed = 95;
      } else if (nodeData.category === 'logic') {
        const isIfElse = nodeData.type === 'logic_if_else';
        const evaluationPassed = true; // Simulated logic test
        stepOutput = {
          condition: nodeData.conditionIf || 'score > 0.8',
          evaluation: evaluationPassed,
          routedBranch: evaluationPassed ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE'
        };
        tokensUsed = 10;
      } else {
        stepOutput = {
          status: 'success',
          nodeType: nodeData.nodeType,
          message: `Executed node ${nodeData.label} successfully.`
        };
        tokensUsed = 25;
      }

      const stepDuration = Date.now() - stepStart;
      totalTokens += Math.round(tokensUsed);
      currentPayload = stepOutput;

      // Update node status
      nodeUpdates[currentNodeId] = {
        status: 'success',
        lastOutput: stepOutput,
        executionTimeMs: stepDuration,
        tokensUsed: Math.round(tokensUsed)
      };

      addLog(
        currentNodeId, 
        nodeData.label, 
        'success', 
        `Successfully executed ${nodeData.label}`, 
        stepOutput, 
        Math.round(tokensUsed),
        stepDuration
      );

      // Find downstream connected target nodes
      const outgoingEdges = edges.filter((e) => e.source === currentNodeId);
      for (const edge of outgoingEdges) {
        if (!visited.has(edge.target)) {
          queue.push(edge.target);
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      const stepDuration = Date.now() - stepStart;
      nodeUpdates[currentNodeId] = {
        status: 'error',
        lastError: err.message || 'Execution error'
      };
      addLog(currentNodeId, nodeData.label, 'error', `Error executing node: ${err.message || 'Execution error'}`);
    }
  }

  const totalDurationMs = Date.now() - startTime;
  totalCostEstimate = totalTokens * 0.0000002;

  addLog(
    'system', 
    'Workflow Complete', 
    'info', 
    `Finished entire workflow in ${totalDurationMs}ms. Total tokens: ${totalTokens}.`
  );

  return {
    logs,
    nodeUpdates,
    finalOutput: currentPayload,
    totalTokens,
    totalCostEstimate,
    totalDurationMs
  };
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

type ParticleType = 'glass' | 'charcoal' | 'glow';

interface Particle {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  baseVx: number;
  baseVy: number;
  size: number;
  alpha: number;
  baseAlpha: number;
  type: ParticleType;
  rotation: number;
  vRot: number;
  shardShape: number; // 0: polygon, 1: diamond, 2: micro circle
  mass: number;
}

export default function ASMRBackground() {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
    if (!ctx) return;

    let animationFrameId: number;
    let width = 0;
    let height = 0;
    let dpr = 1;

    // Mouse / Touch tracking (Global window listener for pointer-events-none canvas)
    const mouse = {
      x: -2000,
      y: -2000,
      targetX: -2000,
      targetY: -2000,
      active: false,
      decayTimer: 0,
    };

    let particles: Particle[] = [];

    const isMobile = () => window.innerWidth < 768;

    const getParticleCount = () => {
      if (isMobile()) return 280;
      return 750; // High performance optimal range (600 - 1000)
    };

    const createParticles = (count: number, w: number, h: number) => {
      const arr: Particle[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        // Distribute types: ~50% Glass, ~35% Charcoal, ~15% Glow
        const rand = Math.random();
        let type: ParticleType = 'glass';
        if (rand > 0.5 && rand <= 0.85) {
          type = 'charcoal';
        } else if (rand > 0.85) {
          type = 'glow';
        }

        const size =
          type === 'glow'
            ? Math.random() * 2.2 + 1.2
            : type === 'glass'
            ? Math.random() * 2.5 + 0.8
            : Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5;

        const baseAlpha =
          type === 'glass'
            ? Math.random() * 0.35 + 0.25 // rgba(240,245,255,0.35) average
            : type === 'charcoal'
            ? Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.25 // rgba(80,80,85,0.35) average
            : Math.random() * 0.35 + 0.25; // rgba(180,220,255,0.4) average

        const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const speed = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.1;

        arr.push({
          x: Math.random() * w,
          y: Math.random() * h,
          vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
          vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
          baseVx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
          baseVy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
          size,
          alpha: baseAlpha,
          baseAlpha,
          type,
          rotation: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
          vRot: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.03,
          shardShape: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3),
          mass: Math.random() * 1.2 + 0.8,
        });
      }
      return arr;
    };

    const resize = () => {
      dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      width = window.innerWidth;
      height = window.innerHeight;

      canvas.width = width * dpr;
      canvas.height = height * dpr;
      canvas.style.width = `${width}px`;
      canvas.style.height = `${height}px`;

      ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

      const targetCount = getParticleCount();
      particles = createParticles(targetCount, width, height);
    };

    resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

    // Track mouse & touch globally on window
    const handlePointerMove = (e: MouseEvent | TouchEvent) => {
      mouse.active = true;
      mouse.decayTimer = 120; // active for 120 frames after motion stops

      if ('touches' in e && e.touches.length > 0) {
        mouse.targetX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        mouse.targetY = e.touches[0].clientY;
      } else if ('clientX' in e) {
        mouse.targetX = e.clientX;
        mouse.targetY = e.clientY;
      }
    };

    const handlePointerLeave = () => {
      mouse.active = false;
      mouse.targetX = -2000;
      mouse.targetY = -2000;
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handlePointerMove, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handlePointerMove, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('mouseleave', handlePointerLeave, { passive: true });

    let time = 0;

    // Render loop - 60 FPS Optimized
    const render = () => {
      time += 0.015;

      // Smooth mouse interpolation
      mouse.x += (mouse.targetX - mouse.x) * 0.1;
      mouse.y += (mouse.targetY - mouse.y) * 0.1;

      if (mouse.decayTimer > 0) {
        mouse.decayTimer--;
      } else {
        mouse.active = false;
      }

      // Motion blur trail fill (#0A0A0C background)
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 10, 12, 0.22)';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

      const vortexRadius = Math.min(width, height) * 0.35;
      const vortexRadiusSq = vortexRadius * vortexRadius;

      for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
        const p = particles[i];

        // Organic fluid noise drift (sine & cosine waves)
        const noiseX = Math.sin(time + p.y * 0.003 + p.x * 0.001) * 0.15;
        const noiseY = Math.cos(time + p.x * 0.003 + p.y * 0.001) * 0.15;

        p.vx += noiseX * 0.05;
        p.vy += noiseY * 0.05;

        // Magnetic Vortex forces if pointer is active nearby
        if (mouse.targetX > -1000) {
          const dx = mouse.x - p.x;
          const dy = mouse.y - p.y;
          const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;

          if (distSq < vortexRadiusSq && distSq > 10) {
            const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq);
            const force = (1 - dist / vortexRadius) * 0.45;

            // Swirl / Tangential angle
            const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
            const swirlAngle = angle + Math.PI / 2 + 0.2; // slight inward spiral

            const pullX = Math.cos(swirlAngle) * force * 1.4;
            const pullY = Math.sin(swirlAngle) * force * 1.4;

            // Inward gravitational pull
            const gravX = (dx / dist) * force * 0.8;
            const gravY = (dy / dist) * force * 0.8;

            p.vx += (pullX + gravX) / p.mass;
            p.vy += (pullY + gravY) / p.mass;

            // Glow acceleration feedback
            p.alpha = Math.min(0.85, p.baseAlpha + force * 0.4);
          } else {
            p.alpha += (p.baseAlpha - p.alpha) * 0.05;
          }
        } else {
          p.alpha += (p.baseAlpha - p.alpha) * 0.05;
        }

        // Apply friction and base velocities
        p.vx = p.vx * 0.95 + p.baseVx * 0.05;
        p.vy = p.vy * 0.95 + p.baseVy * 0.05;

        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;

        p.rotation += p.vRot;

        // Screen boundary wrapping
        if (p.x < -20) p.x = width + 20;
        if (p.x > width + 20) p.x = -20;
        if (p.y < -20) p.y = height + 20;
        if (p.y > height + 20) p.y = -20;

        // Draw particle based on aesthetic type
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
        ctx.rotate(p.rotation);

        if (p.type === 'glass') {
          // Glass shard aesthetic - rgba(240, 245, 255, 0.35)
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(240, 245, 255, ${p.alpha})`;

          if (p.shardShape === 0) {
            // Diamond Shard
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(0, -p.size * 1.6);
            ctx.lineTo(p.size * 0.8, 0);
            ctx.lineTo(0, p.size * 1.6);
            ctx.lineTo(-p.size * 0.8, 0);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
          } else if (p.shardShape === 1) {
            // Triangle Shard
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(0, -p.size * 1.4);
            ctx.lineTo(p.size, p.size);
            ctx.lineTo(-p.size, p.size);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
          } else {
            // Micro Specular Circle
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(0, 0, p.size * 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
          }
        } else if (p.type === 'charcoal') {
          // Charcoal dust aesthetic - rgba(80, 80, 85, 0.35)
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(80, 80, 85, ${p.alpha})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, 0, p.size * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        } else if (p.type === 'glow') {
          // Soft blue glow aesthetic - rgba(180, 220, 255, 0.4)
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(180, 220, 255, ${p.alpha})`;
          ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(180, 220, 255, 0.6)';
          ctx.shadowBlur = p.size * 4;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, 0, p.size * 0.9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }

        ctx.restore();
      }

      animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(render);
    };

    // First frame initialization clear
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0A0A0C';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    animationFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(render);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameId);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handlePointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handlePointerMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseleave', handlePointerLeave);
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 -z-10 pointer-events-none overflow-hidden bg-[#0A0A0C]"
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        zIndex: -1,
        pointerEvents: 'none',
      }}
    >
      <canvas
        ref={canvasRef}
        className="w-full h-full block pointer-events-none"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Premium Dynamic UI Sound Synthesizer Utility
// Uses the Web Audio API to synthesize high-quality, futuristic UI sound effects on-the-fly.

class SoundManager {
  private ctx: AudioContext | null = null;
  private volume: number = 0.5;
  private muted: boolean = false;

  constructor() {
    // Load state from localStorage
    try {
      const storedMute = localStorage.getItem('kronex_sound_muted');
      if (storedMute) {
        this.muted = storedMute === 'true';
      }
      const storedVolume = localStorage.getItem('kronex_sound_volume');
      if (storedVolume) {
        this.volume = parseFloat(storedVolume);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('LocalStorage not available for SoundManager', e);
    }
  }

  private initCtx() {
    if (!this.ctx) {
      // @ts-ignore
      const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (AudioCtx) {
        this.ctx = new AudioCtx();
      }
    }
    if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'suspended') {
      this.ctx.resume();
    }
    return this.ctx;
  }

  setVolume(vol: number) {
    this.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, vol));
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('kronex_sound_volume', this.volume.toString());
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  getVolume(): number {
    return this.volume;
  }

  setMuted(muted: boolean) {
    this.muted = muted;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('kronex_sound_muted', this.muted.toString());
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  isMuted(): boolean {
    return this.muted;
  }

  getMuteState(): boolean {
    return this.muted;
  }

  toggleMute(): boolean {
    this.muted = !this.muted;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('kronex_sound_muted', this.muted.toString());
    } catch (e) {}
    return this.muted;
  }

  private playTone(freqs: number[], duration: number, type: OscillatorType = 'sine', sweep: boolean = false, targetFreq?: number) {
    if (this.muted) return;
    const ctx = this.initCtx();
    if (!ctx) return;

    try {
      const mainGain = ctx.createGain();
      mainGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime);
      mainGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(this.volume * 0.15, ctx.currentTime + 0.01);
      mainGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + duration);

      const oscs = freqs.map((freq) => {
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        osc.type = type;
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime);
        
        if (sweep && targetFreq) {
          osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(targetFreq, ctx.currentTime + duration);
        }
        
        osc.connect(mainGain);
        return osc;
      });

      mainGain.connect(ctx.destination);

      oscs.forEach(osc => osc.start());
      oscs.forEach(osc => osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + duration + 0.05));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Web Audio playback failed', e);
    }
  }

  playClick() {
    // Elegant, short high-frequency click
    this.playTone([800], 0.06, 'sine', true, 400);
  }

  playToggle() {
    // Frequency sweep upwards
    this.playTone([250], 0.15, 'sine', true, 450);
  }

  playMenuOpen() {
    // Upward soft dual chime
    this.playTone([350, 520], 0.12, 'sine');
  }

  playMenuClose() {
    // Downward soft dual chime
    this.playTone([520, 350], 0.12, 'sine');
  }

  playVoiceActivation() {
    // High-tech activation chime
    const ctx = this.initCtx();
    if (!ctx) return;
    [440, 554.37, 659.25, 880].forEach((freq, i) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.playTone([freq], 0.1, 'sine');
      }, i * 45);
    });
  }

  playMessageSent() {
    // Crisp upward swoosh tick
    this.playTone([600], 0.08, 'sine', true, 1100);
  }

  playMessageReceived() {
    // Warm dual pop chime
    this.playTone([523.25, 783.99], 0.14, 'triangle');
  }

  playThinking() {
    // Rhythmic ambient soft pulse
    this.playTone([220], 0.08, 'sine');
  }

  playNotification() {
    // Beautiful ambient dual tone chimes
    const now = this.muted ? 0 : this.volume;
    if (now === 0) return;
    const ctx = this.initCtx();
    if (!ctx) return;

    try {
      const playChime = (freq: number, delay: number, dur: number) => {
        const g = ctx.createGain();
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime + delay);
        g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(this.volume * 0.1, ctx.currentTime + delay + 0.02);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + delay + dur);

        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        osc.type = 'triangle';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime + delay);
        
        osc.connect(g);
        g.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.start(ctx.currentTime + delay);
        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + delay + dur + 0.1);
      };

      playChime(523.25, 0, 0.25); // C5
      playChime(659.25, 0.08, 0.35); // E5
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  playSuccess() {
    // Upward micro-arpeggio (Major triad)
    const ctx = this.initCtx();
    if (!ctx) return;
    const base = 523.25; // C5
    const notes = [base, base * 1.25, base * 1.5, base * 2]; // C5, E5, G5, C6
    
    notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.playTone([freq], 0.12, 'sine');
      }, idx * 60);
    });
  }

  playDeploy() {
    // Deep epic tech-sweep
    const ctx = this.initCtx();
    if (!ctx) return;
    try {
      const duration = 0.8;
      const g = ctx.createGain();
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(this.volume * 0.25, ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime + duration);

      // Low rumble osc
      const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc1.type = 'triangle';
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(80, ctx.currentTime);
      osc1.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(250, ctx.currentTime + duration);

      // High sparkling sweep
      const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator();
      osc2.type = 'sine';
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, ctx.currentTime);
      osc2.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1200, ctx.currentTime + duration);

      osc1.connect(g);
      osc2.connect(g);
      g.connect(ctx.destination);

      osc1.start();
      osc2.start();
      osc1.stop(ctx.currentTime + duration + 0.1);
      osc2.stop(ctx.currentTime + duration + 0.1);
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  playTyping() {
    // Very quiet, dry tick sound
    this.playTone([1200], 0.02, 'sine', true, 900);
  }

  playHover() {
    // Faint, smooth subtle brush sound
    this.playTone([400], 0.08, 'sine');
  }

  playError() {
    // Dual discordant low tones for error feedback
    const ctx = this.initCtx();
    if (!ctx) return;
    try {
      this.playTone([150, 155], 0.35, 'triangle');
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  playWarning() {
    // Double pulsing caution warning tones
    const ctx = this.initCtx();
    if (!ctx) return;
    try {
      this.playTone([320], 0.1, 'sine');
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.playTone([320], 0.1, 'sine');
      }, 130);
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  playHeartPulse() {
    // Cardiac thud lub-dub sound
    const ctx = this.initCtx();
    if (!ctx) return;
    try {
      this.playTone([65, 90], 0.12, 'sine');
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.playTone([55, 80], 0.15, 'sine');
      }, 120);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
}

export const soundManager = new SoundManager();
export default soundManager;
```

```typescript
export interface ThemeSettings {
  presetId: string;
  brightness: number; // 50 - 150
  customAccent: string | null; // Hex or null if preset
  glassBlur: number; // 8 - 40
  glowIntensity: number; // 0 - 100
  borderRadius: number; // 0 - 24
  fontSize: number; // 90 - 110
  animationSpeed: number; // 0.5 - 2.0
  reduceMotion: boolean;
  particleEffects: boolean;
  backgroundGrid: boolean;
  cursorEffects: boolean;
  dynamicLighting: boolean;
  smartAutoMode: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_THEME_SETTINGS: ThemeSettings = {
  presetId: 'dark',
  brightness: 100,
  customAccent: null,
  glassBlur: 24,
  glowIntensity: 80,
  borderRadius: 16,
  fontSize: 100,
  animationSpeed: 1.0,
  reduceMotion: false,
  particleEffects: true,
  backgroundGrid: true,
  cursorEffects: true,
  dynamicLighting: true,
  smartAutoMode: false,
};

export function applyThemeToDOM(settings: ThemeSettings) {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const body = document.body;
  const preset = THEME_PRESETS[settings.presetId] || THEME_PRESETS.dark;

  // Primary / Accent colors
  const primaryColor = settings.customAccent || preset.primary;

  // Apply CSS custom variables
  root.style.setProperty('--color-brand-primary', primaryColor);
  root.style.setProperty('--color-brand-secondary', preset.secondary);
  root.style.setProperty('--color-brand-accent', preset.accent);
  root.style.setProperty('--color-brand-background', preset.bg);
  root.style.setProperty('--color-brand-surface', preset.surface);
  root.style.setProperty('--color-brand-text-primary', preset.textPrimary);
  root.style.setProperty('--color-brand-text-secondary', preset.textSecondary);
  root.style.setProperty('--color-premium-border', preset.border);
  root.style.setProperty('--color-premium-card', preset.card);
  root.style.setProperty('--glass-blur', `${settings.glassBlur}px`);
  root.style.setProperty('--border-radius-custom', `${settings.borderRadius}px`);
  root.style.setProperty('--font-scale', `${settings.fontSize / 100}`);
  root.style.setProperty('--glow-opacity', `${settings.glowIntensity / 100}`);

  // Apply Filter Brightness on Root or Body
  root.style.filter = settings.brightness !== 100 ? `brightness(${settings.brightness}%)` : 'none';

  // Toggle class names for legacy styling compatibility
  if (!preset.isDark) {
    body.classList.add('light-theme');
    body.classList.remove('dark-theme', 'amoled-theme');
  } else {
    body.classList.remove('light-theme');
    body.classList.add('dark-theme');
    if (settings.presetId === 'amoled') {
      body.classList.add('amoled-theme');
    } else {
      body.classList.remove('amoled-theme');
    }
  }

  // Set dataset attributes for target selectors
  root.setAttribute('data-theme', settings.presetId);
  root.setAttribute('data-reduce-motion', settings.reduceMotion ? 'true' : 'false');

  // Background style application
  body.style.backgroundColor = preset.bg;
  body.style.color = preset.textPrimary;
}

export function getSavedThemeSettings(): ThemeSettings {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('kronex_theme_settings_v2');
    if (raw) {
      return { ...DEFAULT_THEME_SETTINGS, ...JSON.parse(raw) };
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Failed to parse theme settings from localStorage:', e);
  }
  return DEFAULT_THEME_SETTINGS;
}

export function saveThemeSettings(settings: ThemeSettings) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem('kronex_theme_settings_v2', JSON.stringify(settings));
    localStorage.setItem('kronex_theme', settings.presetId === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark');
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('Failed to save theme settings:', e);
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { initializeApp, getApps, getApp } from 'firebase/app';
import { 
  getAuth, 
  GoogleAuthProvider, 
  signInWithPopup, 
  signOut as firebaseSignOut, 
  onAuthStateChanged, 
  User,
  signInWithEmailAndPassword,
  createUserWithEmailAndPassword,
  sendPasswordResetEmail
} from 'firebase/auth';
import { getFirestore } from 'firebase/firestore';
import firebaseConfig from '../../firebase-applet-config.json';

// Initialize or reuse Firebase app instance
const app = !getApps().length ? initializeApp(firebaseConfig) : getApp();

export const auth = getAuth(app);
export const googleProvider = new GoogleAuthProvider();
export const db = getFirestore(app, firebaseConfig.firestoreDatabaseId || "(default)");

/**
 * Custom hook / helper function to sign in with Google Popup
 */
export const signInWithGoogle = async () => {
  try {
    googleProvider.setCustomParameters({
      prompt: 'select_account'
    });
    const result = await signInWithPopup(auth, googleProvider);
    return result.user;
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Google Sign In Error:", error);
    throw error;
  }
};

/**
 * Sign out helper
 */
export const logoutFirebase = async () => {
  try {
    await firebaseSignOut(auth);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Logout Error:", error);
  }
};

export { 
  signInWithPopup, 
  firebaseSignOut, 
  onAuthStateChanged, 
  signInWithEmailAndPassword, 
  createUserWithEmailAndPassword, 
  sendPasswordResetEmail 
};
export type { User };
```
